text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, form Abdullah Bin Muskan, from Muhammad Al Halby who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about this Verse [24:61] nor is there blame on the sick, nor on yourselves that you eat from your houses, or your fathers' houses – up to the end of the Verse. I said, ‘What is the Meaning of Hisazwj Words or your friends?’ Heasws said: ‘By Allahazwj He is the man who enters a house of his friend, so he eats without his permission’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُناحٌ أَنْ تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ آبائِكُمْ إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ قُلْتُ مَا يَعْنِي بِقَوْلِهِ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ قَالَ هُوَ وَ اللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ يَدْخُلُ بَيْتَ صَدِيقِهِ فَيَأْكُلُ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, form Abdullah Bin Muskan, from Muhammad Al Halby who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about this Verse [24:61] nor is there blame on the sick, nor on yourselves that you eat from your houses, or your fathers' houses – up to the end of the Verse. I said, ‘What is the Meaning of Hisazwj Words or your friends?’ Heasws said: ‘By Allahazwj He is the man who enters a house of his friend, so he eats without his permission’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/82)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Safwan, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [24:61] or what you possess the keys of, or your friends' (houses), having said: ‘Those whom Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Named in this Verse eat without their permission, from the dates, and the curries; and similar to that is the food (eaten by) the wife from the house of her husband without his permission. So as for besides that from the foodstuff, so no’.

citation.arabic_text: اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَوْ ما مَلَكْتُمْ مَفاتِحَهُ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ قَالَ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ سَمَّى اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ تَأْكُلُ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ مِنَ التَّمْرِ وَ الْمَأْدُومِ وَ كَذَلِكَ تَطْعَمُ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ مَنْزِلِ زَوْجِهَا بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ فَأَمَّا مَا خَلَا ذَلِكَ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ فَلَا .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Safwan, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [24:61] or what you possess the keys of, or your friends' (houses), having said: ‘Those whom Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Named in this Verse eat without their permission, from the dates, and the curries; and similar to that is the food (eaten by) the wife from the house of her husband without his permission. So as for besides that from the foodstuff, so no’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/83)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The wife is that she eats and that she gives charity, and for the friend is that he eats in the house of his brother and gives charity’.

citation.arabic_text: لِلْمَرْأَةِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ وَ أَنْ تَتَصَدَّقَ وَ لِلصَّدِيقِ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ فِي مَنْزِلِ أَخِيهِ وَ يَتَصَدَّقَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The wife is that she eats and that she gives charity, and for the friend is that he eats in the house of his brother and gives charity’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/83)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Al Qasim Bin Urwa, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from Zurara who said, ‘I asked one of the two (5th or 6th Imamasws) about this Verse [24:61] nor is there blame on the sick, nor on yourselves that you eat from your houses, or your fathers' houses or your mothers' houses – the Verse. text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [24:61] or what you possess the keys of, heasws said: ‘The man who happens to have a representative for him standing among his wealth, so he eats without his permission’.

citation.arabic_text: اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَوْ ما مَلَكْتُمْ مَفاتِحَهُ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ لَهُ وَكِيلٌ يَقُومُ فِي مَالِهِ فَيَأْكُلُ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [24:61] or what you possess the keys of, heasws said: ‘The man who happens to have a representative for him standing among his wealth, so he eats without his permission’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/84)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim who said, ‘We went over, along with Ibn Abu Yafour, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and we were a group. So he<sup>asws</sup> called for the breakfast, and we had breakfast and he<sup>asws</sup> had breakfast with us, and I was the youngest of the group in age, so I was cautious in my eating. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Eat (well)! Do you not know that the cordiality of the man for his brother is recognised by his eating from his food?’

citation.arabic_text: دَخَلْنَا مَعَ ابْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ نَحْنُ جَمَاعَةٌ فَدَعَا بِالْغَدَاءِ فَتَغَدَّيْنَا وَ تَغَدَّى مَعَنَا وَ كُنْتُ أَحْدَثَ الْقَوْمِ سِنّاً فَجَعَلْتُ أَقْصُرُ وَ أَنَا آكُلُ فَقَالَ لِي كُلْ أَ مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّهُ تُعْرَفُ مَوَدَّةُ الرَّجُلِ لِأَخِيهِ بِأَكْلِهِ مِنْ طَعَامِهِ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Umar Bin Abdul Aziz, from a man from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said, ‘We ate with Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and we were brought a bowl of rice. So we went on excusing ourselves, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What thing are you doing? The one of you with the most intense love for us<sup>asws</sup>, is the best of you in eating with us<sup>asws</sup>’. Abdul Rahman (the narrator) said, ‘So I raised the covering of the meal, so I ate. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, now’, and he<sup>asws</sup> started narrating that: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was gifted a bowl of rice from the area of the Helpers. So he<sup>saww</sup> called over Salman<sup>as</sup>, and Al-Miqdad<sup>as</sup>, and Abu Dharr<sup>as</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> be Pleased with them<sup>as</sup>. So they went on excusing themselves regarding the eating. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘What thing are you<sup>as</sup> doing? The most intense of you<sup>as</sup> all in love for us<sup>saww</sup> is the best of you<sup>as</sup> all in eating with us<sup>asws</sup>’. So they went on to eat well’. Then Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> have Mercy on them<sup>ra</sup>, and may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> be Pleased with them<sup>ra</sup>, and Send Blessings upon them<sup>as</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: أَكَلْنَا مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَأُوتِينَا بِقَصْعَةٍ مِنْ أَرُزٍّ فَجَعَلْنَا نُعَذِّرُ فَقَالَ ( عليه السلام ) مَا صَنَعْتُمْ شَيْئاً إِنَّ أَشَدَّكُمْ حُبّاً لَنَا أَحْسَنُكُمْ أَكْلًا عِنْدَنَا قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ فَرَفَعْتُ كُسْحَةَ الْمَائِدَةِ فَأَكَلْتُ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ الْآنَ وَ أَنْشَأَ يُحَدِّثُنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أُهْدِيَ إِلَيْهِ قَصْعَةُ أَرُزٍّ مِنْ نَاحِيَةِ الْأَنْصَارِ فَدَعَا سَلْمَانَ وَ الْمِقْدَادَ وَ أَبَا ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ فَجَعَلُوا يُعَذِّرُونَ فِي الْأَكْلِ فَقَالَ مَا صَنَعْتُمْ شَيْئاً أَشَدُّكُمْ حُبّاً لَنَا أَحْسَنُكُمْ أَكْلًا عِنْدَنَا فَجَعَلُوا يَأْكُلُونَ أَكْلًا جَيِّداً ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) رَحِمَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ .

text: Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mhaboub, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from isa Bin Abu Mansour who said, ‘I ate in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> went on to place the roast in front of me, then said: ‘O Isa! Determine the love of the man by his eating from the food of his brother’.

citation.arabic_text: أَكَلْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَجَعَلَ يُلْقِي بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ الشِّوَاءَ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا عِيسَى إِنَّهُ يُقَالُ اعْتَبِرْ حُبَّ الرَّجُلِ بِأَكْلِهِ مِنْ طَعَامِ أَخِيهِ .

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundr, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from a number of our companions, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Abdullah Bin Suleyman Al Sayrafi who said, ‘I was in the presence of Abu Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> forwarded some food towards us in which was a roast and some things after it. Then he<sup>asws</sup> came over with a bowl in which was rice. So I ate with him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eat’. I said, ‘I have eaten’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eat, for the determination of the love of the man for his brother by his extension in his eating’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> marked for me a marking by his<sup>asws</sup> finger in the bowl, so he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘You should eat (up to) that’, after I had already eaten. So I ate it’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَقَدَّمَ إِلَيْنَا طَعَاماً فِيهِ شِوَاءٌ وَ أَشْيَاءَ بَعْدَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَ بِقَصْعَةٍ فِيهَا أَرُزٌّ فَأَكَلْتُ مَعَهُ فَقَالَ كُلْ قُلْتُ قَدْ أَكَلْتُ فَقَالَ كُلْ فَإِنَّهُ يُعْتَبَرُ حُبُّ الرَّجُلِ لِأَخِيهِ بِانْبِسَاطِهِ فِي طَعَامِهِ ثُمَّ حَازَ لِي حَوْزاً بِإِصْبَعِهِ مِنَ الْقَصْعَةِ فَقَالَ لِي لَتَأْكُلَنَّ ذَا بَعْدَ مَا قَدْ أَكَلْتَ فَأَكَلْتُهُ .

text: Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Umeyra, from Abu Magra Al Ijaly, from Anbasa Bin Mus’ab who said, ‘We went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> intended to go out to Makkah, so he<sup>asws</sup> ordered for the meal, and it was placed in front of us. So he<sup>asws</sup> said; ‘Eat’. So we ate, and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You have confirmed, you have confirmed! It was said that the determination of the love of the people is by their eating’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So we ate, and the modesty was gone’.

citation.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنِي عَنْبَسَةُ بْنُ مُصْعَبٍ قَالَ أَتَيْنَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ هُوَ يُرِيدُ الْخُرُوجَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَأَمَرَ بِسُفْرَةٍ فَوُضِعَتْ بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا فَقَالَ كُلُوا فَأَكَلْنَا فَقَالَ أَثْبَتُّمْ أَثْبَتُّمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُقَالُ اعْتَبِرْ حُبَّ الْقَوْمِ بِأَكْلِهِمْ قَالَ فَأَكَلْنَا وَ قَدْ ذَهَبَتِ الْحِشْمَةُ .

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Yunus, from Abu Al Rabie who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> called for the meal, so they came with mash. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to us: ‘Approach, so eat’. So the group went on being reserve. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eat, for the warmth of the man for his brother is manifested in his eating with him’. So we went on to gorge ourselves like the gorging of the camels’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from one of our companions who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws would sometimes feed us Al-Farany, and Al-Akhbasa, then heasws would feed the bead and the oil. So it was said to himasws, ‘If only youasws would manage yourasws affairs until you equalise it’. So heasws said: ‘But rather weasws manage by the Command of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic. So when Heazwj Expands for us, weasws expand, and when Heazwj Rations upon usasws, weasws ration accordingly’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) رُبَّمَا أَطْعَمَنَا الْفَرَانِيَّ وَ الْأَخْبِصَةَ ثُمَّ يُطْعِمُ الْخُبْزَ وَ الزَّيْتَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ لَوْ دَبَّرْتَ أَمْرَكَ حَتَّى تَعْتَدِلَ فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا نَتَدَبَّرُ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَإِذَا وَسَّعَ عَلَيْنَا وَسَّعْنَا وَ إِذَا قَتَّرَ عَلَيْنَا قَتَّرْنَا .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Three things there is no Reckoning over these – The Believer for the food he eats, and clothes that he wears, and a righteous wife aiding him, and by her he protects his chastity’.

citation.arabic_text: ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْيَاءَ لَا يُحَاسَبُ عَلَيْهِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُ طَعَامٌ يَأْكُلُهُ وَ ثَوْبٌ يَلْبَسُهُ وَ زَوْجَةٌ صَالِحَةٌ تُعَاوِنُهُ وَ يُحْصِنُ بِهَا فَرْجَهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Three things there is no Reckoning over these – The Believer for the food he eats, and clothes that he wears, and a righteous wife aiding him, and by her he protects his chastity’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/87)

text: A number of our companion, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Abu saeed, from Abu Hamza who said, ‘We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> as a group, so he<sup>asws</sup> called for the meal what in our time had never been any more delicious like it, and good, and came to us with dates, such that we kept looking at it and to our faces, from their cleanliness, and beauty. So a man said, ‘We would be Questioned about these Bounties which we have been favoured with in the presence of a son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is more Benevolent and Majestic that He<sup>azwj</sup> would Feed you food, so you justify it, then He<sup>azwj</sup> would Question you about it. But, He<sup>azwj</sup> would Question you about what He<sup>azwj</sup> has Favoured upon you by with Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) جَمَاعَةً فَدَعَا بِطَعَامٍ مَا لَنَا عَهْدٌ بِمِثْلِهِ لَذَاذَةً وَ طِيباً وَ أُوتِينَا بِتَمْرٍ نَنْظُرُ فِيهِ إِلَى وُجُوهِنَا مِنْ صَفَائِهِ وَ حُسْنِهِ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ عَنْ هَذَا النَّعِيمِ الَّذِي نُعِّمْتُمْ بِهِ عِنْدَ ابْنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَكْرَمُ وَ أَجَلُّ مِنْ أَنْ يُطْعِمَكُمْ طَعَاماً فَيُسَوِّغَكُمُوهُ ثُمَّ يَسْأَلَكُمْ عَنْهُ وَ لَكِنْ يَسْأَلُكُمْ عَمَّا أَنْعَمَ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) .
citation.translation: A number of our companion, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Abu saeed, from Abu Hamza who said, ‘We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> as a group, so he<sup>asws</sup> called for the meal what in our time had never been any more delicious like it, and good, and came to us with dates, such that we kept looking at it and to our faces, from their cleanliness, and beauty. So a man said, ‘We would be Questioned about these Bounties which we have been favoured with in the presence of a son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is more Benevolent and Majestic that He<sup>azwj</sup> would Feed you food, so you justify it, then He<sup>azwj</sup> would Question you about it. But, He<sup>azwj</sup> would Question you about what He<sup>azwj</sup> has Favoured upon you by with Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/87)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al hakam, from Shihab Bin Abd Rabbih who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no extravagance regarding the meal’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) لَيْسَ فِي الطَّعَامِ سَرَفٌ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al hakam, from Shihab Bin Abd Rabbih who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no extravagance regarding the meal’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/88)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad Al jowhary, from Al Haris Bin Hareyz, from Sadeyr Al Sayrafi, from Abu Khalid Al Kalby who said, ‘I went over to Abu Ja’farasws, so heasws called for the lunch. So I ate with himasws such food what I had not eaten at all, any cleaner than it, nor more aromatic. So when we were free from the meal, heasws said: ‘O Abu Khalid! How did you view your food?’, or said: ‘Ourasws food?’’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! I have not seen better than it, nor any cleaner at all, but I remember the Verse which is in the Book of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [102:8] Then on that Day you shall be Questioned about the Bounties’. Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘No, but rather you would be Questioned what you are upon from the Truth’.

citation.arabic_text: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) فَدَعَا بِالْغَدَاءِ فَأَكَلْتُ مَعَهُ طَعَاماً مَا أَكَلْتُ طَعَاماً قَطُّ أَنْظَفَ مِنْهُ وَ لَا أَطْيَبَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا مِنَ الطَّعَامِ قَالَ يَا أَبَا خَالِدٍ كَيْفَ رَأَيْتَ طَعَامَكَ أَوْ قَالَ طَعَامَنَا قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ مَا رَأَيْتُ أَطْيَبَ مِنْهُ وَ لَا أَنْظَفَ قَطُّ وَ لَكِنِّي ذَكَرْتُ الْآيَةَ الَّتِي فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَتُسْئَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) لَا إِنَّمَا تُسْأَلُونَ عَمَّا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad Al jowhary, from Al Haris Bin Hareyz, from Sadeyr Al Sayrafi, from Abu Khalid Al Kalby who said, ‘I went over to Abu Ja’farasws, so heasws called for the lunch. So I ate with himasws such food what I had not eaten at all, any cleaner than it, nor more aromatic. So when we were free from the meal, heasws said: ‘O Abu Khalid! How did you view your food?’, or said: ‘Ourasws food?’’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, from Shihab Bin Abd Rabbih who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Prepare food and be choosy in it, and invite your companions over it’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) اعْمَلْ طَعَاماً وَ تَنَوَّقْ فِيهِ وَ ادْعُ عَلَيْهِ أَصْحَابَكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, from Shihab Bin Abd Rabbih who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Prepare food and be choosy in it, and invite your companions over it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/89)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from one of our companions who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Musaasws banqueted a wedding feast over one of hisasws sons, so heasws fed the people of Al-Medina Al-Falouzajaat for three days in the cooking in the Masjids and the alleyways. Some of the people of Al-Medina refused (to eat), so (the news of) that reached himasws, so heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic did not Grant anything to a Prophetas from Hisazwj Prophetsas except Heazwj Granted Muhammadsaww similar to it, and Increased it by what Heazwj did not Grant themas. Heazwj Said to Suleymanas [38:39] This is Our Gift, therefore give out freely or withhold, without measure; and Said for Muhammadsaww [59:7] and whatever the Rasool gives you, accept it, and from whatever he forbids you, keep back’.

citation.arabic_text: أَوْلَمَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى ( عليه السلام ) وَلِيمَةً عَلَى بَعْضِ وُلْدِهِ فَأَطْعَمَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ الْفَالُوذَجَاتِ فِي الْجِفَانِ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ وَ الْأَزِقَّةِ فَعَابَهُ بِذَلِكَ بَعْضُ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَبَلَغَهُ ( عليه السلام ) ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ مَا آتَى اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ نَبِيّاً مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِهِ شَيْئاً إِلَّا وَ قَدْ آتَى مُحَمَّداً ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مِثْلَهُ وَ زَادَهُ مَا لَمْ يُؤْتِهِمْ قَالَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ ( عليه السلام ) هذا عَطاؤُنا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسابٍ وَ قَالَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ ما آتاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَ ما نَهاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا .

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Haysam Bin Abu Masrouq, from Hisham Bin Salim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Answering the invitation is not Obligatory except regarding four – the wedding, and the birth, and the return (from a journey), and the circumcision’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا تَجِبُ الدَّعْوَةُ إِلَّا فِي أَرْبَعٍ الْعُرْسِ وَ الْخُرْسِ وَ الْإِيَابِ وَ الْإِعْذَارِ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Haysam Bin Abu Masrouq, from Hisham Bin Salim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Answering the invitation is not Obligatory except regarding four – the wedding, and the birth, and the return (from a journey), and the circumcision’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/90)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The banquet is in four – the wedding, and Al-Khars and it is the birth, emancipate from it and feed; and Al-Azaar, and it is a circumcision of the boy; and Al-Ayaab, and it is the man who is inviting his brethren when he returns from his absence’. And in another report, ‘Or Towkeyr, and it is a construction of the house or other such’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) الْوَلِيمَةُ فِي أَرْبَعٍ الْعُرْسِ وَ الْخُرْسِ وَ هُوَ الْمَوْلُودُ يُعَقُّ عَنْهُ وَ يُطْعَمُ وَ الْإِعْذَارِ وَ هُوَ خِتَانُ الْغُلَامِ وَ الْإِيَابِ وَ هُوَ الرَّجُلُ يَدْعُو إِخْوَانَهُ إِذَا آبَ مِنْ غَيْبَتِهِ . وَ فِي رِوَايَةٍ أُخْرَى أَوْ تَوْكِيرٍ وَ هُوَ بِنَاءُ الدَّارِ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The banquet is in four – the wedding, and Al-Khars and it is the birth, emancipate from it and feed; and Al-Azaar, and it is a circumcision of the boy; and Al-Ayaab, and it is the man who is inviting his brethren when he returns from his absence’. And in another report, ‘Or Towkeyr, and it is a construction of the house or other such’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/90)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad by a chain mentioning it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade from feeding a banquet (where) the rich are favoured, and poor are neglected.

citation.arabic_text: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) عَنْ طَعَامِ وَلِيمَةٍ يُخَصُّ بِهَا الْأَغْنِيَاءُ وَ يُتْرَكُ الْفُقَرَاءُ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad by a chain mentioning it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade from feeding a banquet (where) the rich are favoured, and poor are neglected.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/91)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘A man said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘We tend to find such aroma in the wedding feast which is not to be found elsewhere’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘There is none from a wedding which takes place, in which either a camel is sacrificed, or a cow is slaughtered, or a sheep, except that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Sends a carat of musk of the Paradise until it blends in their food. Thus, that is the aroma which you smell, due to that’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّا نَجِدُ لِطَعَامِ الْعُرْسِ رَائِحَةً لَيْسَتْ بِرَائِحَةِ غَيْرِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا مِنْ عُرْسٍ يَكُونُ يُنْحَرُ فِيهِ جَزُورٌ أَوْ تُذْبَحُ بَقَرَةٌ أَوْ شَاةٌ إِلَّا بَعَثَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى مَلَكاً مَعَهُ قِيرَاطٌ مِنْ مِسْكِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يُدِيفَهُ فِي طَعَامِهِمْ فَتِلْكَ الرَّائِحَةُ الَّتِي تُشَمُّ لِذَلِكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘A man said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘We tend to find such aroma in the wedding feast which is not to be found elsewhere’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘There is none from a wedding which takes place, in which either a camel is sacrificed, or a cow is slaughtered, or a sheep, except that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Sends a carat of musk of the Paradise until it blends in their food. Thus, that is the aroma which you smell, due to that’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/91)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from one of the Iraqis, from Ibrahim Bin Uqba, from Ja’far Al Qalanasy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘We take the food, and we make it good, and are choosy in it, but we do not find for it the aroma of the food of the weddings’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘That is because the food of the wedding, in it is a gift of an aroma from the Paradise, because it is a meal taken for the Permissible’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّا نَتَّخِذُ الطَّعَامَ وَ نَسْتَجِيدُهُ وَ نَتَنَوَّقُ فِيهِ وَ لَا نَجِدُ لَهُ رَائِحَةَ طَعَامِ الْعُرْسِ فَقَالَ ذَلِكَ لِأَنَّ طَعَامَ الْعُرْسِ فِيهِ تَهُبُّ رَائِحَةٌ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ لِأَنَّهُ طَعَامٌ اتُّخِذَ لِلْحَلَالِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from one of the Iraqis, from Ibrahim Bin Uqba, from Ja’far Al Qalanasy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘We take the food, and we make it good, and are choosy in it, but we do not find for it the aroma of the food of the weddings’. citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/91)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibrahim Bin Is’haq Al Ahmar, by his chain, from the one who mentioned it, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When a man enters a city, so he is a guest upon the ones in it from his brethren, and the people of his Religion until he departs from them’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ بَلْدَةً فَهُوَ ضَيْفٌ عَلَى مَنْ بِهَا مِنْ إِخْوَانِهِ وَ أَهْلِ دِينِهِ حَتَّى يَرْحَلَ عَنْهُمْ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibrahim Bin Is’haq Al Ahmar, by his chain, from the one who mentioned it, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When a man enters a city, so he is a guest upon the ones in it from his brethren, and the people of his Religion until he departs from them’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/91)

text: Abu Abdullah Al Ashary, from Al Sayyari, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Al Karkhy, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When a man enters a city, so he is a guest upon the ones who are in it, from the people of his Religion, until he departs from them’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ بَلْدَةً فَهُوَ ضَيْفٌ عَلَى مَنْ بِهَا مِنْ أَهْلِ دِينِهِ حَتَّى يَرْحَلَ عَنْهُمْ .
citation.translation: Abu Abdullah Al Ashary, from Al Sayyari, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Al Karkhy, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When a man enters a city, so he is a guest upon the ones who are in it, from the people of his Religion, until he departs from them’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/92)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Al Husayn Al Farsy, from Suleyman Bin Hafs Al Basry, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The guest would be kind with for two nights. So when it is the third night, so he is from the people of the household. He eats what he comes to’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) الضَّيْفُ يُلْطَفُ لَيْلَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا كَانَتْ لَيْلَةُ الثَّالِثَةِ فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ يَأْكُلُ مَا أَدْرَكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Al Husayn Al Farsy, from Suleyman Bin Hafs Al Basry, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The guest would be kind with for two nights. So when it is the third night, so he is from the people of the household. He eats what he comes to’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/92)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Wasil, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The hospitality is on the first day, and the second, and the third, and whatever is after that, so it is a charity, you have given charity with it upon him’. He (the narrator) said: ‘Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Not one of you should lodge upon his brother until he is difficult with him’. It was said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! How is he difficult upon him?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Until there does not happen to be anything in his presence what he can spend upon him’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) الضِّيَافَةُ أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ وَ الثَّانِيَ وَ الثَّالِثَ وَ مَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّهَا صَدَقَةٌ تُصُدِّقَ بِهَا عَلَيْهِ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) لَا يَنْزِلُ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى أَخِيهِ حَتَّى يُوثِمَهُ مَعَهُ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُوثِمُهُ قَالَ حَتَّى لَا يَكُونَ عِنْدَهُ مَا يُنْفِقُ عَلَيْهِ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Wasil, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The hospitality is on the first day, and the second, and the third, and whatever is after that, so it is a charity, you have given charity with it upon him’. He (the narrator) said: ‘Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Not one of you should lodge upon his brother until he is difficult with him’. It was said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! How is he difficult upon him?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Until there does not happen to be anything in his presence what he can spend upon him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/92)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Musa, from Zubyan Bin Hakeym, from Musa Al Nameyri, from Ibn Abu Yafour who said, ‘I saw a guest in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So he (the guest) stood up one day regarding one of the needs. So he<sup>asws</sup> forbade him from that, and stood up himself<sup>asws</sup> to that particular need, and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade from the guest serving’.

citation.arabic_text: رَأَيْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) ضَيْفاً فَقَامَ يَوْماً فِي بَعْضِ الْحَوَائِجِ فَنَهَاهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ وَ قَامَ بِنَفْسِهِ إِلَى تِلْكَ الْحَاجَةِ وَ قَالَ ( عليه السلام ) نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) عَنْ أَنْ يُسْتَخْدَمَ الضَّيْفُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Musa, from Zubyan Bin Hakeym, from Musa Al Nameyri, from Ibn Abu Yafour who said, ‘I saw a guest in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So he (the guest) stood up one day regarding one of the needs. So he<sup>asws</sup> forbade him from that, and stood up himself<sup>asws</sup> to that particular need, and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade from the guest serving’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/93)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Al Sayyari, from Ubeyd Bin Abu Abdullah Al Baghdady, from the one who informed him, said, ‘A guest had lodge with Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, and was seated in his<sup>asws</sup> presence discussing with him<sup>asws</sup> in one of the nights. So the lantern dimmed, and the man extended his hand to correct it. So Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> stopped him, then attended to it himself<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> corrected it. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘We<sup>asws</sup> are a people who do not make our<sup>asws</sup> gests to serve’.

citation.arabic_text: نَزَلَ بِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) ضَيْفٌ وَ كَانَ جَالِساً عِنْدَهُ يُحَدِّثُهُ فِي بَعْضِ اللَّيْلِ فَتَغَيَّرَ السِّرَاجُ فَمَدَّ الرَّجُلُ يَدَهُ لِيُصْلِحَهُ فَزَبَرَهُ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) ثُمَّ بَادَرَهُ بِنَفْسِهِ فَأَصْلَحَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ إِنَّا قَوْمٌ لَا نَسْتَخْدِمُ أَضْيَافَنَا .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Al Sayyari, from Ubeyd Bin Abu Abdullah Al Baghdady, from the one who informed him, said, ‘A guest had lodge with Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, and was seated in his<sup>asws</sup> presence discussing with him<sup>asws</sup> in one of the nights. So the lantern dimmed, and the man extended his hand to correct it. So Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> stopped him, then attended to it himself<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> corrected it. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘We<sup>asws</sup> are a people who do not make our<sup>asws</sup> gests to serve’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/93)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Musa, from Zubyan Bin Hakeym, from Musa Bin Akeyl Al Nameyri, from Maysara who said, ‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is from the weaknesses, neglect of the rewards, and from the disloyalty, making the guest to serve. So when the guest lodges with you, so aid him, and when he departs, so do not aid him in it (his departure), for it is from the lowness, and provide for him, and make good his provision, for it is from the generosity’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ مِنَ التَّضْعِيفِ تَرْكَ الْمُكَافَأَةِ وَ مِنَ الْجَفَاءِ اسْتِخْدَامَ الضَّيْفِ فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِكُمُ الضَّيْفُ فَأَعِينُوهُ وَ إِذَا ارْتَحَلَ فَلَا تُعِينُوهُ فَإِنَّهُ مِنَ النَّذَالَةِ وَ زَوِّدُوهُ وَ طَيِّبُوا زَادَهُ فَإِنَّهُ مِنَ السَّخَاءِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Musa, from Zubyan Bin Hakeym, from Musa Bin Akeyl Al Nameyri, from Maysara who said, ‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is from the weaknesses, neglect of the rewards, and from the disloyalty, making the guest to serve. So when the guest lodges with you, so aid him, and when he departs, so do not aid him in it (his departure), for it is from the lowness, and provide for him, and make good his provision, for it is from the generosity’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/93)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Al Husayn Al farsy, from Suleyman Bin Hafs Al Basry, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The guest, when he comes over and lodges with a people, comes with his sustenance along with him, from the sky. So when he eats, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Forgives for them (their sins) due to him having lodged with them’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِنَّ الضَّيْفَ إِذَا جَاءَ فَنَزَلَ بِالْقَوْمِ جَاءَ بِرِزْقِهِ مَعَهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَإِذَا أَكَلَ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ بِنُزُولِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Al Husayn Al farsy, from Suleyman Bin Hafs Al Basry, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The guest, when he comes over and lodges with a people, comes with his sustenance along with him, from the sky. So when he eats, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Forgives for them (their sins) due to him having lodged with them’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/94)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Musa Bin Bakr, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1st having said: ‘But rather the Assistance upon a people is upon a measurement of their needs, and that the guest lodges with a people so his sustenance descends with him in his lap’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا تَنْزِلُ الْمَعُونَةُ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَئُونَتِهِمْ وَ إِنَّ الضَّيْفَ لَيَنْزِلُ بِالْقَوْمِ فَيَنْزِلُ رِزْقُهُ مَعَهُ فِي حَجْرِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Musa Bin Bakr, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1st having said: ‘But rather the Assistance upon a people is upon a measurement of their needs, and that the guest lodges with a people so his sustenance descends with him in his lap’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/94)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There is none from a guest who camps with a people except that his sustenance is in his lap’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَا مِنْ ضَيْفٍ حَلَّ بِقَوْمٍ إِلَّا وَ رِزْقُهُ فِي حَجْرِهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There is none from a guest who camps with a people except that his sustenance is in his lap’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/94)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Qays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘Our companions mentioned a people, so I said, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I neither have lunch nor dinner except that with me are two from them, or three, or less or more’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Their grace upon you is more than your grace upon them’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! How can that be, and I feed them my food, and I spend upon them from my wealth, and my servants serve them’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When they come over to you, then enter with a lot of sustenance from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, and when they go out, they exit with the Forgiveness for you’.

citation.arabic_text: ذَكَرَ أَصْحَابُنَا قَوْماً فَقُلْتُ وَ اللَّهِ مَا أَتَغَدَّى وَ لَا أَتَعَشَّى إِلَّا وَ مَعِي مِنْهُمُ اثْنَانِ أَوْ ثَلَاثَةٌ أَوْ أَقَلُّ أَوْ أَكْثَرُ فَقَالَ ( عليه السلام ) فَضْلُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ كَيْفَ ذَا وَ أَنَا أُطْعِمُهُمْ طَعَامِي وَ أُنْفِقُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ مَالِي وَ يَخْدُمُهُمْ خَادِمِي فَقَالَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا عَلَيْكَ دَخَلُوا مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِالرِّزْقِ الْكَثِيرِ وَ إِذَا خَرَجُوا خَرَجُوا بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ لَكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Qays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘Our companions mentioned a people, so I said, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I neither have lunch nor dinner except that with me are two from them, or three, or less or more’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Their grace upon you is more than your grace upon them’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! How can that be, and I feed them my food, and I spend upon them from my wealth, and my servants serve them’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When they come over to you, then enter with a lot of sustenance from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, and when they go out, they exit with the Forgiveness for you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/94)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Umar Bin Abdul Aziz, from Is’haq Bin Abdul Aziz, and Jameel, and Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘From what Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> taught Fatima<sup>asws</sup> is that he<sup>saww</sup> said to her<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O Fatima<sup>asws</sup>! The one who was a believer in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Last Day, so let him be benevolent with his guest’.

citation.arabic_text: مِمَّا عَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فَاطِمَةَ ( عليها السلام ) أَنْ قَالَ لَهَا يَا فَاطِمَةُ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Umar Bin Abdul Aziz, from Is’haq Bin Abdul Aziz, and Jameel, and Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘From what Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> taught Fatima<sup>asws</sup> is that he<sup>saww</sup> said to her<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O Fatima<sup>asws</sup>! The one who was a believer in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Last Day, so let him be benevolent with his guest’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/95)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Is’haq Bin Abdul Aziz, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘From what Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> taught Ali<sup>asws</sup> - he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who believed in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Last Day, so let him be benevolent with his guest’.

citation.arabic_text: مِمَّا عَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) عَلِيّاً ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Al Hassan Bin Al Husayn Al Farsy, from Suleyman Bin Hafs, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘From a right of the guest is that he should be honoured, and that the toothpick be prepared for him’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِنَّ مِنْ حَقِّ الضَّيْفِ أَنْ يُكْرَمَ وَ أَنْ يُعَدَّ لَهُ الْخِلَالُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Al Hassan Bin Al Husayn Al Farsy, from Suleyman Bin Hafs, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘From a right of the guest is that he should be honoured, and that the toothpick be prepared for him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/95)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ash’ary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to eat with the people, was the first one to place his<sup>saww</sup> hand with the people and the last one to raise it, until the people had eaten’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا أَكَلَ مَعَ الْقَوْمِ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ مَعَ الْقَوْمِ وَ آخِرَ مَنْ يَرْفَعُهَا إِلَى أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الْقَوْمُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ash’ary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to eat with the people, was the first one to place his<sup>saww</sup> hand with the people and the last one to raise it, until the people had eaten’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/95)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> ate food with a people, was the first one to place his<sup>saww</sup> hand, and the last one to raise it, to let the people (finish) eating’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا أَكَلَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ طَعَاماً كَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ وَ آخِرَ مَنْ يَرْفَعُهَا لِيَأْكُلَ الْقَوْمُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> ate food with a people, was the first one to place his<sup>saww</sup> hand, and the last one to raise it, to let the people (finish) eating’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/96)

text: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Umar Bin Abdul Aziz, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying that the visitor when he visits the visited, so he eats with him, he should cast off the modesty from him, and when he eats with him, he should take a little’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّ الزَّائِرَ إِذَا زَارَ الْمَزُورَ فَأَكَلَ مَعَهُ أَلْقَى عَنْهُ الْحِشْمَةَ وَ إِذَا يَأْكُلُ مَعَهُ يَنْقَبِضُ قَلِيلًا .
citation.translation: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Umar Bin Abdul Aziz, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying that the visitor when he visits the visited, so he eats with him, he should cast off the modesty from him, and when he eats with him, he should take a little’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/96)

text: From him, from Suleyman Bin Hafs, (It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Musa<sup>asws</sup>, that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, whenever the guest came over to him<sup>saww</sup>, would eat with him, and would not raise his<sup>saww</sup> hand from the table-spread until the guest raised his hand’.

citation.arabic_text: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) كَانَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ الضَّيْفُ أَكَلَ مَعَهُ وَ لَمْ يَرْفَعْ يَدَهُ مِنَ الْخِوَانِ حَتَّى يَرْفَعَ الضَّيْفُ يَدَهُ .
citation.translation: From him, from Suleyman Bin Hafs, (It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Musa<sup>asws</sup>, that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, whenever the guest came over to him<sup>saww</sup>, would eat with him, and would not raise his<sup>saww</sup> hand from the table-spread until the guest raised his hand’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح على الظاهر - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/96)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘Al-Abrash al-Kalby asked himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [14:48] The Day when the earth shall be Changed into a different earth. Heasws said: ‘It would be turned into pure bread. The people would eat from it until they are free from the Reckoning’. Al-Abrash said, ‘I said, ‘The people on that Day would be too pre-occupied from the eating’. So Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘They would be in the Fire, not being too pre-occupied from eating the thorny bushes and drinking the scalding water, and they would be in the Punishment, so how would they be too pre-occupied from it during the Reckoning?’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلَهُ الْأَبْرَشُ الْكَلْبِيُّ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ قَالَ تُبَدَّلُ خُبْزَةً نَقِيَّةً يَأْكُلُ النَّاسُ مِنْهَا حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنَ الْحِسَابِ قَالَ الْأَبْرَشُ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَفِي شُغُلٍ عَنِ الْأَكْلِ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) هُمْ فِي النَّارِ لَا يَشْتَغِلُونَ عَنْ أَكْلِ الضَّرِيعِ وَ شُرْبِ الْحَمِيمِ وَ هُمْ فِي الْعَذَابِ فَكَيْفَ يَشْتَغِلُونَ عَنْهُ فِي الْحِسَابِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘Al-Abrash al-Kalby asked himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [14:48] The Day when the earth shall be Changed into a different earth. Heasws said: ‘It would be turned into pure bread. The people would eat from it until they are free from the Reckoning’. Al-Abrash said, ‘I said, ‘The people on that Day would be too pre-occupied from the eating’. So Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘They would be in the Fire, not being too pre-occupied from eating the thorny bushes and drinking the scalding water, and they would be in the Punishment, so how would they be too pre-occupied from it during the Reckoning?’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/96)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Created the son of Adam<sup>as</sup> as hollow’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ خَلَقَ ابْنَ آدَمَ أَجْوَفَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Created the son of Adam<sup>as</sup> as hollow’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/98)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Taymi, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Biin Hakeym, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Al Waleed Bin Sabeeh, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘But rather, the body is built upon the bread’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا بُنِيَ الْجَسَدُ عَلَى الْخُبْزِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Taymi, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Biin Hakeym, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Al Waleed Bin Sabeeh, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘But rather, the body is built upon the bread’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/98)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from al Wasim Bin Urwat, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from Zurara who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [14:48] The Day when the earth shall be Changed into a different earth. Heasws said: ‘It would be changed into pure bread. The people would be eating from it until they are free from the Reckoning’. So a speaker said to himasws, ‘They would be in an occupation on that Day (too pre-occupied) from the eating and the drinking’. So heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Created the son of Adamas as hollow, and there is no escape for him from the food and the drink. Would they be in a more intense occupation on that Day or the ones in the Fire? So they would be crying for it, and Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [18:29] and if they cry for water, they shall be given water like molten brass which will scald their faces; evil is the drink’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ قَالَ تُبَدَّلُ خُبْزَةً نَقِيَّةً يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا النَّاسُ حَتَّى يَفْرُغُوا مِنَ الْحِسَابِ فَقَالَ لَهُ قَائِلٌ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي شُغُلٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ الْأَكْلِ وَ الشُّرْبِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ خَلَقَ ابْنَ آدَمَ أَجْوَفَ وَ لَا بُدَّ لَهُ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ وَ الشَّرَابِ أَ هُمْ أَشَدُّ شُغُلًا يَوْمَئِذٍ أَمْ مَنْ فِي النَّارِ فَقَدِ اسْتَغَاثُوا وَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ وَ إِنْ يَسْتَغِيثُوا يُغاثُوا بِماءٍ كَالْمُهْلِ يَشْوِي الْوُجُوهَ بِئْسَ الشَّرابُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from al Wasim Bin Urwat, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from Zurara who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [14:48] The Day when the earth shall be Changed into a different earth. Heasws said: ‘It would be changed into pure bread. The people would be eating from it until they are free from the Reckoning’. So a speaker said to himasws, ‘They would be in an occupation on that Day (too pre-occupied) from the eating and the drinking’. So heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Created the son of Adamas as hollow, and there is no escape for him from the food and the drink. So they would be crying for it, and Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [18:29] and if they cry for water, they shall be given water like molten brass which will scald their faces; evil is the drink’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/98)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, a narrative about Musaas [28:24] My Lord! Surely I stand in need of whatever good You may Send down upon me. So heasws said: ‘Heas asked for the food’.

citation.arabic_text: اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ حِكَايَةً عَنْ مُوسَى ( عليه السلام ) رَبِّ إِنِّي لِما أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ فَقَالَ سَأَلَ الطَّعَامَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, a narrative about Musaas [28:24] My Lord! Surely I stand in need of whatever good You may Send down upon me. So heasws said: ‘Heas asked for the food’.

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Abu Al Bakhtary, raising it, said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Bless us in the bread, and do not Cause separation between us and it, for had there not been for the bread, neither would we have (been able to) Fast, nor Pray, nor fulfill the Obligations of our Lord<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي الْخُبْزِ وَ لَا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَهُ فَلَوْ لَا الْخُبْزُ مَا صُمْنَا وَ لَا صَلَّيْنَا وَ لَا أَدَّيْنَا فَرَائِضَ رَبِّنَا عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Abu Al Bakhtary, raising it, said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Bless us in the bread, and do not Cause separation between us and it, for had there not been for the bread, neither would we have (been able to) Fast, nor Pray, nor fulfill the Obligations of our Lord<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.

text: Muhammad Bin yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl BiN Shazaan, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Al Waleed Bin Sabeeh, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘But rather, the body is built upon the bread’.

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Yaqoub Bin salim, from Al Musny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Yaqoubasws had a caller for himas who used to call out every lunchtime from hisas house up to a Farsakh, ‘Indeed! The one who wants the lunch, so let him come to the house of Yaqoubas!’ And when it was evening he would call out, ‘Indeed! The one who wants the dinner, so let him come to the house of Yaqoubas!’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ يَعْقُوبَ ( عليه السلام ) كَانَ لَهُ مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي كُلَّ غَدَاةٍ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ عَلَى فَرْسَخٍ أَلَا مَنْ أَرَادَ الْغَدَاءَ فَلْيَأْتِ إِلَى مَنْزِلِ يَعْقُوبَ وَ إِذَا أَمْسَى يُنَادِي أَلَا مَنْ أَرَادَ الْعَشَاءَ فَلْيَأْتِ إِلَى مَنْزِلِ يَعْقُوبَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Yaqoub Bin salim, from Al Musny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Yaqoubasws had a caller for himas who used to call out every lunchtime from hisas house up to a Farsakh, ‘Indeed!
