citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/99)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar, Bin Suweyd, from Ali Bin Al Salt, from a cousin of Shahaab Bin Abd Rabbih who said, ‘I complained to Abu Abdullahasws what I faced from the pains and the indigestion. So heasws said to me: ‘Have lunch and the dinner and do not eat anything between the two, for therein is the spoiling of the body. Have you not heard Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Saying [19:62] and they shall have their sustenance therein morning and evening?’

citation.arabic_text: شَكَوْتُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَا أَلْقَى مِنَ الْأَوْجَاعِ وَ التُّخَمِ فَقَالَ لِي تَغَدَّ وَ تَعَشَّ وَ لَا تَأْكُلْ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئاً فَإِنَّ فِيهِ فَسَادَ الْبَدَنِ أَ مَا سَمِعْتَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ لَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيها بُكْرَةً وَ عَشِيًّا .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar, Bin Suweyd, from Ali Bin Al Salt, from a cousin of Shahaab Bin Abd Rabbih who said, ‘I complained to Abu Abdullahasws what I faced from the pains and the indigestion. So heasws said to me: ‘Have lunch and the dinner and do not eat anything between the two, for therein is the spoiling of the body. Have you not heard Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Saying [19:62] and they shall have their sustenance therein morning and evening?’
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/100)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from the grandfather of Al Hassan Bin Rashid, form Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The dinner of the Prophets<sup>as</sup> was after the darkness, therefore do not leave it. So if you were to neglect the dinner, the body would be ruined’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) عَشَاءُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ ( عليهم السلام ) بَعْدَ الْعَتَمَةِ فَلَا تَدَعُوهُ فَإِنَّ تَرْكَ الْعَشَاءِ خَرَابُ الْبَدَنِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from the grandfather of Al Hassan Bin Rashid, form Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The dinner of the Prophets<sup>as</sup> was after the darkness, therefore do not leave it. So if you were to neglect the dinner, the body would be ruined’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/100)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The origin of the ruination of the body is the neglect of the dinner’.

citation.arabic_text: أَصْلُ خَرَابِ الْبَدَنِ تَرْكُ الْعَشَاءِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The origin of the ruination of the body is the neglect of the dinner’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/100)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Salih, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Neglecting of the dinner is Forbidden, and it is befitting for the aged man that he does not sleep except his hollowness is filled from the food’.

citation.arabic_text: تَرْكُ الْعَشَاءِ مَهْرَمَةٌ وَ يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّجُلِ إِذَا أَسَنَّ أَلَّا يَبِيتَ إِلَّا وَ جَوْفُهُ مُمْتَلِئٌ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Salih, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Neglecting of the dinner is Forbidden, and it is befitting for the aged man that he does not sleep except his hollowness is filled from the food’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/101)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Saeed Bin Janah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When the man is middle-aged so he should not leave eating something at night, for it is a gift for the sleep, and more aromatic for the breath’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا اكْتَهَلَ الرَّجُلُ فَلَا يَدَعُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ بِاللَّيْلِ شَيْئاً فَإِنَّهُ أَهْدَى لِلنَّوْمِ وَ أَطْيَبُ لِلنَّكْهَةِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Saeed Bin Janah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When the man is middle-aged so he should not leave eating something at night, for it is a gift for the sleep, and more aromatic for the breath’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/101)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far Al Ja’fary who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> did not leave the dinner, even though it be by a cake, and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘It is strengthening for the body’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said, and I do not know except that he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And it is correctness for the copulation’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) لَا يَدَعُ الْعَشَاءَ وَ لَوْ بِكَعْكَةٍ وَ كَانَ يَقُولُ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّهُ قُوَّةٌ لِلْجِسْمِ وَ قَالَ وَ لَا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا قَالَ وَ صَالِحٌ لِلْجِمَاعِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far Al Ja’fary who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> did not leave the dinner, even though it be by a cake, and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘It is strengthening for the body’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said, and I do not know except that he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And it is correctness for the copulation’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/101)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Waleed Bin sabeeh who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘It is not good for the one who enters in the old age that he sleeps light, but he should sleep filled up, it is better for him’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ لَا خَيْرَ لِمَنْ دَخَلَ فِي السِّنِّ أَنْ يَبِيتَ خَفِيفاً بَلْ يَبِيتُ مُمْتَلِياً خَيْرٌ لَهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Waleed Bin sabeeh who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘It is not good for the one who enters in the old age that he sleeps light, but he should sleep filled up, it is better for him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/101)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ziyad Bin Ab Al Hallal who said, ‘I had dinner with Abu Abdullahasws so heasws said: ‘The dinner after the last Isha (Prayer) is the dinner of the Prophetsas’.

citation.arabic_text: تَعَشَّيْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَقَالَ الْعَشَاءُ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ عَشَاءُ النَّبِيِّينَ ( عليهم السلام ) .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ziyad Bin Ab Al Hallal who said, ‘I had dinner with Abu Abdullahasws so heasws said: ‘The dinner after the last Isha (Prayer) is the dinner of the Prophetsas’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/101)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullahasws, from Abu Suleyman, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Jabaly, from his father, from Jameel Bin Darraj who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘The one who neglects the dinner on the night of Saturday and the night of Sunday consecutively, his strength would go away from him, so it would not return to him for forty days’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ مَنْ تَرَكَ الْعَشَاءَ لَيْلَةَ السَّبْتِ وَ لَيْلَةَ الْأَحَدِ مُتَوَالِيَتَيْنِ ذَهَبَتْ عَنْهُ قُوَّتُهُ فَلَمْ تَرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْماً .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullahasws, from Abu Suleyman, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Jabaly, from his father, from Jameel Bin Darraj who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘The one who neglects the dinner on the night of Saturday and the night of Sunday consecutively, his strength would go away from him, so it would not return to him for forty days’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/101)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, from Zareeh, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The old man should not neglect the dinner, even though it may be a morsel’.

citation.arabic_text: الشَّيْخُ لَا يَدَعُ الْعَشَاءَ وَ لَوْ بِلُقْمَةٍ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, from Zareeh, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The old man should not neglect the dinner, even though it may be a morsel’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/102)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Bakr Bin Salih, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah Bin Ibrahim, from Ali Bin Abu Ali Al Lahby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘What are your followers saying regarding dinner at night?’ I said, ‘They are forbidding from it’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But I<sup>asws</sup> am ordering you all with it’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ مَا تَقُولُ أَطِبَّاؤُكُمْ فِي عَشَاءِ اللَّيْلِ قُلْتُ إِنَّهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَّا عَنْهُ قَالَ لَكِنِّي آمُرُكُمْ بِهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Bakr Bin Salih, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah Bin Ibrahim, from Ali Bin Abu Ali Al Lahby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘What are your followers saying regarding dinner at night?’ I said, ‘They are forbidding from it’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But I<sup>asws</sup> am ordering you all with it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/102)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Al Hajjal, from sa’alba, from a man who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A meal of the night is more beneficial than a meal of the day’.

citation.arabic_text: طَعَامُ اللَّيْلِ أَنْفَعُ مِنْ طَعَامِ النَّهَارِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Al Hajjal, from sa’alba, from a man who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A meal of the night is more beneficial than a meal of the day’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/102)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ZIyad, from one of the people of Ahvaaz, (It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There are veins in the body called A’ Asha. So if the man neglects the dinner, that vein does not cease supplicating against him till the morning, saying, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you hungry as you kept me hungry, and may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you thirsty as you kept me thirsty’. Therefore, not one of you should neglect the dinner even though it may be a morsel of bread, or a drink of water’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّ فِي الْجَسَدِ عِرْقاً يُقَالُ لَهُ الْعَشَاءُ فَإِنْ تَرَكَ الرَّجُلُ الْعَشَاءَ لَمْ يَزَلْ يَدْعُو عَلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ الْعِرْقُ إِلَى أَنْ يُصْبِحَ يَقُولُ أَجَاعَكَ اللَّهُ كَمَا أَجَعْتَنِي وَ أَظْمَأَكَ اللَّهُ كَمَا أَظْمَأْتَنِي فَلَا يَدَعَنَّ أَحَدُكُمُ الْعَشَاءَ وَ لَوْ بِلُقْمَةٍ مِنْ خُبْزٍ أَوْ شَرْبَةٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ZIyad, from one of the people of Ahvaaz, (It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There are veins in the body called A’ Asha. So if the man neglects the dinner, that vein does not cease supplicating against him till the morning, saying, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you hungry as you kept me hungry, and may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you thirsty as you kept me thirsty’. Therefore, not one of you should neglect the dinner even though it may be a morsel of bread, or a drink of water’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/102)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ZIyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘The one who washes his hands before the meal and after it would live in ease, and would be excused from the affliction in his body’.

citation.arabic_text: مَنْ غَسَلَ يَدَهُ قَبْلَ الطَّعَامِ وَ بَعْدَهُ عَاشَ فِي سَعَةٍ وَ عُوفِيَ مِنْ بَلْوَى فِي جَسَدِهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ZIyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘The one who washes his hands before the meal and after it would live in ease, and would be excused from the affliction in his body’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/102)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Safwan Al Jammal, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘O Abu Hamza! The ablution before the meal and after it both remove the poverty’. I said, ‘May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! They both remove the poverty?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, they both remove it’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ الْوُضُوءُ قَبْلَ الطَّعَامِ وَ بَعْدَهُ يُذْهِبَانِ الْفَقْرَ قُلْتُ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَ أُمِّي يَذْهَبَانِ بِالْفَقْرِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ يَذْهَبَانِ بِهِ.
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Safwan Al Jammal, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘O Abu Hamza! The ablution before the meal and after it both remove the poverty’. I said, ‘May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! They both remove the poverty?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, they both remove it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/103)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Washing the two hands before the meal and after it increases in the age, and the removing for the stains from the clothing, and it stimulates the vision’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) غَسْلُ الْيَدَيْنِ قَبْلَ الطَّعَامِ وَ بَعْدَهُ زِيَادَةٌ فِي الْعُمُرِ وَ إِمَاطَةٌ لِلْغَمَرِ عَنِ الثِّيَابِ وَ يَجْلُو الْبَصَرَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Washing the two hands before the meal and after it increases in the age, and the removing for the stains from the clothing, and it stimulates the vision’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/103)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘One who is gladdened that goodness should frequent his house, so let him perform ablution during the presentation of his meal’.

citation.arabic_text: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَكْثُرَ خَيْرُ بَيْتِهِ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ عِنْدَ حُضُورِ طَعَامِهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘One who is gladdened that goodness should frequent his house, so let him perform ablution during the presentation of his meal’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/103)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Awf Al Bajaly who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The ablution before the meal and after it both increase in the livelihood’. And it is reported that, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Its first (ablution before the meal) negates the poverty, and its end (ablution after the meal) negates the worries’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ الْوُضُوءُ قَبْلَ الطَّعَامِ وَ بَعْدَهُ يَزِيدَانِ فِي الرِّزْقِ . وَ رُوِيَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) قَالَ أَوَّلُهُ يَنْفِي الْفَقْرَ وَ آخِرُهُ يَنْفِي الْهَمَّ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Awf Al Bajaly who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The ablution before the meal and after it both increase in the livelihood’. And it is reported that, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Its first (ablution before the meal) negates the poverty, and its end (ablution after the meal) negates the worries’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول وآخره مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/103)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Ajlan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The ablution before the meal, the owner of the house begins, perhaps someone is embarrassed. So when (everyone) is free from the meal, he begins with the one on his right of the owner of the house, be he a freeman or a slave’. He (the narrator) said, ‘And in another Hadeeth: ‘First the lord of the house would wash his hands, then he would begin with the upon his right. And when the meal is raised, he would begin with the one upon his left of the owner of the house, and it would happen that the last one to wash his hands would be the owner of the house, because he was the first with the patience upon the stains’.

citation.arabic_text: الْوُضُوءُ قَبْلَ الطَّعَامِ يَبْدَأُ صَاحِبُ الْبَيْتِ لِئَلَّا يَحْتَشِمَ أَحَدٌ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ بَدَأَ بِمَنْ عَنْ يَمِينِ صَاحِبِ الْبَيْتِ حُرّاً كَانَ أَوْ عَبْداً قَالَ وَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ يَغْسِلُ أَوَّلًا رَبُّ الْبَيْتِ يَدَهُ ثُمَّ يَبْدَأُ بِمَنْ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ وَ إِذَا رُفِعَ الطَّعَامُ بَدَأَ بِمَنْ عَلَى يَسَارِ صَاحِبِ الْمَنْزِلِ وَ يَكُونُ آخِرُ مَنْ يَغْسِلُ يَدَهُ صَاحِبَ الْمَنْزِلِ لِأَنَّهُ أَوْلَى بِالصَّبْرِ عَلَى الْغَمَرِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Ajlan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The ablution before the meal, the owner of the house begins, perhaps someone is embarrassed. So when (everyone) is free from the meal, he begins with the one on his right of the owner of the house, be he a freeman or a slave’. He (the narrator) said, ‘And in another Hadeeth: ‘First the lord of the house would wash his hands, then he would begin with the upon his right. And when the meal is raised, he would begin with the one upon his left of the owner of the house, and it would happen that the last one to wash his hands would be the owner of the house, because he was the first with the patience upon the stains’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول وآخره مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/104)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Amro Bin Sabit, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Washing your hands in one vessel would improve your manners’.

citation.arabic_text: اغْسِلُوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ فِي إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ تَحْسُنْ أَخْلَاقُكُمْ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Amro Bin Sabit, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Washing your hands in one vessel would improve your manners’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/104)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Fazl Bin Al Mubarak, from Al Fazl Bin Yunus who said, ‘When Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> had lunch with me, and I came with the washing tray to begin with him<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> was in the centre of the gathering, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Begin with the one upon your right’. So when one had performed ablution, the slave intended that he raise the tray, so Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘Leave it, and wash your hands in it’.

citation.arabic_text: لَمَّا تَغَدَّى عِنْدِي أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ جِي‏ءَ بِالطَّسْتِ بُدِئَ بِهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ كَانَ فِي صَدْرِ الْمَجْلِسِ فَقَالَ ( عليه السلام ) ابْدَأْ بِمَنْ عَلَى يَمِينِكَ فَلَمَّا تَوَضَّأَ وَاحِدٌ أَرَادَ الْغُلَامُ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ الطَّسْتَ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) دَعْهَا وَ اغْسِلُوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ فِيهَا .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Fazl Bin Al Mubarak, from Al Fazl Bin Yunus who said, ‘When Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> had lunch with me, and I came with the washing tray to begin with him<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> was in the centre of the gathering, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Begin with the one upon your right’. So when one had performed ablution, the slave intended that he raise the tray, so Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘Leave it, and wash your hands in it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/104)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Abu Mahmoud, from his father, from a man who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you have washed your hands for the meal, so do not wipe your hand with the towel, for the Blessings do not cease in the meal for as long as the moisture is in the hand’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا غَسَلْتَ يَدَكَ لِلطَّعَامِ فَلَا تَمْسَحْ يَدَكَ بِالْمِنْدِيلِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا تَزَالُ الْبَرَكَةُ فِي الطَّعَامِ مَا دَامَتِ النَّدَاوَةُ فِي الْيَدِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Abu Mahmoud, from his father, from a man who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you have washed your hands for the meal, so do not wipe your hand with the towel, for the Blessings do not cease in the meal for as long as the moisture is in the hand’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/105)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Marazam who said, ‘I saw Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> when he<sup>asws</sup> performed ablution before the meal, he<sup>asws</sup> did not wipe the towel, and when he<sup>asws</sup> perform ablution after the meal, he<sup>asws</sup> wiped the towel’.

citation.arabic_text: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ قَبْلَ الطَّعَامِ لَمْ يَمَسَّ الْمِنْدِيلَ وَ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ بَعْدَ الطَّعَامِ مَسَّ الْمِنْدِيلَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Marazam who said, ‘I saw Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> when he<sup>asws</sup> performed ablution before the meal, he<sup>asws</sup> did not wipe the towel, and when he<sup>asws</sup> perform ablution after the meal, he<sup>asws</sup> wiped the towel’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/105)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Al Magra, from Zayd Al Shahaam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having disliked that the man wipes his hand with the towel and in it is something from the food, as a reverence for the meal, until he licks it, or that happens to be a child upon his side who licks it’.

citation.arabic_text: هَا شَيْ‏ءٌ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ تَعْظِيماً لِلطَّعَامِ حَتَّى يَمُصَّهَا أَوْ يَكُونَ عَلَى جَنْبِهِ صَبِيٌّ يَمُصُّهَا .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Al Magra, from Zayd Al Shahaam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having disliked that the man wipes his hand with the towel and in it is something from the food, as a reverence for the meal, until he licks it, or that happens to be a child upon his side who licks it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/105)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from one of his men, from Ibrahim Bin Uqba, (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Wipe the face after the ablution does away with the troubles and increases in the livelihood’.

citation.arabic_text: مَسْحُ الْوَجْهِ بَعْدَ الْوُضُوءِ يَذْهَبُ بِالْكَلَفِ وَ يَزِيدُ فِي الرِّزْقِ .

text: Ali Bin Muhammad, raising it from Al Mufazzal who said, ‘I went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so I complained to him<sup>asws</sup> of the conjunctivitis. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Or would you like something odd?’ Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Whenever you wash your hands after the meal, so wipe your eyelids, and say three times, ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Bestower, the Aggregate, the Benefactor, the Gracious’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So I did that, so I did not have conjunctivitis in my eye after that, and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the Worlds’.

citation.arabic_text: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَشَكَوْتُ إِلَيْهِ الرَّمَدَ فَقَالَ لِي أَ وَ تُرِيدُ الطَّرِيفَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي إِذَا غَسَلْتَ يَدَكَ بَعْدَ الطَّعَامِ فَامْسَحْ حَاجِبَيْكَ وَ قُلْ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الْمُحْسِنِ الْمُجْمِلِ الْمُنْعِمِ الْمُفْضِلِ قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ فَمَا رَمِدَتْ عَيْنِي بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘When the meal is placed, four thousand Angels surround it. So when the servant says, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj’, the Angels say: ‘May Allahazwj Bless you in your meal’. Then they are saying to the Satanla: ‘Get out, O mischievous one! There is no authority for youla over them’. So when they are free, so they say, ‘The Praise is for Allahazwj’, the Angels say: ‘A people who Allahazwj has Favoured so they paying their gratitude to their Lordazwj’. And when they are not Naming (saying Bismillah), the Angels say to the Satanla: ‘Approach, O mischievous one, so become with them!’ So when they raise their hands and do not mention the Name of Allahazwj upon it, the Angels say: ‘A people whom Allahazwj Favoured upon them, so they forgot their Lordazwj Majestic and Mighty’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا وُضِعَتِ الْمَائِدَةُ حَفَّتْهَا أَرْبَعَةُ آلَافِ مَلَكٍ فَإِذَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي طَعَامِكُمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ لِلشَّيْطَانِ اخْرُجْ يَا فَاسِقُ لَا سُلْطَانَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَإِذَا فَرَغُوا فَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ قَوْمٌ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَأَدَّوْا شُكْرَ رَبِّهِمْ وَ إِذَا لَمْ يُسَمُّوا قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ لِلشَّيْطَانِ ادْنُ يَا فَاسِقُ فَكُلْ مَعَهُمْ فَإِذَا رُفِعَتِ الْمَائِدَةُ وَ لَمْ يَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ قَوْمٌ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَنَسُوا رَبَّهُمْ جَلَّ وَ عَزَّ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umyer, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When the meal is placed, so say, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, and when you eat, so say, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> at the beginning of it and at the end of it, and when it is raised, so say, ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا وُضِعَ الْخِوَانُ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ إِذَا أَكَلْتَ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ عَلَى أَوَّلِهِ وَ آخِرِهِ وَ إِذَا رُفِعَ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ .

text: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad,f rom Al Washa, from Ahmad Bin A’iz, from Abu Khadeeja, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>, his<sup>asws</sup> brother Abdullah son of Ali (Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>) came to him<sup>asws</sup> seeking permission for Amro Bin Ubeyd, and Wasil, and Bashir Al-Rahhal. So he<sup>asws</sup> permitted them. So when they were seated, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is none from the things except for it is a Limit ending to it’. So they came with the meal and placed it, so they said in between them, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! He<sup>asws</sup> has given us an opportunity from it’. So they said, ‘O Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>! This meal, is it from the ‘things’?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. They said, ‘So what is its Limit?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it is placed, it is said, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, and every human being should eat from what is in front of him and should something from the front of another (person)’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ أَبِي ( صلوات الله عليه ) أَتَاهُ أَخُوهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ يَسْتَأْذِنُ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ وَ وَاصِلٍ وَ بَشِيرٍ الرَّحَّالِ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَلَمَّا جَلَسُوا قَالَ مَا مِنْ شَيْ‏ءٍ إِلَّا وَ لَهُ حَدٌّ يَنْتَهِي إِلَيْهِ فَجِي‏ءَ بِالْخِوَانِ فَوُضِعَ فَقَالُوا فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمْ قَدْ وَ اللَّهِ اسْتَمْكَنَّا مِنْهُ فَقَالُوا يَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ هَذَا الْخِوَانُ مِنَ الشَّيْ‏ءِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ قَالُوا فَمَا حَدُّهُ قَالَ حَدُّهُ إِذَا وُضِعَ قِيلَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ إِذَا رُفِعَ قِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَ يَأْكُلُ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ مِمَّا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَ لَا يَتَنَاوَلُ مِنْ قُدَّامِ الْآخَرِ شَيْئاً.

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Muhammad Bin Marwan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When the lunch and the dinner are place, so say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj, for the Satanla, may Allahazwj Curse himla is saying to hisla companions, ‘Let’s get out for there is neither a dinner over here nor any overnight sleep’. And when he forgets to Name (Bismillah), hela says to hisla companions, ‘Come, for there is dinner for you all over here and an overnight sleep’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا وُضِعَ الْغَدَاءُ وَ الْعَشَاءُ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ يَقُولُ لِأَصْحَابِهِ اخْرُجُوا فَلَيْسَ هَاهُنَا عَشَاءٌ وَ لَا مَبِيتٌ وَ إِذَا نَسِيَ أَنْ يُسَمِّيَ قَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ تَعَالَوْا فَإِنَّ لَكُمْ هَاهُنَا عَشَاءً وَ مَبِيتاً .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Muhammad Bin Marwan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When the lunch and the dinner are place, so say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj, for the Satanla, may Allahazwj Curse himla is saying to hisla companions, ‘Let’s get out for there is neither a dinner over here nor any overnight sleep’. And when he forgets to Name (Bismillah), hela says to hisla companions, ‘Come, for there is dinner for you all over here and an overnight sleep’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/107)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Gayas Bin Ibrahim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who eats food, so let him mention the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic over it. So if he were to forget, so he should mentioned Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from afterwards, the Satan<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup> vomits what he<sup>la</sup> had eaten (in participation) with him, and the man would find the meal as little’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) مَنْ أَكَلَ طَعَاماً فَلْيَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ مِنْ بَعْدُ تَقَيَّأَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ مَا كَانَ أَكَلَ وَ اسْتَقَلَّ الرَّجُلُ الطَّعَامَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Gayas Bin Ibrahim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who eats food, so let him mention the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic over it. So if he were to forget, so he should mentioned Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from afterwards, the Satan<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup> vomits what he<sup>la</sup> had eaten (in participation) with him, and the man would find the meal as little’.

text: And by this chain, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who mentions Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic upon the meal would not be Questioned about that Bounty, ever!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ مَنْ ذَكَرَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ لَمْ يُسْأَلْ عَنْ نَعِيمِ ذَلِكَ أَبَداً .
citation.translation: And by this chain, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who mentions Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic upon the meal would not be Questioned about that Bounty, ever!’
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/107)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from kuleyb Al Asady, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Muslim man, when he intends to eat food, so he extends his hand, so he says, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the Worlds’, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Forgives for him before the morsel arrives to his mouth’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ الْمُسْلِمَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَطْعَمَ طَعَاماً فَأَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَصِلَ اللُّقْمَةُ إِلَى فِيهِ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from kuleyb Al Asady, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Muslim man, when he intends to eat food, so he extends his hand, so he says, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the Worlds’, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Forgives for him before the morsel arrives to his mouth’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/108)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, raising it, said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, whenever the meal was placed in front of him<sup>saww</sup>, said: ‘Glory be to You<sup>azwj</sup>! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! How Goodly You<sup>azwj</sup> are Testing us. How frequently You<sup>azwj</sup> are Feeding us Glory be to You<sup>azwj</sup>! How frequently You<sup>azwj</sup> are Excusing us. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Expand upon us and upon the poor Believing men and the believing women, and the Muslim men and the Muslim women’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘When the meal is presented, and a man from them has Named (Bismillah), it suffices from them altogether’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِذَا حَضَرَتِ الْمَائِدَةُ وَ سَمَّى رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ أَجْزَأَ عَنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘When the meal is presented, and a man from them has Named (Bismillah), it suffices from them altogether’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/108)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> had a meal with a family, would say to them: ‘The Fasting ones savour the food in your presence, and the righteous eat the food in your presence, and the Chosen Angels send Blessings upon you’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا طَعِمَ عِنْدَ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ قَالَ لَهُمْ طَعِمَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَ أَكَلَ عِنْدَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ وَ صَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ الْأَخْيَارُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> had a meal with a family, would say to them: ‘The Fasting ones savour the food in your presence, and the righteous eat the food in your presence, and the Chosen Angels send Blessings upon you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/108)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When you eat the food, so say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj’ at the beginning of it and at its end, for if the servant Names (Bismillah) before he eats, the Satanla does not eat with him, but when he does not Name (Bismillah), the Satanla does eat with him. So when he Names (Bismillah) after having eaten, and the Satanla had eaten with him, the Satanla vomits what he had eaten’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا أَكَلْتَ الطَّعَامَ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَ آخِرِهِ فَإِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا سَمَّى قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ لَمْ يَأْكُلْ مَعَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ وَ إِذَا لَمْ يُسَمِّ أَكَلَ مَعَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَإِذَا سَمَّى بَعْدَ مَا يَأْكُلُ وَ أَكَلَ الشَّيْطَانُ مَعَهُ تَقَيَّأَ الشَّيْطَانُ مَا كَانَ أَكَلَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When you eat the food, so say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj’ at the beginning of it and at its end, for if the servant Names (Bismillah) before he eats, the Satanla does not eat with him, but when he does not Name (Bismillah), the Satanla does eat with him. So when he Names (Bismillah) after having eaten, and the Satanla had eaten with him, the Satanla vomits what he had eaten’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/108)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Amro Al Mutattab, from Abu Yahya Al Sana’any, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, whenever the meal was placed in front of him<sup>asws</sup>, said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! This is from You<sup>azwj</sup>, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Grace, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Grant. Therefore, Bless for us in it, and Make it pleasant for us, and Sustain us afterwards when we have eaten it, those who are needy for it You<sup>azwj</sup> have Sustained them, so You<sup>azwj</sup> Favoured. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and Make us to be from the grateful ones’. So when the meal is raised, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Carried us in the land and the sea, and Sustained us from the good things, and Graced us upon abundance from His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, with abundant Grace’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا وُضِعَ الطَّعَامُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا مِنْ مَنِّكَ وَ فَضْلِكَ وَ عَطَائِكَ فَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَ سَوِّغْنَاهُ وَ ارْزُقْنَا خَلَفاً إِذَا أَكَلْنَاهُ وَ رُبَّ مُحْتَاجٍ إِلَيْهِ رَزَقْتَ فَأَحْسَنْتَ اللَّهُمَّ وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ فَإِذَا رُفِعَ الْخِوَانُ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي حَمَلَنَا فِي الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ وَ رَزَقَنَا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَ فَضَّلَنَا عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ تَفْضِيلًا .

text: From him, from his father, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Jarrah Al Madainy who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Mention the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic upon the meal. So when you are free, so say, ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Feeds and is not fed’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) اذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُطْعِمُ وَ لَا يُطْعَمُ .
citation.translation: From him, from his father, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Jarrah Al Madainy who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Mention the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic upon the meal. So when you are free, so say, ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Feeds and is not fed’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/109)

text: And from him, from his father, from the one who narrated it, from Abdul Rahman Al Azramy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who mentioned Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic during a meal, or drink, at the beginning of it, and Praises Allah<sup>azwj</sup> during its end, would not be Questioned about that Bounty of the meal, ever!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) مَنْ ذَكَرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عِنْدَ طَعَامٍ أَوْ شَرَابٍ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَ حَمِدَ اللَّهَ فِي آخِرِهِ لَمْ يُسْأَلْ عَنْ نَعِيمِ ذَلِكَ الطَّعَامِ أَبَداً .
citation.translation: And from him, from his father, from the one who narrated it, from Abdul Rahman Al Azramy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who mentioned Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic during a meal, or drink, at the beginning of it, and Praises Allah<sup>azwj</sup> during its end, would not be Questioned about that Bounty of the meal, ever!’

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, from Ibrahim Bin Mihzam, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, whenever the meal was raised, said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! You<sup>azwj</sup> Made it plentiful, and pleasant, and Blessed, so You<sup>azwj</sup> have satiated us, and quenched us. The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Feeds and is not fed’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا رُفِعَتِ الْمَائِدَةُ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثَرْتَ وَ أَطَبْتَ وَ بَارَكْتَ فَأَشْبَعْتَ وَ أَرْوَيْتَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُطْعِمُ وَ لَا يُطْعَمُ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Satiated us among our hungry ones, and Quenched us among our thirsty ones, and Sheltered us among our homeless ones, and Carried us among our walking ones, and Secured us among our scared ones, and Made us to be served among our toiling ones’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَبِي ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَشْبَعَنَا فِي جَائِعِينَ وَ أَرْوَانَا فِي ظَامِئِينَ وَ آوَانَا فِي ضَائِعِينَ وَ حَمَلَنَا فِي رَاجِلِينَ وَ آمَنَنَا فِي خَائِفِينَ وَ أَخْدَمَنَا فِي عَانِينَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Satiated us among our hungry ones, and Quenched us among our thirsty ones, and Sheltered us among our homeless ones, and Carried us among our walking ones, and Secured us among our scared ones, and Made us to be served among our toiling ones’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/109)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara who said, ‘I ate a meal with Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so I could not count how many times he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Made me<sup>asws</sup> desire it’.

citation.arabic_text: أَكَلْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) طَعَاماً فَمَا أُحْصِي كَمْ مَرَّةً قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَنِي أَشْتَهِيهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara who said, ‘I ate a meal with Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so I could not count how many times he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Made me<sup>asws</sup> desire it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/110)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Dawood Bin Farqad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Iasws guarantee for the one who Names (Bismillah) upon his meal that he would not complain from it’. So Ibn Al-Kawwa said to himasws, ‘O Amir Al-Momineenasws! I did eat a meal yesterday and I had Named (Bismillah) over it, and it harmed me’. So heasws said: ‘Perhaps you had a variety, so you Named upon some of it and did not Name upon some, O dimwit!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) ضَمِنْتُ لِمَنْ يُسَمِّي عَلَى طَعَامِهِ أَنْ لَا يَشْتَكِيَ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ الْكَوَّاءِ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَقَدْ أَكَلْتُ الْبَارِحَةَ طَعَاماً فَسَمَّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آذَانِي فَقَالَ لَعَلَّكَ أَكَلْتَ أَلْوَاناً فَسَمَّيْتَ عَلَى بَعْضِهَا وَ لَمْ تُسَمِّ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَا لُكَعُ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Dawood Bin Farqad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Iasws guarantee for the one who Names (Bismillah) upon his meal that he would not complain from it’. So Ibn Al-Kawwa said to himasws, ‘O Amir Al-Momineenasws! I did eat a meal yesterday and I had Named (Bismillah) over it, and it harmed me’. So heasws said: ‘Perhaps you had a variety, so you Named upon some of it and did not Name upon some, O dimwit!’
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/110)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Abu Abdullah Al Barqy, from Abu Talib, from Misma’a who said, ‘I complained what harm I faced from the food, to Abu Abdullahasws, whenever I ate it. So heasws said: ‘Did you not Name (Bismillah)?’ So I said, ‘I do Name, and it (still) harms me’. So heasws said to me: ‘When you cut off the Naming (Bismillah) by talking, then you return to the meal, do you Name (Bismillah)?’ I said, ‘No’. Heasws said: ‘So from over here it harmed you. If you had Named (Bismillah) when you returned to the food, it would not have harmed you’.

citation.arabic_text: شَكَوْتُ مَا أَلْقَى مِنْ أَذَى الطَّعَامِ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا أَكَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ لَمْ تُسَمِّ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي لَأُسَمِّي وَ إِنَّهُ لَيَضُرُّنِي فَقَالَ لِي إِذَا قَطَعْتَ التَّسْمِيَةَ بِالْكَلَامِ ثُمَّ عُدْتَ إِلَى الطَّعَامِ تُسَمِّي قُلْتُ لَا قَالَ فَمِنْ هَاهُنَا يَضُرُّكَ أَمَا لَوْ أَنَّكَ إِذَا عُدْتَ إِلَى الطَّعَامِ سَمَّيْتَ مَا ضَرَّكَ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Abu Abdullah Al Barqy, from Abu Talib, from Misma’a who said, ‘I complained what harm I faced from the food, to Abu Abdullahasws, whenever I ate it. So heasws said to me: ‘When you cut off the Naming (Bismillah) by talking, then you return to the meal, do you Name (Bismillah)?’ I said, ‘No’. Heasws said: ‘So from over here it harmed you. If you had Named (Bismillah) when you returned to the food, it would not have harmed you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/110)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Dawood who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘How shall I Name (Bismillah) upon the meal?’ So heasws said: ‘When there are different vessels, so Name (Bismillah) upon each vessel’. I said, ‘So if I forget to Name (Bismillah)?’ Heasws said: ‘You should be saying, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj upon its first and its last’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) كَيْفَ أُسَمِّي عَلَى الطَّعَامِ قَالَ فَقَالَ إِذَا اخْتَلَفَتِ الْآنِيَةُ فَسَمِّ عَلَى كُلِّ إِنَاءٍ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ نَسِيتُ أَنْ أُسَمِّيَ قَالَ تَقُولُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ عَلَى أَوَّلِهِ وَ آخِرِهِ.
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Dawood who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘How shall I Name (Bismillah) upon the meal?’ So heasws said: ‘When there are different vessels, so Name (Bismillah) upon each vessel’. citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/110)

text: From him, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Al Husayn Bin Ahmad Al Minqary, from Yunus Bin Zabyan who said, ‘ I was with Abu Abdullahasws, so the time of the dinner presented itself, so I went to stand up, so heasws said: ‘Be seated, O Abu Abdullah!’ So I sat down until the meal was placed. So heasws Named (Bismillah) when it was placed. So when we were free, heasws said: ‘The Praise is for Allahazwj. This is from Youazwj and from Muhammadsaww’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَحَضَرَ وَقْتُ الْعِشَاءِ فَذَهَبْتُ أَقُومُ فَقَالَ اجْلِسْ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَجَلَسْتُ حَتَّى وُضِعَ الْخِوَانُ فَسَمَّى حِينَ وُضِعَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ هَذَا مِنْكَ وَ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/111)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Ibn Bukeyr who said, ‘We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> fed us, then we raised our hands, so we said, ‘The Prais is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! This is from You<sup>azwj</sup>, and from Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! For You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Praise. Send Blessings upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَأَطْعَمَنَا ثُمَّ رَفَعْنَا أَيْدِيَنَا فَقُلْنَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا مِنْكَ وَ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Ibn Bukeyr who said, ‘We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> fed us, then we raised our hands, so we said, ‘The Prais is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! This is from You<sup>azwj</sup>, and from Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! For You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Praise. Send Blessings upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/111)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Mention Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic upon the meal, and do not make a noise, for it is a Bounty from the Bounties of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and a Sustenance from His<sup>azwj</sup> Sustenance. It is Obligatory upon you with regards to it, to thank Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and Mention Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and Praise Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ وَ لَا تَلْغَطُوا فَإِنَّهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنْ نِعَمِ اللَّهِ وَ رِزْقٌ مِنْ رِزْقِهِ يَجِبُ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيهِ شُكْرُهُ وَ ذِكْرُهُ وَ حَمْدُهُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Mention Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic upon the meal, and do not make a noise, for it is a Bounty from the Bounties of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and a Sustenance from His<sup>azwj</sup> Sustenance. It is Obligatory upon you with regards to it, to thank Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and Mention Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and Praise Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/111)

text: A number of our companion, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ismail Al Madainy, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from a man who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> ordered with the meat, but it got cold. Then they came with it from afterwards. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Whom Made me desire it’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Bounty during the good health is better than the Bounty upon the measured (constraint)’.

citation.arabic_text: أَمَرَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) بِلَحْمٍ فَبُرِّدَ ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِهِ مِنْ بَعْدُ فَقَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَنِي أَشْتَهِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ النِّعْمَةُ فِي الْعَافِيَةِ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ النِّعْمَةِ عَلَى الْقُدْرَةِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companion, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ismail Al Madainy, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from a man who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> ordered with the meat, but it got cold. text: Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Al Asamma, from Misma’a, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘There is none from a man who gathers his family and the meal is placed in front of him, and he Names (Bismillah) and they are Naming (Bismillah) at the beginning of the meal, and they are praising (Al-Hamdulillah) at the end of it, so the meal is not raised until Heazwj Forgives them’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَجْمَعُ عِيَالَهُ وَ يَضَعُ مَائِدَةً بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَ يُسَمِّي وَ يُسَمُّونَ فِي أَوَّلِ الطَّعَامِ وَ يَحْمَدُونَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي آخِرِهِ فَتَرْتَفِعُ الْمَائِدَةُ حَتَّى يُغْفَرَ لَهُمْ .
citation.translation: Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Al Asamma, from Misma’a, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘There is none from a man who gathers his family and the meal is placed in front of him, and he Names (Bismillah) and they are Naming (Bismillah) at the beginning of the meal, and they are praising (Al-Hamdulillah) at the end of it, so the meal is not raised until Heazwj Forgives them’.
