text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Gayas Bin Ibrahim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Do not eat from the top of Al-Sareyd (a porridge), and eat from its side, for the fennel-flower seeds are in its top’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) لَا تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ رَأْسِ الثَّرِيدِ وَ كُلُوا مِنْ جَوَانِبِهِ فَإِنَّ الْبَرَكَةَ فِي رَأْسِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Gayas Bin Ibrahim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Do not eat from the top of Al-Sareyd (a porridge), and eat from its side, for the fennel-flower seeds are in its top’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/112)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was asked about a meal on a table found on the road, abundant with its meat, and its bread, and its eggs, and its cheese, and among it is a knife. So Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whatever is therein would be evaluated, then eaten, because it would (otherwise) spoil, and there is no remaining for it. So it a seeker of it comes over, the price would be paid to him’. It was said, ‘O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! It is not known whether it is a meal of a Muslim or a meal of the Magians?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They are in a leeway until they come to know’.

citation.arabic_text: الطَّرِيقِ مَطْرُوحَةً كَثِيرٍ لَحْمُهَا وَ خُبْزُهَا وَ بَيْضُهَا وَ جُبُنُّهَا وَ فِيهَا سِكِّينٌ فَقَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) يُقَوَّمُ مَا فِيهَا ثُمَّ يُؤْكَلُ لِأَنَّهُ يَفْسُدُ وَ لَيْسَ لَهُ بَقَاءٌ فَإِنْ جَاءَ طَالِبُهَا غَرِمُوا لَهُ الثَّمَنَ قِيلَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَا يُدْرَى سُفْرَةُ مُسْلِمٍ أَوْ سُفْرَةُ مَجُوسِيٍّ فَقَالَ هُمْ فِي سَعَةٍ حَتَّى يَعْلَمُوا .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was asked about a meal on a table found on the road, abundant with its meat, and its bread, and its eggs, and its cheese, and among it is a knife. So Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whatever is therein would be evaluated, then eaten, because it would (otherwise) spoil, and there is no remaining for it. So it a seeker of it comes over, the price would be paid to him’. It was said, ‘O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! It is not known whether it is a meal of a Muslim or a meal of the Magians?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They are in a leeway until they come to know’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/112)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ZIyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Whenever one of you eats, so let him eat from what is next to him’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَأْكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ZIyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Whenever one of you eats, so let him eat from what is next to him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/112)

text: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Khashab, from Ibn Baqqa, from Amro Bin Jumi’a, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to lick the plate (no left-over) and he<sup>saww</sup> was saying: ‘The one who licks a plate (no left-over), so it is as if he has given in charity with the likes of it’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) يَلْطَعُ الْقَصْعَةَ وَ يَقُولُ مَنْ لَطَعَ قَصْعَةً فَكَأَنَّمَا تَصَدَّقَ بِمِثْلِهَا .
citation.translation: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Khashab, from Ibn Baqqa, from Amro Bin Jumi’a, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to lick the plate (no left-over) and he<sup>saww</sup> was saying: ‘The one who licks a plate (no left-over), so it is as if he has given in charity with the likes of it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/113)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad, raising it, said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws used to brush hisasws teeth sideways and eat in a Herta manner’. And heasws said: ‘Al-Herta is that heasws ate with all of hisasws fingers together’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) يَسْتَاكُ عَرْضاً وَ يَأْكُلُ هَرْتاً وَ قَالَ الْهَرْتُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ بِأَصَابِعِهِ جَمِيعاً .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad, raising it, said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws used to brush hisasws teeth sideways and eat in a Herta manner’. And heasws said: ‘Al-Herta is that heasws ate with all of hisasws fingers together’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/113)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Hashim, from Abu Khadeeja, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, he<sup>asws</sup> used to sit the seating of the slave, and would place his<sup>asws</sup> hand upon the ground, and he<sup>asws</sup> would eat with three fingers, and that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was eating like this, not like what the tyrants are doing, one of them eating with his two fingers’.

citation.arabic_text: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَجْلِسُ جِلْسَةَ الْعَبْدِ وَ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ وَ يَأْكُلُ بِثَلَاثِ أَصَابِعَ وَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) كَانَ يَأْكُلُ هَكَذَا لَيْسَ كَمَا يَفْعَلُ الْجَبَّارُونَ أَحَدُهُمْ يَأْكُلُ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Hashim, from Abu Khadeeja, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, he<sup>asws</sup> used to sit the seating of the slave, and would place his<sup>asws</sup> hand upon the ground, and he<sup>asws</sup> would eat with three fingers, and that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was eating like this, not like what the tyrants are doing, one of them eating with his two fingers’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مختلف فيه - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/113)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Whenever one of you eats food, so he should lick the fingers which he ate with’. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said: “Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Bless you in it”’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَمَصَّ أَصَابِعَهُ الَّتِي أَكَلَ بِهَا قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيكَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Whenever one of you eats food, so he should lick the fingers which he ate with’. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said: “Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Bless you in it”’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/113)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Nuh Bin Shuayb, from Yasseer Al Khaddam who said, ‘The boys ate a fruit one day and did not scrutinize it, and threw it away. So Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said to them: ‘Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! If you are needless, so there are people who are not needless. Feed the ones who are needy to it’.

citation.arabic_text: أَكَلَ الْغِلْمَانُ يَوْماً فَاكِهَةً وَ لَمْ يَسْتَقْصُوا أَكْلَهَا وَ رَمَوْا بِهَا فَقَالَ لَهُمْ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمُ اسْتَغْنَيْتُمْ فَإِنَّ أُنَاساً لَمْ يَسْتَغْنُوا أَطْعِمُوهُ مَنْ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَيْهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Nuh Bin Shuayb, from Yasseer Al Khaddam who said, ‘The boys ate a fruit one day and did not scrutinize it, and threw it away. So Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said to them: ‘Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! If you are needless, so there are people who are not needless. Feed the ones who are needy to it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/114)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at Bin Mihran who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Prayer which had presented itself and the meal is placed. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was at the beginning of the time, begin with the food; and if something from the time had passed, and you fear it would be lost, so you would have to repeat the Prayer, so begin with the Prayer’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ تَحْضُرُ وَ قَدْ وُضِعَ الطَّعَامُ قَالَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ يُبْدَأُ بِالطَّعَامِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ مَضَى مِنَ الْوَقْتِ شَيْ‏ءٌ وَ تَخَافُ أَنْ تَفُوتَكَ فَتُعِيدَ الصَّلَاةَ فَابْدَأْ بِالصَّلَاةِ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at Bin Mihran who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Prayer which had presented itself and the meal is placed. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was at the beginning of the time, begin with the food; and if something from the time had passed, and you fear it would be lost, so you would have to repeat the Prayer, so begin with the Prayer’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول كالموثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/114)

text: From him, from Nuh Bin Shuayb, from Yasser Al Khadim, and Nadir, altogether said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said to us: ‘If I<sup>asws</sup> was standing over your heads, and you all are eating, so do not get up until you are free (from eating)’. And sometimes he<sup>asws</sup> would call one of us, so it would be said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘They are eating’, so he<sup>asws</sup> saying to them: ‘Leave them until they are free’.

citation.arabic_text: ا قَالَ لَنَا أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنْ قُمْتُ عَلَى رُءُوسِكُمْ وَ أَنْتُمْ تَأْكُلُونَ فَلَا تَقُومُوا حَتَّى تَفْرُغُوا وَ لَرُبَّمَا دَعَا بَعْضَنَا فَيُقَالُ لَهُ هُمْ يَأْكُلُونَ فَيَقُولُ دَعْهُمْ حَتَّى يَفْرُغُوا .
citation.translation: From him, from Nuh Bin Shuayb, from Yasser Al Khadim, and Nadir, altogether said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said to us: ‘If I<sup>asws</sup> was standing over your heads, and you all are eating, so do not get up until you are free (from eating)’. And sometimes he<sup>asws</sup> would call one of us, so it would be said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘They are eating’, so he<sup>asws</sup> saying to them: ‘Leave them until they are free’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/114)

text: And it is reported from Nadir the servant who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, whenever one of us (servants) was eating, would not get him to attend to something until he was free from his meal’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُنَا لَا يَسْتَخْدِمُهُ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْ طَعَامِهِ .
citation.translation: And it is reported from Nadir the servant who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, whenever one of us (servants) was eating, would not get him to attend to something until he was free from his meal’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/114)

text: And it is reported by Nadir the servant who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassanasws placed one Jowzinja (a sweet) upon the other, and gave it to me’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) يَضَعُ جَوْزِينَجَةً عَلَى الْأُخْرَى وَ يُنَاوِلُنِي .
citation.translation: And it is reported by Nadir the servant who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassanasws placed one Jowzinja (a sweet) upon the other, and gave it to me’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/114)

text: Ahmad, from his father, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said, when sometimes they come with the meal, so one of the people intended to wash his hands, so he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘The one whose hands are clean, so there is no problem if he were to eat without washing his hands’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) رُبَّمَا أُتِيَ بِالْمَائِدَةِ فَأَرَادَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ أَنْ يَغْسِلَ يَدَهُ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ كَانَتْ يَدُهُ نَظِيفَةً فَلَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَغْسِلَ يَدَهُ .
citation.translation: Ahmad, from his father, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said, when sometimes they come with the meal, so one of the people intended to wash his hands, so he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘The one whose hands are clean, so there is no problem if he were to eat without washing his hands’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/114)

text: Ahmad Bin Yahya Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ibn Abu Al Balaad, from his father, from Bazie Bin Umar Bin Bazie who said, ‘I went over to Abu Ja’farasws and heasws was eating vinegar (Khal) and oil in one black bowl, with a yellow inscription in the middle of it: ‘Say, He Allah is One’ (Chapter 112 Verse 1). So heasws said to me: ‘Approach, O Bazie! So I approached and ate with him. Then heasws sipped three sips from the water when there did not remain anything from the bread. Then heasws gave it to me, so I sipped the remainder’.

citation.arabic_text: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) وَ هُوَ يَأْكُلُ خَلًّا وَ زَيْتاً فِي قَصْعَةٍ سَوْدَاءَ مَكْتُوبٍ فِي وَسَطِهَا بِصُفْرَةٍ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ فَقَالَ لِي ادْنُ يَا بَزِيعُ فَدَنَوْتُ فَأَكَلْتُ مَعَهُ ثُمَّ حَسَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ ثَلَاثَ حَسِيَّاتٍ حِينَ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنَ الْخُبْزِ شَيْ‏ءٌ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَنِيهَا فَحَسَوْتُ الْبَقِيَّةَ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Yahya Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ibn Abu Al Balaad, from his father, from Bazie Bin Umar Bin Bazie who said, ‘I went over to Abu Ja’farasws and heasws was eating vinegar (Khal) and oil in one black bowl, with a yellow inscription in the middle of it: ‘Say, He Allah is One’ (Chapter 112 Verse 1). So heasws said to me: ‘Approach, O Bazie! So I approached and ate with him. Then heasws sipped three sips from the water when there did not remain anything from the bread. Then heasws gave it to me, so I sipped the remainder’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/115)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Moamar Bin Khallad who said, ‘I heard Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who eats food in his house, so something falls down from it, so let him take it; and the one who eats in the desert, or outside, so let him leave it for the birds or the wild animals’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ مَنْ أَكَلَ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ طَعَاماً فَسَقَطَ مِنْهُ شَيْ‏ءٌ فَلْيَتَنَاوَلْهُ وَ مَنْ أَكَلَ فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ أَوْ خَارِجاً فَلْيَتْرُكْهُ لِطَائِرٍ أَوْ سَبُعٍ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Moamar Bin Khallad who said, ‘I heard Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who eats food in his house, so something falls down from it, so let him take it; and the one who eats in the desert, or outside, so let him leave it for the birds or the wild animals’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/115)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘Ismail had a banquet, so Abu Abdullahasws said to him: ‘It is upon you with (inviting) the poor, so satiate them, for Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [34:49] and what the falsehood started, shall not return’.

citation.arabic_text: أَوْلَمَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَلَيْكَ بِالْمَسَاكِينِ فَأَشْبِعْهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ وَ ما يُبْدِئُ الْباطِلُ وَ ما يُعِيدُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘Ismail had a banquet, so Abu Abdullahasws said to him: ‘It is upon you with (inviting) the poor, so satiate them, for Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [34:49] and what the falsehood started, shall not return’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/115)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Ibrahim Al Ja’fary, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, (It has been narrated) raising it from them<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, whenever he<sup>saww</sup> ate gave to one in front of his<sup>saww</sup> eyes, and when he<sup>saww</sup> drank, quenched the one upon his<sup>saww</sup> right’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالُوا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا أَكَلَ لَقَّمَ مَنْ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ وَ إِذَا شَرِبَ سَقَى مَنْ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Ibrahim Al Ja’fary, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, (It has been narrated) raising it from them<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, whenever he<sup>saww</sup> ate gave to one in front of his<sup>saww</sup> eyes, and when he<sup>saww</sup> drank, quenched the one upon his<sup>saww</sup> right’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/116)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from a number of our companions, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from his uncle Yaqoub Bin Salim, raising it, said, ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Do not leave the food-stained towel in the house, for it is a play-pen for the devils’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) لَا تُؤْوُوا مِنْدِيلَ الْغَمَرِ فِي الْبَيْتِ فَإِنَّهُ مَرْبِضٌ لِلشَّيَاطِينِ.
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from a number of our companions, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from his uncle Yaqoub Bin Salim, raising it, said, ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Do not leave the food-stained towel in the house, for it is a play-pen for the devils’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/116)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Present your family members during every Friday with something from the fruits, or the meats, until they are joyful with the Friday’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْرِفُوا أَهَالِيَكُمْ فِي كُلِّ جُمُعَةٍ بِشَيْ‏ءٍ مِنَ الْفَاكِهَةِ أَوِ اللَّحْمِ حَتَّى يَفْرَحُوا بِالْجُمُعَةِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Present your family members during every Friday with something from the fruits, or the meats, until they are joyful with the Friday’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/116)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said; ‘The one who builds a dwelling, so let him slaughter a fat ram, and let him feed its meat to the poor. Then he should be saying, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Stave off from me the castaways from the Jinn and the humans, and the devils, and Bless for us in our house’, except that he would be Given whatever he asks’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَنْ بَنَى مَسْكَناً فَلْيَذْبَحْ كَبْشاً سَمِيناً وَ لْيُطْعِمْ لَحْمَهُ الْمَسَاكِينَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ ادْحَرْ عَنِّي مَرَدَةَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ وَ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي بُيُوتِنَا إِلَّا أُعْطِيَ مَا سَأَلَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said; ‘The one who builds a dwelling, so let him slaughter a fat ram, and let him feed its meat to the poor. Then he should be saying, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Stave off from me the castaways from the Jinn and the humans, and the devils, and Bless for us in our house’, except that he would be Given whatever he asks’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/116)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, (It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When you have eaten something, so lie down upon you back and place your right leg upon the left’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا أَكَلْتَ شَيْئاً فَاسْتَلْقِ عَلَى قَفَاكَ وَ ضَعْ رِجْلَكَ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى الْيُسْرَى .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, (It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When you have eaten something, so lie down upon you back and place your right leg upon the left’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/116)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin yahya, form his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, form Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eat what falls from the food-spread, for it is a healing from every illness by the Permission of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic for the one who wants to be healed by it’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) كُلُوا مَا يَسْقُطُ مِنَ الْخِوَانِ فَإِنَّهُ شِفَاءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْتَشْفِيَ بِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin yahya, form his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, form Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eat what falls from the food-spread, for it is a healing from every illness by the Permission of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic for the one who wants to be healed by it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/117)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sandy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Aban Bin Usman, from Dawood Bin Kaseer who said, ‘I had dinner in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> late into the evening. So when he<sup>asws</sup> was free from his<sup>asws</sup> dinner, he<sup>asws</sup> Praised Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic and said: ‘This is my<sup>asws</sup> dinner, and a dinner of my<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup>’. So when the meal was raised, he<sup>asws</sup> proceeded to eat what had fallen from it, then cast it into his<sup>asws</sup> mouth’.

citation.arabic_text: تَعَشَّيْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَتَمَةً فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ عَشَائِهِ حَمِدَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ قَالَ هَذَا عَشَائِي وَ عَشَاءُ آبَائِي فَلَمَّا رُفِعَ الْخِوَانُ تَقَمَّمَ مَا سَقَطَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ أَلْقَاهُ إِلَى فِيهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sandy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Aban Bin Usman, from Dawood Bin Kaseer who said, ‘I had dinner in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> late into the evening. So when he<sup>asws</sup> was free from his<sup>asws</sup> dinner, he<sup>asws</sup> Praised Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic and said: ‘This is my<sup>asws</sup> dinner, and a dinner of my<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup>’. So when the meal was raised, he<sup>asws</sup> proceeded to eat what had fallen from it, then cast it into his<sup>asws</sup> mouth’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/117)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Abdullah Bin Salih Al Khash’amy who said, ‘I complained to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> of the waist pain. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon you is with what falls from the food-spread, so eat it’. So I did that, so it went away from me’. Ibrahim (the narrator) said, ‘I had found that in the right side and the left, so I took with that (eating the fallen crumbs), so I benefited by it’.

citation.arabic_text: شَكَوْتُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَجَعَ الْخَاصِرَةِ فَقَالَ عَلَيْكَ بِمَا يَسْقُطُ مِنْ الْخِوَانِ فَكُلْهُ قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ فَذَهَبَ عَنِّي قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ قَدْ كُنْتُ وَجَدْتُ ذَلِكَ فِي الْجَانِبِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَ الْأَيْسَرِ فَأَخَذْتُ ذَلِكَ فَانْتَفَعْتُ بِهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Abdullah Bin Salih Al Khash’amy who said, ‘I complained to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> of the waist pain. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon you is with what falls from the food-spread, so eat it’. So I did that, so it went away from me’. Ibrahim (the narrator) said, ‘I had found that in the right side and the left, so I took with that (eating the fallen crumbs), so I benefited by it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/117)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Al Hassan Bin Muawiya Bin Wahab, from his father, who said, ‘We ate in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So when the meal was raised, he<sup>asws</sup> picked up what had fallen from it, so he<sup>asws</sup> ate it. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to us: ‘It negates the poverty and causes abundance of the children’.

citation.arabic_text: أَكَلْنَا عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَلَمَّا رُفِعَ الْخِوَانُ لَقَطَ مَا وَقَعَ مِنْهُ فَأَكَلَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَنَا إِنَّهُ يَنْفِي الْفَقْرَ وَ يُكْثِرُ الْوَلَدَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Al Hassan Bin Muawiya Bin Wahab, from his father, who said, ‘We ate in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So when the meal was raised, he<sup>asws</sup> picked up what had fallen from it, so he<sup>asws</sup> ate it. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to us: ‘It negates the poverty and causes abundance of the children’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/117)

text: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Khashaab, from Ibn Baqqa, from Amro Bin Jumi’a who said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who finds one crumb, so he eats it, would have a Reward for him; and the one who finds it in dirt, so he washes it, then raises it, would have seventy Rewards for him’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَنْ وَجَدَ كِسْرَةً فَأَكَلَهَا كَانَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ وَ مَنْ وَجَدَهَا فِي قَذِرٍ فَغَسَلَهَا ثُمَّ رَفَعَهَا كَانَتْ لَهُ سَبْعُونَ حَسَنَةً .
citation.translation: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Khashaab, from Ibn Baqqa, from Amro Bin Jumi’a who said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who finds one crumb, so he eats it, would have a Reward for him; and the one who finds it in dirt, so he washes it, then raises it, would have seventy Rewards for him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/117)

text: And by this chain, from Amro Bin Jumi’a, from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww went over to Ayesha, so hesaww saw a crumb which hesaww almost trod upon, so hesaww took it and ate it. Then hesaww said: ‘O Humeyra! Honour the neighbourliness of a Bounty of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic upon you, for it does not flee from a people, so it almost does not return to them’.

citation.arabic_text: دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَرَأَى كِسْرَةً كَادَ أَنْ يَطَأَهَا فَأَخَذَهَا فَأَكَلَهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا حُمَيْرَاءُ أَكْرِمِي جِوَارَ نِعَمِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَيْكِ فَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تَنْفِرْ مِنْ قَوْمٍ فَكَادَتْ تَعُودُ إِلَيْهِمْ .
citation.translation: And by this chain, from Amro Bin Jumi’a, from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww went over to Ayesha, so hesaww saw a crumb which hesaww almost trod upon, so hesaww took it and ate it. Then hesaww said: ‘O Humeyra! Honour the neighbourliness of a Bounty of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic upon you, for it does not flee from a people, so it almost does not return to them’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/118)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ibrahim Bin Mihzan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I complained to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> what I faced from the waist pain. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is preventing you from eating what falls from the food-spread’.

citation.arabic_text: شَكَا رَجُلٌ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَا يَلْقَى مِنْ وَجَعِ الْخَاصِرَةِ فَقَالَ مَا يَمْنَعُكَ مِنْ أَكْلِ مَا يَقَعُ مِنَ الْخِوَانِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ibrahim Bin Mihzan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I complained to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> what I faced from the waist pain. text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Moamar Bin Khallad who said, ‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who eats food in his house, so something from it falls off, so let him take it; and the one who eats in the desert, or outside, so let him leave it for the birds and the wild animals’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ مَنْ أَكَلَ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ طَعَاماً فَسَقَطَ مِنْهُ شَيْ‏ءٌ فَلْيَتَنَاوَلْهُ وَ مَنْ أَكَلَ فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ أَوْ خَارِجاً فَلْيَتْرُكْهُ لِلطَّيْرِ وَ السَّبُعِ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from one of his companions, from Al Asamma, from Abdullah Al Arjany who said, ‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> was eating. So I saw him pursue the likes of the sesame seeds from the food what fell off from the food-spread. So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! You<sup>asws</sup> are pursuing this?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abdullah! This is the sustenance, therefore do not leave it, but in it is a healing from every illness’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ هُوَ يَأْكُلُ فَرَأَيْتُهُ يَتَتَبَّعُ مِثْلَ السِّمْسِمِ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ مَا سَقَطَ مِنَ الْخِوَانِ فَقُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ تَتَبَّعُ هَذَا فَقَالَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ هَذَا رِزْقُكَ فَلَا تَدَعْهُ أَمَا إِنَّ فِيهِ شِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Amro Bin Shimr who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> lick my<sup>asws</sup> fingers from the sauce until I<sup>asws</sup> fear that my<sup>asws</sup> servant would see me, so he would view that as being from the greed, and that is not like that. A people had the Bounties offloaded upon them, and they are the (people of) Sarsaar. So they took the wheat and made it as bread (to be used) for firewood, and made it to be utilised for cleaning their children with it, to the extent that a big hill gathered from that (soiled bread)’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So a righteous man passed by them and there was a woman, and she was doing that with a child of hers (cleaning him with the bread). So he said to them, ‘Woe be unto you all! Fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Might and Majestic, and do not change what is with you from the Bounties’. So she said to him, ‘It is as if you are scaring us with the hunger. But, for as long as our Sarsaar (river) is flowing, so we do not fear the hunger’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Made them regret and weakened the Sarsaar (river) to them, and Withheld the drops of the sky (rain) from them, and the vegetation of the earth. So they became needy to that hill (of soiled bread) and they would then distribute it between them with the scale’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِنِّي لَأَلْحَسُ أَصَابِعِي مِنَ الْأُدْمِ حَتَّى أَخَافَ أَنْ يَرَانِي خَادِمِي فَيَرَى أَنَّ ذَلِكَ مِنَ التَّجَشُّعِ وَ لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ كَذَلِكَ إِنَّ قَوْماً أُفْرِغَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ النِّعْمَةُ وَ هُمْ أَهْلُ الثَّرْثَارِ فَعَمَدُوا إِلَى مُخِّ الْحِنْطَةِ فَجَعَلُوهَا خُبْزاً هَجَاءً وَ جَعَلُوا يُنْجُونَ بِهِ صِبْيَانَهُمْ حَتَّى اجْتَمَعَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ جَبَلٌ عَظِيمٌ قَالَ فَمَرَّ بِهِمْ رَجُلٌ صَالِحٌ وَ إِذَا امْرَأَةٌ وَ هِيَ تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِصَبِيٍّ لَهَا فَقَالَ لَهُمْ وَيْحَكُمْ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ لَا تُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِكُمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ كَأَنَّكَ تُخَوِّفُنَا بِالْجُوعِ أَمَّا مَا دَامَ ثَرْثَارُنَا تَجْرِي فَإِنَّا لَا نَخَافُ الْجُوعَ قَالَ فَأَسِفَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَأَضْعَفَ لَهُمُ الثَّرْثَارَ وَ حَبَسَ عَنْهُمْ قَطْرَ السَّمَاءِ وَ نَبَاتَ الْأَرْضِ قَالَ فَاحْتَاجُوا إِلَى ذَلِكَ الْجَبَلِ وَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُقْسَمُ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْمِيزَانِ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin Sadaqa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Honour the bread, for it has been worked upon by what is between the Throne and the earth and what is from the numerous of its people’. Then he<sup>saww</sup> said to the ones around him<sup>saww</sup>: ‘Shall I<sup>saww</sup> inform you all?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, may the fathers and the mothers be sacrificed for you<sup>saww</sup>’. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There was a Prophet<sup>as</sup> among the ones who were before you all, called Dainel<sup>as</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> gave the owner of the crossing a bread in order to cross with it. So the owner of the crossing threw down the bread and said, ‘What do I do with this bread. The bread is with us’, and he trampled it with the leg. So when Daniel<sup>as</sup> saw that from him, he<sup>as</sup> raised his<sup>as</sup> hands towards the sky, then said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Honour the bread, for You<sup>azwj</sup> have Seen, O Lord<sup>azwj</sup> what this servant has done and what he said’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto the sky that it withholds the rain, and Revealed unto the earth that it become layers like the pottery. So it did not rain to the extent that their affairs reached such that some of them ate each other. So when (the situation) reached what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Intended from that, a woman said to another, and for both of them were parents, ‘O so and so, come, let I and you both, eat my parents today, and when it is tomorrow, we both eat your parents’. So she said to her, ‘Yes’. So they ate them. So when she came over afterwards the other enticing to eat her parents, she prevented her, and she said, ‘Between me and you is a Prophet<sup>as</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So they both brought their dispute to Daniel<sup>as</sup>. So he<sup>as</sup> said to them both: ‘And has the matter reached to what I<sup>as</sup> see?’ She said to him<sup>as</sup>, ‘Yes, O Prophet<sup>as</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and even more difficult’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So he<sup>as</sup> raised his<sup>as</sup> hands towards the sky, so he<sup>as</sup> said; ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Return upon us with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Grace, and Grace of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, and do not Punish the children, and the good ones in it, by the sin of the owner of the crossing, and his disrespecting Your<sup>azwj</sup> Bounty’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Commanded the sky that: “Rain for Me<sup>azwj</sup> upon the earth”, and Commanded the earth that “Grow for My<sup>azwj</sup> Creatures, so Give them from your goodness, for I<sup>azwj</sup> am being Merciful to them due to the young children’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَكْرِمُوا الْخُبْزَ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ عَمِلَ فِيهِ مَا بَيْنَ الْعَرْشِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَ مَا فِيهَا مِنْ كَثِيرٍ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَ لَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ قَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِدَاكَ الْآبَاءُ وَ الْأُمَّهَاتُ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ نَبِيٌّ فِيمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُ دَانِيَالُ وَ إِنَّهُ أَعْطَى صَاحِبَ مِعْبَرٍ رَغِيفاً لِكَيْ يَعْبُرَ بِهِ فَرَمَى صَاحِبُ الْمِعْبَرِ بِالرَّغِيفِ وَ قَالَ مَا أَصْنَعُ بِالْخُبْزِ هَذَا الْخُبْزُ عِنْدَنَا قَدْ يُدَاسُ بِالْأَرْجُلِ فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ دَانِيَالُ رَفَعَ يَدَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أَكْرِمِ الْخُبْزَ فَقَدْ رَأَيْتَ يَا رَبِّ مَا صَنَعَ هَذَا الْعَبْدُ وَ مَا قَالَ قَالَ فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ أَنْ تَحْبِسَ الْغَيْثَ وَ أَوْحَى إِلَى الْأَرْضِ أَنْ كُونِي طَبَقاً كَالْفَخَّارِ قَالَ فَلَمْ يُمْطَرُوا حَتَّى أَنَّهُ بَلَغَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ أَنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ أَكَلَ بَعْضاً فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مِنْهُمْ مَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ لِأُخْرَى وَ لَهُمَا وَلَدَانِ يَا فُلَانَةُ تَعَالِي حَتَّى نَأْكُلَ أَنَا وَ أَنْتِ الْيَوْمَ وَلَدِي وَ إِذَا كَانَ غَداً أَكَلْنَا وَلَدَكِ قَالَتْ لَهَا نَعَمْ فَأَكَلَتَاهُ فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاعَتَا مِنْ بَعْدُ رَاوَدَتِ الْأُخْرَى عَلَى أَكْلِ وَلَدِهَا فَامْتَنَعَتْ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَتْ لَهَا بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَكِ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ فَاخْتَصَمَا إِلَى دَانِيَالَ ( عليه السلام ) فَقَالَ لَهُمَا وَ قَدْ بَلَغَ الْأَمْرُ إِلَى مَا أَرَى قَالَتَا لَهُ نَعَمْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ وَ أَشَدَّ قَالَ فَرَفَعَ يَدَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ عُدْ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَ فَضْلِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ لَا تُعَاقِبِ الْأَطْفَالَ وَ مَنْ فِيهِ خَيْرٌ بِذَنْبِ صَاحِبِ الْمِعْبَرِ وَ أَضْرَابِهِ لِنِعْمَتِكَ قَالَ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ السَّمَاءَ أَنْ أَمْطِرِي عَلَى الْأَرْضِ وَ أَمَرَ الْأَرْضَ أَنْ أَنْبِتِي لِخَلْقِي مَا قَدْ فَاتَهُمْ مِنْ خَيْرِكَ فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَحِمْتُهُمْ بِالطِّفْلِ الصَّغِيرِ .

citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Al Maysami, from Aban Bin Taghlub who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not place the bread beneath the bowl’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/120)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Bin Al Sayyari, from Ali Bin Asbad, from one of his companions who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Honour the bread’. It was said, ‘And what is its honouring?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it is placed, so do not wait with it for something else’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَكْرِمُوا الْخُبْزَ قِيلَ وَ مَا إِكْرَامُهُ قَالَ إِذَا وُضِعَ لَا يُنْتَظَرُ بِهِ غَيْرُهُ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Bin Al Sayyari, from Ali Bin Asbad, from one of his companions who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Honour the bread’. It was said, ‘And what is its honouring?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it is placed, so do not wait with it for something else’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/120)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Talha Bin Zayd, from one of our companions who said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Honour the bread!’ So it was said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! What is its honouring?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When it is placed, do not wait with it for something else’. And Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘And from its honouring is that it should neither be trodden upon nor cut (into pieces before it is placed)’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَكْرِمُوا الْخُبْزَ فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَ مَا إِكْرَامُهُ قَالَ إِذَا وُضِعَ لَمْ يُنْتَظَرْ بِهِ غَيْرُهُ وَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ مِنْ كَرَامَتِهِ أَنْ لَا يُوطَأَ وَ لَا يُقْطَعَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Talha Bin Zayd, from one of our companions who said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Honour the bread!’ So it was said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! What is its honouring?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When it is placed, do not wait with it for something else’. And Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘And from its honouring is that it should neither be trodden upon nor cut (into pieces before it is placed)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع وآخره مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/121)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Beware of smelling the bread just as you smell the wild animals smell it, for the bread is Blessed. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has Commanded the sky for it for torrential downpour, and for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Grown the meadows, and by it you are Praying, and by it you are Fasting, and by it you are performing the Hajj of the House of your Lord<sup>azwj</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِيَّاكُمْ أَنْ تَشَمُّوا الْخُبْزَ كَمَا تَشَمُّهُ السِّبَاعُ فَإِنَّ الْخُبْزَ مُبَارَكٌ أَرْسَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُ السَّمَاءَ مِدْرَاراً وَ لَهُ أَنْبَتَ اللَّهُ الْمَرْعَى وَ بِهِ صَلَّيْتُمْ وَ بِهِ صُمْتُمْ وَ بِهِ حَجَجْتُمْ بَيْتَ رَبِّكُمْ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Beware of smelling the bread just as you smell the wild animals smell it, for the bread is Blessed. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has Commanded the sky for it for torrential downpour, and for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Grown the meadows, and by it you are Praying, and by it you are Fasting, and by it you are performing the Hajj of the House of your Lord<sup>azwj</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/121)

text: And by this chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When you are brought the bread and the meat, so begin with the bread, so close by it the emptiness of the hunger, then eat the meat’.

citation.arabic_text: وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا أُوتِيتُمْ بِالْخُبْزِ وَ اللَّحْمِ فَابْدَءُوا بِالْخُبْزِ فَسُدُّوا بِهِ خِلَالَ الْجُوعِ ثُمَّ كُلُوا اللَّحْمَ .
citation.translation: And by this chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘When you are brought the bread and the meat, so begin with the bread, so close by it the emptiness of the hunger, then eat the meat’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/121)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yaqoub Bin Yaqteen who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Make your bread as small, for with each loaf is a Blessing’. And Yaqoub Bin Yaqteen (the narrator) said, ‘I saw Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, meaning Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, breaking the bread upwards’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) صَغِّرُوا رُغْفَانَكُمْ فَإِنَّ مَعَ كُلِّ رَغِيفٍ بَرَكَةً وَ قَالَ يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ يَقْطِينٍ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ يَعْنِي الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) يَكْسِرُ الرَّغِيفَ إِلَى فَوْقُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yaqoub Bin Yaqteen who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Make your bread as small, for with each loaf is a Blessing’. And Yaqoub Bin Yaqteen (the narrator) said, ‘I saw Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, meaning Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, breaking the bread upwards’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/121)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Sayyari, from Abu Ali Bin Rashid, (It has been narrated) raising it from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, whenever he<sup>asws</sup> did not have a sauce for him<sup>asws</sup>, cut the bread with the knife’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ أُدْمٌ قَطَعَ الْخُبْزَ بِالسِّكِّينِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Sayyari, from Abu Ali Bin Rashid, (It has been narrated) raising it from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, whenever he<sup>asws</sup> did not have a sauce for him<sup>asws</sup>, cut the bread with the knife’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/121)

text: Al Sayyari, (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The lowest of the sauce is to cut the bread with the knife’.

citation.arabic_text: السَّيَّارِيُّ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ أَدْنَى الْأُدْمِ قَطْعُ الْخُبْزِ بِالسِّكِّينِ .
citation.translation: Al Sayyari, (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The lowest of the sauce is to cut the bread with the knife’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/122)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, and someone else, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Fazl Al Nowfaly, from Al Fazl Bin Yunus who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> had lunch with me, so I came with a bowl and beneath it was bread. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Honour the bread, that it should not happen to be under it’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Instruct the slave that he takes out the bread from beneath the bowl’.

citation.arabic_text: تَغَدَّى عِنْدِي أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) فَجِي‏ءَ بِقَصْعَةٍ وَ تَحْتَهَا خُبْزٌ فَقَالَ أَكْرِمُوا الْخُبْزَ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ تَحْتَهَا وَ قَالَ لِي مُرِ الْغُلَامَ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ الرَّغِيفَ مِنْ تَحْتِ الْقَصْعَةِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, and someone else, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Fazl Al Nowfaly, from Al Fazl Bin Yunus who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> had lunch with me, so I came with a bowl and beneath it was bread. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Honour the bread, that it should not happen to be under it’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Instruct the slave that he takes out the bread from beneath the bowl’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: كالموثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/122)

text: Ahmad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Maysami, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having disliked that the bread be placed under the bowl’.

citation.arabic_text: أَنَّهُ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُوضَعَ الرَّغِيفُ تَحْتَ الْقَصْعَةِ.
citation.translation: Ahmad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Maysami, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having disliked that the bread be placed under the bowl’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: كالموثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/122)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Idrees Bin Yusuf, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘do not cut the bread with the knife, but break it with the hand, and let your breaking be opposite to that of the non-Arabs’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) لَا تَقْطَعُوا الْخُبْزَ بِالسِّكِّينِ وَ لَكِنِ اكْسِرُوهُ بِالْيَدِ وَ لْيُكْسَرْ لَكُمْ خَالِفُوا الْعَجَمَ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Idrees Bin Yusuf, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘do not cut the bread with the knife, but break it with the hand, and let your breaking be opposite to that of the non-Arabs’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/122)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Do not cut the bread with the knife, but cut it by the hand, and oppose the non-Arabs’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا تَقْطَعُوا الْخُبْزَ بِالسِّكِّينِ وَ لَكِنِ اكْسِرُوهُ بِالْيَدِ وَ خَالِفُوا الْعَجَمَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Do not cut the bread with the knife, but cut it by the hand, and oppose the non-Arabs’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/122)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, form Muhammad Bin Isa, form Yunus, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The merit of the barley bread upon the wheat is like our<sup>asws</sup> merit over the people, and there is none from a Prophet<sup>as</sup> except that he<sup>as</sup> for the eating of the barley, and Blessed upon it, and it does not enter the inside except it throws out every illness in it, and it is a livelihood of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>, and food of the righteous. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the High Refused to Make the livelihood of the Prophets<sup>as</sup> to be (anything) except for barley’.

citation.arabic_text: فَضْلُ خُبْزِ الشَّعِيرِ عَلَى الْبُرِّ كَفَضْلِنَا عَلَى النَّاسِ وَ مَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ دَعَا لِأَكْلِ الشَّعِيرِ وَ بَارَكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ مَا دَخَلَ جَوْفاً إِلَّا وَ أَخْرَجَ كُلَّ دَاءٍ فِيهِ وَ هُوَ قُوتُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَ طَعَامُ الْأَبْرَارِ أَبَى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنْ يَجْعَلَ قُوتَ أَنْبِيَائِهِ إِلَّا شَعِيراً .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, form Muhammad Bin Isa, form Yunus, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The merit of the barley bread upon the wheat is like our<sup>asws</sup> merit over the people, and there is none from a Prophet<sup>as</sup> except that he<sup>as</sup> for the eating of the barley, and Blessed upon it, and it does not enter the inside except it throws out every illness in it, and it is a livelihood of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>, and food of the righteous. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the High Refused to Make the livelihood of the Prophets<sup>as</sup> to be (anything) except for barley’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/123)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, form Yunus, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There does not enter the inside of the (sufferer of) tuberculosis, anything more beneficial for him than the rice bread’.

citation.arabic_text: مَا دَخَلَ جَوْفَ الْمَسْلُولِ شَيْ‏ءٌ أَنْفَعُ لَهُ مِنْ خُبْزِ الْأَرُزِّ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, form Yunus, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There does not enter the inside of the (sufferer of) tuberculosis, anything more beneficial for him than the rice bread’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/123)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Musa, from Al Khashaab, form Ali Bin Hassan, from one of our companions who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Feed the rice bread to the (sufferer of) stomach ailments, for there does not enter the inside of the (sufferer of) stomach ailments anything more beneficial to him than it; at the same time it repairs the stomach and pulls out the illness of tuberculosis’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَطْعِمُوا الْمَبْطُونَ خُبْزَ الْأَرُزِّ فَمَا دَخَلَ جَوْفَ الْمَبْطُونِ شَيْ‏ءٌ أَنْفَعُ مِنْهُ أَمَا إِنَّهُ يَدْبُغُ الْمَعِدَةَ وَ يَسُلُّ الدَّاءَ سَلًّا .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Musa, from Al Khashaab, form Ali Bin Hassan, from one of our companions who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Feed the rice bread to the (sufferer of) stomach ailments, for there does not enter the inside of the (sufferer of) stomach ailments anything more beneficial to him than it; at the same time it repairs the stomach and pulls out the illness of tuberculosis’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/123)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Sayyari, from Yahya Bin Abu Rafi’a, and someone else, (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Nothing from the early morning meal remains inside up to the night, except for the rice bread’.

citation.arabic_text: لَيْسَ يَبْقَى فِي الْجَوْفِ مِنْ غُدْوَةٍ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ إِلَّا خُبْزُ الْأَرُزِّ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Sayyari, from Yahya Bin Abu Rafi’a, and someone else, (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Nothing from the early morning meal remains inside up to the night, except for the rice bread’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/123)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Hamman, form Suleyman Al Ja’fary, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The best sustenance is Al-Suweyq; if you were hungry it stays, and if you were satiated, it would digest the food’.

citation.arabic_text: نِعْمَ الْقُوتُ السَّوِيقُ إِنْ كُنْتَ جَائِعاً أَمْسَكَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ شَبْعَاناً [شَبْعَانَ] هَضَمَ طَعَامَكَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Hamman, form Suleyman Al Ja’fary, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The best sustenance is Al-Suweyq; if you were hungry it stays, and if you were satiated, it would digest the food’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/124)

text: Muhamad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah Bin Jundab, from one of our companions who said, ‘Al-Suweyq was mentioned in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather it was prepared by the Revelation’.

citation.arabic_text: ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) السَّوِيقُ فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا عُمِلَ بِالْوَحْيِ .
citation.translation: Muhamad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah Bin Jundab, from one of our companions who said, ‘Al-Suweyq was mentioned in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather it was prepared by the Revelation’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/124)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Al-Suweyq builds the flesh and strengthens the bones’.

citation.arabic_text: السَّوِيقُ يُنْبِتُ اللَّحْمَ وَ يَشُدُّ الْعَظْمَ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Al-Suweyq builds the flesh and strengthens the bones’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/124)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Usman Bin Isa, from Khalid Bin Najeeh, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Al-Suweyq is a meal of the Mursil Prophets<sup>as</sup>’, or said: ‘The Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: السَّوِيقُ طَعَامُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ أَوْ قَالَ النَّبِيِّينَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Usman Bin Isa, from Khalid Bin Najeeh, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Al-Suweyq is a meal of the Mursil Prophets<sup>as</sup>’, or said: ‘The Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/124)

text: From him, from a number of our companions, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Sayaba, from Jundab Bin Abdullah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘But rather, Al-Suweyq was Revealed by the Revelation from the sky’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا أُنْزِلَ السَّوِيقُ بِالْوَحْيِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ .
citation.translation: From him, from a number of our companions, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Sayaba, from Jundab Bin Abdullah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘But rather, Al-Suweyq was Revealed by the Revelation from the sky’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/124)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The dry Al-Suweyq does away with the whiteness (vitiligo?)’.

citation.arabic_text: السَّوِيقُ الْجَافُّ يَذْهَبُ بِالْبَيَاضِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The dry Al-Suweyq does away with the whiteness (vitiligo?)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/125)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, and someone else, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ubeydullah Bin Abdullah Al Dahqan, from Dorost Bin Abu Mansour, from Abdullah Bin Muskan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Drinking Al-Suweyq with the oil builds the flesh and strengthens the bones, and softens the skin, and increases in the sexual desire’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ شُرْبُ السَّوِيقِ بِالزَّيْتِ يُنْبِتُ اللَّحْمَ وَ يَشُدُّ الْعَظْمَ وَ يُرِقُّ الْبَشَرَةَ وَ يَزِيدُ فِي الْبَاهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, and someone else, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ubeydullah Bin Abdullah Al Dahqan, from Dorost Bin Abu Mansour, from Abdullah Bin Muskan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Drinking Al-Suweyq with the oil builds the flesh and strengthens the bones, and softens the skin, and increases in the sexual desire’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/125)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Quteyba Al A’ash, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Three handfuls of dry Suweyq upon the empty stomach dries the phlegm, and the bile until it almost leaves nothing’.

citation.arabic_text: ثَلَاثُ رَاحَاتِ سَوِيقٍ جَافٍّ عَلَى الرِّيقِ يُنَشِّفُ الْبَلْغَمَ وَ الْمِرَّةَ حَتَّى لَا يَكَادَ يَدَعُ شَيْئاً .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Quteyba Al A’ash, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Three handfuls of dry Suweyq upon the empty stomach dries the phlegm, and the bile until it almost leaves nothing’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/125)

text: From him, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Nazar Bin Qirwash who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Al-Maazy<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) said: ‘When Al-Suweyq is washed even times, and transferred from a vessel to another vessel, so it does away with the fever and the strength comes to the two legs and the two feet’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْمَاضِي ( عليه السلام ) السَّوِيقُ إِذَا غَسَلْتَهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ وَ قَلَّبْتَهُ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ إِلَى إِنَاءٍ آخَرَ فَهُوَ يَذْهَبُ بِالْحُمَّى وَ يُنْزِلُ الْقُوَّةَ فِي السَّاقَيْنِ وَ الْقَدَمَيْنِ .
citation.translation: From him, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Nazar Bin Qirwash who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Al-Maazy<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) said: ‘When Al-Suweyq is washed even times, and transferred from a vessel to another vessel, so it does away with the fever and the strength comes to the two legs and the two feet’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/125)

text: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammad Bin Usman, and Muhammad Bin Sowqat, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Al-Suweyq digests the crusts’.

citation.arabic_text: السَّوِيقُ يَهْضِمُ الرُّءُوسَ .
citation.translation: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammad Bin Usman, and Muhammad Bin Sowqat, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Al-Suweyq digests the crusts’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/125)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Yahya Bin Masour, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Al-Suweyq gets rid of the bile and the phlegm from the stomach with a stripping, and repels seventy types from the types of the afflictions’.

citation.arabic_text: السَّوِيقُ يَجْرُدُ الْمِرَّةَ وَ الْبَلْغَمَ مِنَ الْمَعِدَةِ جَرْداً وَ يَدْفَعُ سَبْعِينَ نَوْعاً مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الْبَلَاءِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Yahya Bin Masour, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Al-Suweyq gets rid of the bile and the phlegm from the stomach with a stripping, and repels seventy types from the types of the afflictions’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/125)

text: From him, from his father, from Abu Abdullah Al Barqy, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, from Khasheyma who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who drinks Al-Suweyq for forty mornings, his shoulders would be filled with strength’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَنْ شَرِبَ السَّوِيقَ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحاً امْتَلَأَ كَتِفَاهُ قُوَّةً .
citation.translation: From him, from his father, from Abu Abdullah Al Barqy, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, from Khasheyma who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who drinks Al-Suweyq for forty mornings, his shoulders would be filled with strength’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/126)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Musa Bin Al Hassan, from Al Sayyari, from Ubeydullah Bin Abu Abdullah having said: ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> wrote from Khurasan to Al-Medina: ‘Do not let Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup> to drink Al-Suweyq with the sugar, for it is a destruction for the men’.

citation.arabic_text: كَتَبَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) مِنْ خُرَاسَانَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَا تَسْقُوا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِيَ السَّوِيقَ بِالسُّكَّرِ فَإِنَّهُ رَدِيٌّ لِلرِّجَالِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Musa Bin Al Hassan, from Al Sayyari, from Ubeydullah Bin Abu Abdullah having said: ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> wrote from Khurasan to Al-Medina: ‘Do not let Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup> to drink Al-Suweyq with the sugar, for it is a destruction for the men’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/126)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Sayf, from Sayf Al Tammar who said, ‘One of our friends fell sick at Makkah, and hallucinated. So I went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and let him<sup>asws</sup> know. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Make him drink the Al-Suweyq of barley so he would be healthy, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing; and it is a nourishment in the inside of the sick’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So we did not make him drink Al-Suweyq except for two days only’ (or said ‘twice’) until he our companion was healthy’.

citation.arabic_text: مَرِضَ بَعْضُ رُفَقَائِنَا بِمَكَّةَ وَ بُرْسِمَ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَأَعْلَمْتُهُ فَقَالَ لِي اسْقِهِ سَوِيقَ الشَّعِيرِ فَإِنَّهُ يُعَافِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَ هُوَ غِذَاءٌ فِي جَوْفِ الْمَرِيضِ قَالَ فَمَا سَقَيْنَاهُ السَّوِيقَ إِلَّا يَوْمَيْنِ أَوْ قَالَ مَرَّتَيْنِ حَتَّى عُوفِيَ صَاحِبُنَا .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Sayf, from Sayf Al Tammar who said, ‘One of our friends fell sick at Makkah, and hallucinated. So I went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and let him<sup>asws</sup> know. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Make him drink the Al-Suweyq of barley so he would be healthy, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing; and it is a nourishment in the inside of the sick’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So we did not make him drink Al-Suweyq except for two days only’ (or said ‘twice’) until he our companion was healthy’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/126)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Musa, raising it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Suweyq of the lentils cuts the thirst, and strengthens the stomach, and in it is a healing from seventy illnesses, and it extinguishes the yellowness and is a coolness for the interior; and it was that whenever he<sup>asws</sup> travelled, did not separate from it, and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Whenever someone’s blood of modesty got agitated, he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘Drink the Suweyq of lentils, for it would settle the agitation of the blood and extinguish the heat’.

citation.arabic_text: سَوِيقُ الْعَدَسِ يَقْطَعُ الْعَطَشَ وَ يُقَوِّي الْمَعِدَةَ وَ فِيهِ شِفَاءٌ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ دَاءً وَ يُطْفِئُ الصَّفْرَاءَ وَ يُبَرِّدُ الْجَوْفَ وَ كَانَ إِذَا سَافَرَ ( عليه السلام ) لَا يُفَارِقُهُ وَ كَانَ يَقُولُ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا هَاجَ الدَّمُ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ حَشَمِهِ قَالَ لَهُ اشْرَبْ مِنْ سَوِيقِ الْعَدَسِ فَإِنَّهُ يُسَكِّنُ هَيَجَانَ الدَّمِ وَ يُطْفِئُ الْحَرَارَةَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Musa, raising it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Suweyq of the lentils cuts the thirst, and strengthens the stomach, and in it is a healing from seventy illnesses, and it extinguishes the yellowness and is a coolness for the interior; and it was that whenever he<sup>asws</sup> travelled, did not separate from it, and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Whenever someone’s blood of modesty got agitated, he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘Drink the Suweyq of lentils, for it would settle the agitation of the blood and extinguish the heat’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/126)

text: And from him, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Mahziyar who said, ‘A slave girls of our was hit by the menstruation, and it would not get cut-off from her until she came near the death. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> ordered that she should be made to drink the Suweyq of lentils. So she was made to drink it, so it got cut-off from her, and she recovered’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ جَارِيَةً لَنَا أَصَابَهَا الْحَيْضُ وَ كَانَ لَا يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهَا حَتَّى أَشْرَفَتْ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ فَأَمَرَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) أَنْ تُسْقَى سَوِيقَ الْعَدَسِ فَسُقِيَتْ فَانْقَطَعَ عَنْهَا وَ عُوفِيَتْ .
citation.translation: And from him, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Mahziyar who said, ‘A slave girls of our was hit by the menstruation, and it would not get cut-off from her until she came near the death. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> ordered that she should be made to drink the Suweyq of lentils. So she was made to drink it, so it got cut-off from her, and she recovered’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/127)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Sayyari, from Ibrahim Bin Bustan, form a man from the people of Marv who said, ‘Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> sent a messenger and he<sup>asws</sup> was seeking Al-Suweyq which was with us. So we sent it over to him<sup>asws</sup> a mixture of Suweyq. So he<sup>asws</sup> returned it and sent a message to us that Al-Suweyq, when it is drunk upon the empty stomach, and it is dry, it extinguished the heat and settles the bile; and when it is mixed, it does not do that’.

citation.arabic_text: بَعَثَ إِلَيْنَا الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) وَ هُوَ عِنْدَنَا يَطْلُبُ السَّوِيقَ فَبَعَثْنَا إِلَيْهِ بِسَوِيقٍ مَلْتُوتٍ فَرَدَّهُ وَ بَعَثَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّ السَّوِيقَ إِذَا شُرِبَ عَلَى الرِّيقِ وَ هُوَ جَافٌّ أَطْفَأَ الْحَرَارَةَ وَ سَكَّنَ الْمِرَّةَ وَ إِذَا لُتَّ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Sayyari, from Ibrahim Bin Bustan, form a man from the people of Marv who said, ‘Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> sent a messenger and he<sup>asws</sup> was seeking Al-Suweyq which was with us. So we sent it over to him<sup>asws</sup> a mixture of Suweyq. So he<sup>asws</sup> returned it and sent a message to us that Al-Suweyq, when it is drunk upon the empty stomach, and it is dry, it extinguished the heat and settles the bile; and when it is mixed, it does not do that’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/127)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the chief of the sauces (cooked food) in the world and the Hereafter, so heasws said: ‘The meat (sauce). Have you not heard the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [56:21] And the flesh of fowl such as they would be desiring’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ سَيِّدِ الْآدَامِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ فَقَالَ اللَّحْمُ أَ مَا سَمِعْتَ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ لَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the chief of the sauces (cooked food) in the world and the Hereafter, so heasws said: ‘The meat (sauce). Have you not heard the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [56:21] And the flesh of fowl such as they would be desiring’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/127)

text: Ali Bin Muhamad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Isa Bin Abdullah Al Alawy, from his father, from his grandfather, (It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The meat is the chief of the foods in the world and the Hereafter’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) اللَّحْمُ سَيِّدُ الطَّعَامِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhamad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Isa Bin Abdullah Al Alawy, from his father, from his grandfather, (It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The meat is the chief of the foods in the world and the Hereafter’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/127)

text: And from him, from Ali Bin Al Rayyan, (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The chief of the sauces of the Paradise is the meat (sauce)’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) سَيِّدُ آدَامِ الْجَنَّةِ اللَّحْمُ .
citation.translation: And from him, from Ali Bin Al Rayyan, (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The chief of the sauces of the Paradise is the meat (sauce)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/128)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The chief of the foods is the meat’.

citation.arabic_text: سَيِّدُ الطَّعَامِ اللَّحْمُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The chief of the foods is the meat’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/128)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, and someone else, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yusuf, from Zakariyya Bin Muhammad Al Azdy, from Abdul A’ala, a slave of the progeny of Saam who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘We are reported to in our presence from Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> having said that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Hates the house of the meat’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They are lying! But rather Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The house in which the people are backbiting and eating their (brothers’) meats, and my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was meat-loving , and he<sup>asws</sup> passed away, (and on) the day he<sup>asws</sup> passed away in a sleeve of a mother of his<sup>asws</sup> child were thirty Dirhams for (buying) the meat’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّا نُرْوَى عِنْدَنَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى يُبْغِضُ الْبَيْتَ اللَّحِمَ فَقَالَ ( عليه السلام ) كَذَبُوا إِنَّمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) الْبَيْتَ الَّذِي يَغْتَابُونَ فِيهِ النَّاسَ وَ يَأْكُلُونَ لُحُومَهُمْ وَ قَدْ كَانَ أَبِي ( عليه السلام ) لَحِماً وَ لَقَدْ مَاتَ يَوْمَ مَاتَ وَ فِي كُمِّ أُمِّ وَلَدِهِ ثَلَاثُونَ دِرْهَماً لِلَّحْمِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, and someone else, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yusuf, from Zakariyya Bin Muhammad Al Azdy, from Abdul A’ala, a slave of the progeny of Saam who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘We are reported to in our presence from Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> having said that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Hates the house of the meat’. citation.arabic_text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) لَحِماً يُحِبُّ اللَّحْمَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was meat-lover, he<sup>saww</sup> loved the meat’.

citation.arabic_text: تَرَكَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) ثَلَاثِينَ دِرْهَماً لِلَّحْمِ يَوْمَ تُوُفِّيَ وَ كَانَ رَجُلًا لَحِماً .

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِنَّا مَعَاشِرَ قُرَيْشٍ قَوْمٌ لَحِمُونَ .

citation.arabic_text: اللَّحْمُ يُنْبِتُ اللَّحْمَ وَ مَنْ تَرَكَ اللَّحْمَ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْماً سَاءَ خُلُقُهُ وَ مَنْ سَاءَ خُلُقُهُ فَأَذِّنُوا فِي أُذُنِهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The meat builds the meat, and the one who neglects (eating) the meat for forty days, his mannerisms would worsen, therefore recite the Azaan in his ears’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/129)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Al Husayn Bin Khalid who said, ‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> that, ‘The people are saying that the one who does not eat the meat for thirty days, his mannerisms would worsen’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They are lying, but the one who does not eat the meat for forty days, his mannerisms would change, and his body (as well), and that is the transference of the seed in a measurement of forty days’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ مَنْ لَمْ يَأْكُلِ اللَّحْمَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ سَاءَ خُلُقُهُ فَقَالَ كَذَبُوا وَ لَكِنْ مَنْ لَمْ يَأْكُلِ اللَّحْمَ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْماً تَغَيَّرَ خُلُقُهُ وَ بَدَنُهُ وَ ذَلِكَ لِانْتِقَالِ النُّطْفَةِ فِي مِقْدَارِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْماً .
