text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Gayas Bin Ibrahim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Neither drink the water from a notch of the vessel, nor from its handle, for the Satan<sup>la</sup> sits upon the handle and the notch’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) لَا تَشْرَبُوا الْمَاءَ مِنْ ثُلْمَةِ الْإِنَاءِ وَ لَا مِنْ عُرْوَتِهِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَقْعُدُ عَلَى الْعُرْوَةِ وَ الثُّلْمَةِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Gayas Bin Ibrahim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Neither drink the water from a notch of the vessel, nor from its handle, for the Satan<sup>la</sup> sits upon the handle and the notch’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/236)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Hashim, from Salim Bin Mukram, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> said to Umar Bin Ubeyd and Bashir Al-Rahhal and Wasil in a Hadeeth: ‘Neither drink from the ear of the pitcher, nor from its crack if there was one in it, for it is a drinking place of the Satans<sup>la</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبِي لِعَمْرِو بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ وَ بَشِيرٍ الرَّحَّالِ وَ وَاصِلٍ فِي حَدِيثٍ وَ لَا يُشْرَبُ مِنْ أُذُنِ الْكُوزِ وَ لَا مِنْ كَسْرِهِ إِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ فَإِنَّهُ مَشْرَبُ الشَّيَاطِينِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Hashim, from Salim Bin Mukram, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> said to Umar Bin Ubeyd and Bashir Al-Rahhal and Wasil in a Hadeeth: ‘Neither drink from the ear of the pitcher, nor from its crack if there was one in it, for it is a drinking place of the Satans<sup>la</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مختلف فيه - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/236)

text: A number of our companions, for Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> passed by a group of people who were drinking the water by their mouths during the military expedition of Tabuk. So he<sup>saww</sup> said to them: ‘Drink with your hands, for these are the best of your utensils’.

citation.arabic_text: مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) بِقَوْمٍ يَشْرَبُونَ الْمَاءَ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ فَقَالَ لَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) اشْرَبُوا بِأَيْدِيكُمْ فَإِنَّهَا خَيْرُ أَوَانِيكُمْ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, for Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> passed by a group of people who were drinking the water by their mouths during the military expedition of Tabuk. So he<sup>saww</sup> said to them: ‘Drink with your hands, for these are the best of your utensils’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/236)

text: Muhammad Bin Yaya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibrahim, from Talha Bin Zayd, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> liked drinking in the Syrian vessel, and he<sup>saww</sup> was saying: ‘It is the best of your vessels’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) يُعْجِبُهُ أَنْ يَشْرَبَ فِي الْإِنَاءِ الشَّامِيِّ وَ كَانَ يَقُولُ هُوَ أَنْظَفُ آنِيَتِكُمْ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yaya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibrahim, from Talha Bin Zayd, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> liked drinking in the Syrian vessel, and he<sup>saww</sup> was saying: ‘It is the best of your vessels’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/236)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, altogether from Ali Bin Asbaat, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying, and Egypt was mentioned, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Neither eat in its pottery, nor wash your heads with its clay, for it would remove the honour and inherit the actions of a pimp’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ وَ ذَكَرَ مِصْرَ فَقَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) لَا تَأْكُلُوا فِي فَخَّارِهَا وَ لَا تَغْسِلُوا رُءُوسَكُمْ بِطِينِهَا فَإِنَّهُ يَذْهَبُ بِالْغَيْرَةِ وَ يُورِثُ الدِّيَاثَةَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, altogether from Ali Bin Asbaat, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying, and Egypt was mentioned, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Neither eat in its pottery, nor wash your heads with its clay, for it would remove the honour and inherit the actions of a pimp’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن أو موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/236)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Zazam used to be more intensely whiter than the milk, and sweeter than the honey, and it burst its banks and it boasted about it, so it was came upon by the (other) waters. So Allahazwj Majestic and Mighty Resented it and Caused a spring of aloe to flow over it’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَتْ زَمْزَمُ أَشَدَّ بَيَاضاً مِنَ اللَّبَنِ وَ أَحْلَى مِنَ الشَّهْدِ وَ كَانَتْ سَائِحَةً فَبَغَتْ عَلَى الْأَمْيَاهِ فَأَغَارَهَا اللَّهُ جَلَّ وَ عَزَّ وَ أَجْرَى عَلَيْهَا عَيْناً مِنْ صَبِرٍ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Zazam used to be more intensely whiter than the milk, and sweeter than the honey, and it burst its banks and it boasted about it, so it was came upon by the (other) waters. So Allahazwj Majestic and Mighty Resented it and Caused a spring of aloe to flow over it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/237)

text: And by his chain, said, ‘Zazam was mentioned in the presence of Abu Abdullahasws, so heasws said: ‘A spring was Caused to flow to it from beneath the (Black) Stone, so when the water of the spring overwhelms, water of Zazam sweetens’.

citation.arabic_text: وَ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ ذُكِرَتْ زَمْزَمُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَقَالَ أُجْرِيَ إِلَيْهَا عَيْنٌ مِنْ تَحْتِ الْحِجْرِ فَإِذَا غَلَبَ مَاءُ الْعَيْنِ عَذُبَ مَاءُ زَمْزَمَ .
citation.translation: And by his chain, said, ‘Zazam was mentioned in the presence of Abu Abdullahasws, so heasws said: ‘A spring was Caused to flow to it from beneath the (Black) Stone, so when the water of the spring overwhelms, water of Zazam sweetens’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/237)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The water of Zamzam is the best water upon the surface of the earth, and the most evil water upon the face of the earth is water of Barhout which is at Hazramowt (near Yemem), receiving a significant number of Infidels at night’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) مَاءُ زَمْزَمَ خَيْرُ مَاءٍ عَلَى وَجْهِ الْأَرْضِ وَ شَرُّ مَاءٍ عَلَى وَجْهِ الْأَرْضِ مَاءُ بَرَهُوتَ الَّذِي بِحَضْرَمَوْتَ تَرِدُهُ هَامُ الْكُفَّارِ بِاللَّيْلِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The water of Zamzam is the best water upon the surface of the earth, and the most evil water upon the face of the earth is water of Barhout which is at Hazramowt (near Yemem), receiving a significant number of Infidels at night’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/237)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ismail Bin Jabir who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Water of Zamzam is a healing from every illness’, and I think heasws said: ‘Whatever it may be’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ مَاءُ زَمْزَمَ شِفَاءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ وَ أَظُنُّهُ قَالَ كَائِناً مَا كَانَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ismail Bin Jabir who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Water of Zamzam is a healing from every illness’, and I think heasws said: ‘Whatever it may be’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/238)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Water of Zamzam is a medication from whatever it is drunk for’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَاءُ زَمْزَمَ دَوَاءٌ مِمَّا شُرِبَ لَهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Water of Zamzam is a medication from whatever it is drunk for’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/238)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far, and someone else, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, altogether, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Musadif who said, ‘A man from our brethren complained at Makkah until he fell for the death. So we met Abu Abdullahasws in the street, so heasws said: ‘O Musadif! What did you do with so and so?’ I said, ‘I left him with the death, may I be sacrificed for youasws’. So heasws said: ‘But had Iasws been in your place, Iasws would have quenched him from the water of the groove (of the Kabah)’. So we sought with everyone, but we did not find it. So whilst we were indulged in that, when a cloud raised itself, so there was thunder and lightning and it rained. So I went over to someone in the Masjid, so I gave him one Dirham and took his drinking cup. Then I took from the water of the groove and came up with it and quenched him from it, and I did not go away from his presence until he had drunk Saweyq, and was healthy, and he was cured after that’.

citation.arabic_text: اشْتَكَى رَجُلٌ مِنْ إِخْوَانِنَا بِمَكَّةَ حَتَّى سَقَطَ لِلْمَوْتِ فَلَقِينَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فِي الطَّرِيقِ فَقَالَ يَا مُصَادِفُ مَا فَعَلَ فُلَانٌ قُلْتُ تَرَكْتُهُ بِالْمَوْتِ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ فَقَالَ أَمَا لَوْ كُنْتُ مَكَانَكُمْ لَسَقَيْتُهُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْمِيزَابِ فَطَلَبْنَا عِنْدَ كُلِّ أَحَدٍ فَلَمْ نَجِدْهُ فَبَيْنَا نَحْنُ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا ارْتَفَعَتْ سَحَابَةٌ فَأَرْعَدَتْ وَ أَبْرَقَتْ وَ أَمْطَرَتْ فَجِئْتُ إِلَى بَعْضِ مَنْ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَأَعْطَيْتُهُ دِرْهَماً وَ أَخَذْتُ قَدَحَهُ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْمِيزَابِ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِهِ وَ سَقَيْتُهُ مِنْهُ وَ لَمْ أَبْرَحْ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ حَتَّى شَرِبَ سَوِيقاً وَ صَلَحَ وَ بَرَأَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far, and someone else, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, altogether, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Musadif who said, ‘A man from our brethren complained at Makkah until he fell for the death. So we met Abu Abdullahasws in the street, so heasws said: ‘O Musadif! What did you do with so and so?’ I said, ‘I left him with the death, may I be sacrificed for youasws’. So heasws said: ‘But had Iasws been in your place, Iasws would have quenched him from the water of the groove (of the Kabah)’. So we sought with everyone, but we did not find it. So whilst we were indulged in that, when a cloud raised itself, so there was thunder and lightning and it rained. So I went over to someone in the Masjid, so I gave him one Dirham and took his drinking cup. Then I took from the water of the groove and came up with it and quenched him from it, and I did not go away from his presence until he had drunk Saweyq, and was healthy, and he was cured after that’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/238)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ali Bin Yaqteen, from Amro Bin Ibrahim, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, ‘I hear Abu Ja’farasws saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said regarding the Words of the High [50:9] And We Send down from the sky Blessed water. Heasws said: ‘There is no water in the earth except that there has been mixed with it the water of the sky’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى وَ نَزَّلْنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً مُبارَكاً قَالَ لَيْسَ مِنْ مَاءٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ خَالَطَهُ مَاءُ السَّمَاءِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ali Bin Yaqteen, from Amro Bin Ibrahim, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, ‘I hear Abu Ja’farasws saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said regarding the Words of the High [50:9] And We Send down from the sky Blessed water. Heasws said: ‘There is no water in the earth except that there has been mixed with it the water of the sky’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/239)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Drink water of the sky (rain) for it purifies the body and dispels the diseases. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said [8:11] and Sent down upon you water from the sky that He might thereby Purify you, and Take away from you the uncleanness of the Satan, and that He might Fortify your hearts and Steady (your) footsteps thereby’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) اشْرَبُوا مَاءَ السَّمَاءِ فَإِنَّهُ يُطَهِّرُ الْبَدَنَ وَ يَدْفَعُ الْأَسْقَامَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ يُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ بِهِ وَ يُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطانِ وَ لِيَرْبِطَ عَلى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَ يُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدامَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Drink water of the sky (rain) for it purifies the body and dispels the diseases. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said [8:11] and Sent down upon you water from the sky that He might thereby Purify you, and Take away from you the uncleanness of the Satan, and that He might Fortify your hearts and Steady (your) footsteps thereby’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/239)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Imran Bin Musa, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from his father, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The hail cannot be eaten because Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [13:13] and Afflicts with them whomsoever He so Desires to’.

citation.arabic_text: الْبَرَدُ لَا يُؤْكَلُ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ يُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ يَشاءُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Imran Bin Musa, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from his father, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The hail cannot be eaten because Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [13:13] and Afflicts with them whomsoever He so Desires to’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/239)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, form Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There is no one who is welcomed (newborn) with the water of the Euphrates except that he would love us<sup>asws</sup> the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The people of Al-Kufa do not quench themselves with the water of Euphrates except for a matter’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Therein diffuse two water-spouts from the paradise’.

citation.arabic_text: مَا إِخَالُ أَحَداً يُحَنَّكُ بِمَاءِ الْفُرَاتِ إِلَّا أَحَبَّنَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَ قَالَ ( عليه السلام ) مَا سُقِيَ أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ مَاءَ الْفُرَاتِ إِلَّا لِأَمْرٍ مَا وَ قَالَ يُصَبُّ فِيهِ مِيزَابَانِ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, form Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There is no one who is welcomed (newborn) with the water of the Euphrates except that he would love us<sup>asws</sup> the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The people of Al-Kufa do not quench themselves with the water of Euphrates except for a matter’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Therein diffuse two water-spouts from the paradise’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/240)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There burst into the Euphrates every day, bursts from the (water of) Paradise’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ يُدْفَقُ فِي الْفُرَاتِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ دُفُقَاتٌ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There burst into the Euphrates every day, bursts from the (water of) Paradise’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل كالموثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/240)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, from Ibn Awrama, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, raising it who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This river of yours, meaning the water of Euphrates, two water-spouts pour into it, from the spouts of the Paradise’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Had there (not) been miles between us<sup>asws</sup> and it, we<sup>asws</sup> would have gone to it, and we<sup>asws</sup> would have quenched ourselves by it’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) نَهَرُكُمْ هَذَا يَعْنِي مَاءَ الْفُرَاتِ يَصُبُّ فِيهِ مِيزَابَانِ مِنْ مَيَازِيبِ الْجَنَّةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) لَوْ كَانَ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَهُ أَمْيَالٌ لَأَتَيْنَاهُ وَ نَسْتَسْقِي بِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, from Ibn Awrama, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, raising it who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This river of yours, meaning the water of Euphrates, two water-spouts pour into it, from the spouts of the Paradise’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Had there (not) been miles between us<sup>asws</sup> and it, we<sup>asws</sup> would have gone to it, and we<sup>asws</sup> would have quenched ourselves by it’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, raising it, said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘How much (distance) is there between you and the Euphrates?’ So I informed him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If I<sup>asws</sup> was in its presence, I<sup>asws</sup> would have loved to go to it at two ends of the day’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) كَمْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَ بَيْنَ الْفُرَاتِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ لَوْ كُنْتُ عِنْدَهُ لَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ آتِيَهُ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ .

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, altogether from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’dan, from someone else, (It has been narrated) raising it to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘As for the people of Al-Kufa, had they welcomed their children (newborns) with the water of the Euphrates, they would have been our<sup>asws</sup> Shiah’.

citation.arabic_text: أَمَا إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْكُوفَةِ لَوْ حَنَّكُوا أَوْلَادَهُمْ بِمَاءِ الْفُرَاتِ لَكَانُوا شِيعَةً لَنَا .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, altogether from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’dan, from someone else, (It has been narrated) raising it to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘As for the people of Al-Kufa, had they welcomed their children (newborns) with the water of the Euphrates, they would have been our<sup>asws</sup> Shiah’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/241)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzal, from Hanan Bin Sudeyr, from his father, from Hakeem Bin Jubeyr who said, ‘I heard our Master Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘An Angel descends from the sky during every night, with him being three ounces of musk from the musk of the Paradise, so he casts it in the Euphrates, and there is none from a river in the east of the earth nor in the west of it with a Blessing greater than it’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ سَيِّدَنَا عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِنَّ مَلَكاً يَهْبِطُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مَعَهُ ثَلَاثَةُ مَثَاقِيلَ مِسْكاً مِنْ مِسْكِ الْجَنَّةِ فَيَطْرَحُهَا فِي الْفُرَاتِ وَ مَا مِنْ نَهَرٍ فِي شَرْقِ الْأَرْضِ وَ لَا غَرْبِهَا أَعْظَمَ بَرَكَةً مِنْهُ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzal, from Hanan Bin Sudeyr, from his father, from Hakeem Bin Jubeyr who said, ‘I heard our Master Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘An Angel descends from the sky during every night, with him being three ounces of musk from the musk of the Paradise, so he casts it in the Euphrates, and there is none from a river in the east of the earth nor in the west of it with a Blessing greater than it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/241)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin sadaqa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade from healing by the hot flows, and these are the hot springs in which happen to be in the mountains in which the smell of sulphur is found’, and he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘These are from the mouth of Hell’.

citation.arabic_text: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) عَنِ الِاسْتِشْفَاءِ بِالْحُمَّيَاتِ وَ هِيَ الْعُيُونُ الْحَارَّةُ الَّتِي تَكُونُ فِي الْجِبَالِ الَّتِي تُوجَدُ فِيهَا رَائِحَةُ الْكِبْرِيتِ وَ قِيلَ إِنَّهَا مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin sadaqa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade from healing by the hot flows, and these are the hot springs in which happen to be in the mountains in which the smell of sulphur is found’, and he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘These are from the mouth of Hell’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/241)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When Noah<sup>as</sup> was during the days of the flood, called all the waters. So they all responded except for the sulphuric water, and the bitter water, so he<sup>as</sup> cursed them both’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ نُوحاً ( عليه السلام ) لَمَّا كَانَ فِي أَيَّامِ الطُّوفَانِ دَعَا الْمِيَاهَ كُلَّهَا فَأَجَابَتْهُ إِلَّا مَاءَ الْكِبْرِيتِ وَ الْمَاءَ الْمُرَّ فَلَعَنَهُمَا .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When Noah<sup>as</sup> was during the days of the flood, called all the waters. So they all responded except for the sulphuric water, and the bitter water, so he<sup>as</sup> cursed them both’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/241)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Hamdan Bin Suleyman Al Neyshapouri, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Zakariyya, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, altogether, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abu Al Jaroud, from Abu Saeed Aqeysa Al Taymi who said, ‘I passed by Al-Hassanasws and Al-Husaynasws, and theyasws were both in the Euphrates soaking up to theirasws trousers. So I said to both of themasws, ‘So two sonsasws of Rasool-Allahsaww! Is it upon you twoasws to spoil yourasws trousers?’ So theyasws both said: ‘O Abu Saeed! Spoiling ourasws trousers is more beloved to usasws than spoiling the Religion. For the water, there are its rightful ones, dwellers like the dwellers of the ground’. Then theyasws said: ‘Where are you intending to go to?’ So I said, ‘Into this water’. So theyasws said: ‘And what is (in) this water?’ So I said, ‘I want its medication. I would drink from this bitter hoping that the body would lighten and the belly would be at ease’. So theyasws said: ‘Weasws do not reckon that Allahazwj Majestic and Mighty would Make a healing to be in something which Heazwj has Cursed’. I said, ‘And why is that so?’ So theyasws said: ‘Because Allahazwj Blessed and High, When Heazwj Decided upon the people of Noahas, Opened the sky with a downpour of water, and Revealed unto the earth. But certain springs disobeyed from these, therefore Heazwj Cursed these and Made these as salty, bitter’. And in a report of Hamdan Bin Suleyman, theyasws both said: ‘O Abu Saeed! You have come to a water which denies ourasws Wilayah three times during each day. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Presents ourasws Wilayah upon the waters, so whatever accepts ourasws Wilayah is fresh and sweet, and whatever rejects ourasws Wilayah, Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Makes it to be bitter, or salty, burning’.

citation.arabic_text: مَرَرْتُ بِالْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ ( صلوات الله عليهما ) وَ هُمَا فِي الْفُرَاتِ مُسْتَنْقِعَانِ فِي إِزَارَيْنِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُمَا يَا ابْنَيْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمَا أَفْسَدْتُمَا الْإِزَارَيْنِ فَقَالَا لِي يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ فَسَادُنَا لِلْإِزَارَيْنِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْنَا مِنْ فَسَادِ الدِّينِ إِنَّ لِلْمَاءِ أَهْلًا وَ سُكَّاناً كَسُكَّانِ الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ قَالَا إِلَى أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ فَقُلْتُ إِلَى هَذَا الْمَاءِ فَقَالَا وَ مَا هَذَا الْمَاءُ فَقُلْتُ أُرِيدُ دَوَاءَهُ أَشْرَبُ مِنْ هَذَا الْمُرِّ لِعِلَّةٍ بِي أَرْجُو أَنْ يَخِفَّ لَهُ الْجَسَدُ وَ يُسْهِلَ الْبَطْنَ فَقَالَا مَا نَحْسَبُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ جَلَّ وَ عَزَّ جَعَلَ فِي شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدْ لَعَنَهُ شِفَاءً قُلْتُ وَ لِمَ ذَاكَ فَقَالَا لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى لَمَّا آسَفَهُ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ( عليه السلام ) فَتَحَ السَّمَاءَ بِمَاءٍ مُنْهَمِرٍ وَ أَوْحَى إِلَى الْأَرْضِ فاسْتَعْصَتْ عَلَيْهِ عُيُونٌ مِنْهَا فَلَعَنَهَا وَ جَعَلَهَا مِلْحاً أُجَاجاً وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ حَمْدَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ أَنَّهُمَا ( عليهما السلام ) قَالَا يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ تَأْتِي مَاءً يُنْكِرُ وَلَايَتَنَا فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَرَضَ وَلَايَتَنَا عَلَى الْمِيَاهِ فَمَا قَبِلَ وَلَايَتَنَا عَذُبَ وَ طَابَ وَ مَا جَحَدَ وَلَايَتَنَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مُرّاً أَوْ مِلْحاً أُجَاجاً .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ZIyad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> used to dislike healing with the bitter water, or with sulphuric water, and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Noah<sup>as</sup>, when it was during the flood, called the waters, so all of them responded except for the bitter water and the sulphuric water, so he<sup>as</sup> supplicated against the two, and cursed them both’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَبِي ( عليه السلام ) يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَتَدَاوَى بِالْمَاءِ الْمُرِّ وَ بِمَاءِ الْكِبْرِيتِ وَ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِنَّ نُوحاً ( عليه السلام ) لَمَّا كَانَ الطُّوفَانُ دَعَا الْمِيَاهَ فَأَجَابَتْهُ كُلُّهَا إِلَّا الْمَاءَ الْمُرَّ وَ مَاءَ الْكِبْرِيتِ فَدَعَا عَلَيْهِمَا وَ لَعَنَهُمَا .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin ZIyad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> used to dislike healing with the bitter water, or with sulphuric water, and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Noah<sup>as</sup>, when it was during the flood, called the waters, so all of them responded except for the bitter water and the sulphuric water, so he<sup>as</sup> supplicated against the two, and cursed them both’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/242)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Al Arzamy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The springs burst out from underneath the Kabah’.

citation.arabic_text: تَفَجَّرَتِ الْعُيُونُ مِنْ تَحْتِ الْكَعْبَةِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Al Arzamy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The springs burst out from underneath the Kabah’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/243)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Zakariyya Al Momin, from Abu Saeed Al Mukary, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly who said, ‘I was at the fountain of Zamzam, and a man came over to me, so he said to me, ‘Do not drink from this water, O Abu Hamza, for in this the Jinn and the humans participate in it, and this is not for the participation in it except for the human beings’. So I was surprised from his speech, and I said (to myself), ‘From where does he know this?’ Then I said to Abu Ja’farasws what was from the speech of the man to me, so heasws said to me: ‘That man is from the Jinn intending to guide you’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ حَوْضِ زَمْزَمَ فَأَتَانِي رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ لِي لَا تَشْرَبْ مِنْ هَذَا الْمَاءِ يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ فَإِنَّ هَذَا يَشْتَرِكُ فِيهِ الْجِنُّ وَ الْإِنْسُ وَ هَذَا لَا يَشْتَرِكُ فِيهِ إِلَّا الْإِنْسُ قَالَ فَتَعَجَّبْتُ مِنْ قَوْلِهِ وَ قُلْتُ مِنْ أَيْنَ عَلِمَ هَذَا قَالَ ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) مَا كَانَ مِنْ قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ لِي فَقَالَ ( عليه السلام ) لِي إِنَّ ذَلِكَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ أَرَادَ إِرْشَادَكَ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, raising it, said, ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The water of the Nile of Egypt deadens the hearts’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) مَاءُ نِيلِ مِصْرَ يُمِيتُ الْقُلُوبَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, raising it, said, ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The water of the Nile of Egypt deadens the hearts’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/243)

text: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Abbas Bin Marouf, from Al Nowfaly from Al Yaqouby, from Isa Bin Abdullah, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far having said: ‘Abu Abdullahasws said regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [23:18] And We send down water from the sky according to a measure, then We Settle it in the earth, and We are able to Take it away. So heasws said: ‘Meaning the water of the ravines’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ أَنْزَلْنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَ إِنَّا عَلى ذَهابٍ بِهِ لَقادِرُونَ فَقَالَ يَعْنِي مَاءَ الْعَقِيقِ .
citation.translation: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Abbas Bin Marouf, from Al Nowfaly from Al Yaqouby, from Isa Bin Abdullah, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far having said: ‘Abu Abdullahasws said regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [23:18] And We send down water from the sky according to a measure, then We Settle it in the earth, and We are able to Take it away. So heasws said: ‘Meaning the water of the ravines’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/244)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Ibrahim Al Madainy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Two rivers are Believers, and two rivers are Infidels. So as for the two Believers, the Euphrates and Nile of Egypt, and as for the two Infidels, the Tigris and the river Balkh’.

citation.arabic_text: نَهَرَانِ مُؤْمِنَانِ وَ نَهَرَانِ كَافِرَانِ فَأَمَّا الْمُؤْمِنَانِ فَالْفُرَاتُ وَ نِيلُ مِصْرَ وَ أَمَّا الْكَافِرَانِ فَدِجْلَةُ وَ نَهَرُ بَلْخَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Ibrahim Al Madainy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Two rivers are Believers, and two rivers are Infidels. So as for the two Believers, the Euphrates and Nile of Egypt, and as for the two Infidels, the Tigris and the river Balkh’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/244)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ja’far, from the one who mentioned it, from Al Khashab, from Ali Bin Al Hasaan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Kaseer, from Dawood Al Raqy who said, ‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> when he<sup>asws</sup> asked for water. So when he<sup>asws</sup> drank it, I saw him<sup>asws</sup> bewail and his<sup>asws</sup> eyes filled with his<sup>asws</sup> tears. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Dawood! May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse the killers of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and there is none from a servant who drinks the water, so he remembers Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> and the People of his<sup>asws</sup> household, and curses his<sup>asws</sup> killers, except that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Writes for him one hundred thousand Rewards, and Deletes from him one hundred thousand sins, and raises for him one hundred thousand levels, and it is as if he has librated one hundred thousand persons, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Resurrect him on the Day of Judgement as cool-hearted’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا اسْتَسْقَى الْمَاءَ فَلَمَّا شَرِبَهُ رَأَيْتُهُ قَدِ اسْتَعْبَرَ وَ اغْرَوْرَقَتْ عَيْنَاهُ بِدُمُوعِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي يَا دَاوُدُ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ شَرِبَ الْمَاءَ فَذَكَرَ الْحُسَيْنَ ( عليه السلام ) وَ أَهْلَ بَيْتِهِ وَ لَعَنَ قَاتِلَهُ إِلَّا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُ مِائَةَ أَلْفِ حَسَنَةٍ وَ حَطَّ عَنْهُ مِائَةَ أَلْفِ سَيِّئَةٍ وَ رَفَعَ لَهُ مِائَةَ أَلْفِ دَرَجَةٍ وَ كَأَنَّمَا أَعْتَقَ مِائَةَ أَلْفِ نَسَمَةٍ وَ حَشَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ثَلِجَ الْفُؤَادِ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The wine is from five – the grape juice, and the marinade of the raisins, and the mead from the honey, and the ale from the barley, and Al-Nabeez from the dates’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) الْخَمْرُ مِنْ خَمْسَةٍ الْعَصِيرُ مِنَ الْكَرْمِ وَ النَّقِيعُ مِنَ الزَّبِيبِ وَ الْبِتْعُ مِنَ الْعَسَلِ وَ الْمِزْرُ مِنَ الشَّعِيرِ وَ النَّبِيذُ مِنَ التَّمْرِ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Khalid Bin Jareer, from Abu Al Rabie Al Shamy who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the origin of the wine, how did its permissibility begin, and its Prohibition, and when was the wine taken?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When Adam<sup>as</sup> descended from the Paradise, he<sup>asws</sup> desired from its fruits. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Sent down two branches of grapes unto him<sup>as</sup>. So he<sup>as</sup> planted these. So when it grew leaves, and fruits, and became big, Iblees<sup>la</sup> may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, came over. So he<sup>la</sup> built a wall over these. So Adam<sup>as</sup> said: ‘What is your<sup>la</sup> state, O Accursed?’ So Iblees<sup>la</sup> said, ‘These two are mine<sup>la</sup>’. So he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘You<sup>la</sup> are lying!’ So they both agreed for the Holy Spirit to (decide) between them. So when they both ended up to it, Adam<sup>as</sup> related his<sup>as</sup> story to him, and the Holy Spirit took some fire and threw it upon both (trees), and the grapes were in their branches, to the extent that Adam<sup>as</sup> thought that there would not remain anything from these, and Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, thought similar to that. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So the fire entered wherever it tends to enter, and two thirds from these two (trees) had gone away (incinerated), and there remained a third. So the (Holy) Spirit said: ‘As for what has gone from these two, so it is the share of Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, and whatever remains, so it is for you<sup>as</sup>, O Adam<sup>as</sup>’. Al-Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Khalid Bin Nafi’n, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> – similar to it’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ أَصْلِ الْخَمْرِ كَيْفَ كَانَ بَدْءُ حَلَالِهَا وَ حَرَامِهَا وَ مَتَى اتُّخِذَ الْخَمْرَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ آدَمَ ( عليه السلام ) لَمَّا هَبَطَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ اشْتَهَى مِنْ ثِمَارِهَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَيْهِ قَضِيبَيْنِ مِنْ عِنَبٍ فَغَرَسَهُمَا فَلَمَّا أَنْ أَوْرَقَا وَ أَثْمَرَا وَ بَلَغَا جَاءَ إِبْلِيسُ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ فَحَاطَ عَلَيْهِمَا حَائِطاً فَقَالَ آدَمُ ( عليه السلام ) مَا حَالُكَ يَا مَلْعُونُ فَقَالَ إِبْلِيسُ إِنَّهُمَا لِي فَقَالَ لَهُ كَذَبْتَ فَرَضِيَا بَيْنَهُمَا بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ فَلَمَّا انْتَهَيَا إِلَيْهِ قَصَّ عَلَيْهِ آدَمُ ( عليه السلام ) قِصَّتَهُ وَ أَخَذَ رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ ضِغْثاً مِنْ نَارٍ وَ رَمَى بِهِ عَلَيْهِمَا وَ الْعِنَبُ فِي أَغْصَانِهِمَا حَتَّى ظَنَّ آدَمُ ( عليه السلام ) أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْهُمَا شَيْ‏ءٌ وَ ظَنَّ إِبْلِيسُ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ فَدَخَلَتِ النَّارُ حَيْثُ دَخَلَتْ وَ قَدْ ذَهَبَ مِنْهُمَا ثُلُثَاهُمَا وَ بَقِيَ الثُّلُثُ فَقَالَ الرُّوحُ أَمَّا مَا ذَهَبَ مِنْهُمَا فَحَظُّ إِبْلِيسَ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ وَ مَا بَقِيَ فَلَكَ يَا آدَمُ . الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مِثْلَهُ .

text: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Al Husayn Bin Yazeed, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Ibrahim, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘When Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Caused Adam<sup>as</sup> to descend, Commanded him<sup>as</sup> with the ploughing and the planting and Forwarded to him<sup>as</sup> plants from the plants of the Paradise. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Gave him<sup>as</sup> the palm tree, and the grapes, and the olives, and the pomegranate. So he<sup>as</sup> planted these for it to be for his<sup>as</sup> offspring. So he<sup>as</sup> ate from its fruits, so Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, said to him<sup>as</sup>, ‘O Adam<sup>as</sup>! What is this plant which I<sup>la</sup> do not happen to recognise it in the earth, and I<sup>la</sup> was here before you<sup>as</sup>, and was not Permitted to eat anything from these?’ So Adam<sup>la</sup> refused to invite him<sup>la</sup>. So Iblees<sup>la</sup> came over at the end of the lifetime of Adam<sup>as</sup> and said to Hawwa<sup>as</sup>, ‘The hunger and the thirst has exhausted me<sup>la</sup>’. So she<sup>as</sup> said: ‘So what is it which you<sup>la</sup> want?’ He<sup>la</sup> said, ‘I<sup>la</sup> want you<sup>as</sup> to make me<sup>la</sup> taste from these fruits’. So Hawwa<sup>as</sup> said: ‘Adam<sup>as</sup> has made me<sup>as</sup> vow that I<sup>as</sup> would not feed you<sup>la</sup> anything from these plants because these are from the Paradise, and it is not befitting for you<sup>la</sup> that you<sup>la</sup> should be eating from it’. So he<sup>la</sup> said to her<sup>as</sup>, ‘So squeeze its juice in my<sup>la</sup> palm, something from it’. But she<sup>as</sup> refused to him<sup>la</sup>. So he<sup>la</sup> said, ‘Allow me<sup>la</sup> to suck from it and I<sup>la</sup> will not eat it’. So she<sup>as</sup> took a cluster of grapes and gave it to him<sup>la</sup>. So he<sup>la</sup> sucked it, and did not eat from it. When Hawwa<sup>as</sup> was assured over it, he<sup>la</sup> went on to bite it, and Hawwa<sup>as</sup> seized it from his<sup>la</sup> mouth. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Revealed unto Adam<sup>as</sup>: “The grapes have been sucked by My<sup>azwj</sup> enemy and your<sup>as</sup> enemy Iblees<sup>la</sup>, and I<sup>azwj</sup> have Prohibited upon you<sup>as</sup> from the wine juice what the breath of Iblees<sup>la</sup> had been mixed with”. Thus, the Prohibition of the wine is because Iblees<sup>la</sup> the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had plotted against Hawwa<sup>as</sup> until he<sup>la</sup> sucked the grapes, and had he<sup>la</sup> eaten it, the grapes would have been Prohibited from its beginning to its end, and the entirety of its fruits, and whatever comes out from it’. Then he<sup>la</sup> said to Hawwa<sup>as</sup>, ‘If only you<sup>as</sup> would let me<sup>la</sup> suck from these dates just as you<sup>as</sup> let me<sup>la</sup> suck from the grapes’. So she<sup>as</sup> gave him a date. So he<sup>la</sup> touched it, and the grapes and the dates used to be more intensely aromatic and pure than the Al-Azfar musk, and sweeter than the honey. So when Iblees<sup>la</sup> the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> touched it, both their aromas and their sweetness was reduced’. Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, after the passing away of Adam<sup>as</sup> went and urinated in the roots of the grapes and the palm tree. So the water flowed upon its veins from the urine of the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So from then onwards, the grapes and the dates produced wine. citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَمَّا أَهْبَطَ آدَمَ ( عليه السلام ) أَمَرَهُ بِالْحَرْثِ وَ الزَّرْعِ وَ طَرَحَ إِلَيْهِ غَرْساً مِنْ غُرُوسِ الْجَنَّةِ فَأَعْطَاهُ النَّخْلَ وَ الْعِنَبَ وَ الزَّيْتُونَ وَ الرُّمَّانَ فَغَرَسَهَا لِيَكُونَ لِعَقِبِهِ وَ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ فَأَكَلَ هُوَ مِنْ ثِمَارِهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ إِبْلِيسُ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ يَا آدَمُ مَا هَذَا الْغَرْسُ الَّذِي لَمْ أَكُنْ أَعْرِفُهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَ قَدْ كُنْتُ فِيهَا قَبْلَكَ ائْذَنْ لِي آكُلْ مِنْهَا شَيْئاً فَأَبَى آدَمُ ( عليه السلام ) أَنْ يَدَعَهُ فَجَاءَ إِبْلِيسُ عِنْدَ آخِرِ عُمْرِ آدَمَ ( عليه السلام ) وَ قَالَ لِحَوَّاءَ إِنَّهُ قَدْ أَجْهَدَنِي الْجُوعُ وَ الْعَطَشُ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ حَوَّاءُ فَمَا الَّذِي تُرِيدُ قَالَ أُرِيدُ أَنْ تُذِيقِينِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الثِّمَارِ فَقَالَتْ حَوَّاءُ إِنَّ آدَمَ ( عليه السلام ) عَهِدَ إِلَيَّ أَنْ لَا أُطْعِمَكَ شَيْئاً مِنْ هَذَا الْغَرْسِ لِأَنَّهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ لَا يَنْبَغِي لَكَ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً فَقَالَ لَهَا فَاعْصِرِي فِي كَفِّي شَيْئاً مِنْهُ فَأَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ذَرِينِي أَمَصَّهُ وَ لَا آكُلْهُ فَأَخَذَتْ عُنْقُوداً مِنْ عِنَبٍ فَأَعْطَتْهُ فَمَصَّهُ وَ لَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ لِمَا كَانَتْ حَوَّاءُ قَدْ أَكَّدَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ يَعَضُّ عَلَيْهِ جَذَبَتْهُ حَوَّاءُ مِنْ فِيهِ فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى إِلَى آدَمَ ( عليه السلام ) أَنَّ الْعِنَبَ قَدْ مَصَّهُ عَدُوِّي وَ عَدُوُّكَ إِبْلِيسُ وَ قَدْ حَرَّمْتُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ عَصِيرَةِ الْخَمْرِ مَا خَالَطَهُ نَفَسُ إِبْلِيسَ فَحُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ لِأَنَّ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ إِبْلِيسَ مَكَرَ بِحَوَّاءَ حَتَّى مَصَّ الْعِنَبَ وَ لَوْ أَكَلَهَا لَحُرِّمَتِ الْكَرْمَةُ مِنْ أَوَّلِهَا إِلَى آخِرِهَا وَ جَمِيعُ ثَمَرِهَا وَ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ قَالَ لِحَوَّاءَ فَلَوْ أَمْصَصْتِنِي شَيْئاً مِنْ هَذَا التَّمْرِ كَمَا أَمْصَصْتِنِي مِنَ الْعِنَبِ فَأَعْطَتْهُ تَمْرَةً فَمَصَّهَا وَ كَانَتِ الْعِنَبُ وَ التَّمْرَةُ أَشَدَّ رَائِحَةً وَ أَزْكَى مِنَ الْمِسْكِ الْأَذْفَرِ وَ أَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ فَلَمَّا مَصَّهُمَا عَدُوُّ اللَّهِ إِبْلِيسُ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ ذَهَبَتْ رَائِحَتُهُمَا وَ انْتَقَصَتْ حَلَاوَتُهُمَا قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) ثُمَّ إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ ذَهَبَ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ آدَمَ ( عليه السلام ) فَبَالَ فِي أَصْلِ الْكَرْمَةِ وَ النَّخْلَةِ فَجَرَى الْمَاءُ عَلَى عُرُوقِهِمَا مِنْ بَوْلِ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ فَمِنْ ثَمَّ يَخْتَمِرُ الْعِنَبُ وَ التَّمْرُ فَحَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَى ذُرِّيَّةِ آدَمَ ( عليه السلام ) كُلَّ مُسْكِرٍ لِأَنَّ الْمَاءَ جَرَى بِبَوْلِ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ فِي النَّخْلَةِ وَ الْعِنَبِ وَ صَارَ كُلُّ مُخْتَمِرٍ خَمْراً لِأَنَّ الْمَاءَ اخْتَمَرَ فِي النَّخْلَةِ وَ الْكَرْمَةِ مِنْ رَائِحَةِ بَوْلِ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ إِبْلِيسَ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Al Husayn Bin Yazeed, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Ibrahim, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘When Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Caused Adam<sup>as</sup> to descend, Commanded him<sup>as</sup> with the ploughing and the planting and Forwarded to him<sup>as</sup> plants from the plants of the Paradise. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Gave him<sup>as</sup> the palm tree, and the grapes, and the olives, and the pomegranate. So he<sup>as</sup> planted these for it to be for his<sup>as</sup> offspring. So he<sup>as</sup> ate from its fruits, so Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, said to him<sup>as</sup>, ‘O Adam<sup>as</sup>! What is this plant which I<sup>la</sup> do not happen to recognise it in the earth, and I<sup>la</sup> was here before you<sup>as</sup>, and was not Permitted to eat anything from these?’ So Adam<sup>la</sup> refused to invite him<sup>la</sup>. So Iblees<sup>la</sup> came over at the end of the lifetime of Adam<sup>as</sup> and said to Hawwa<sup>as</sup>, ‘The hunger and the thirst has exhausted me<sup>la</sup>’. So she<sup>as</sup> said: ‘So what is it which you<sup>la</sup> want?’ He<sup>la</sup> said, ‘I<sup>la</sup> want you<sup>as</sup> to make me<sup>la</sup> taste from these fruits’. So Hawwa<sup>as</sup> said: ‘Adam<sup>as</sup> has made me<sup>as</sup> vow that I<sup>as</sup> would not feed you<sup>la</sup> anything from these plants because these are from the Paradise, and it is not befitting for you<sup>la</sup> that you<sup>la</sup> should be eating from it’. So he<sup>la</sup> said to her<sup>as</sup>, ‘So squeeze its juice in my<sup>la</sup> palm, something from it’. But she<sup>as</sup> refused to him<sup>la</sup>. So he<sup>la</sup> said, ‘Allow me<sup>la</sup> to suck from it and I<sup>la</sup> will not eat it’. So she<sup>as</sup> took a cluster of grapes and gave it to him<sup>la</sup>. So he<sup>la</sup> sucked it, and did not eat from it. When Hawwa<sup>as</sup> was assured over it, he<sup>la</sup> went on to bite it, and Hawwa<sup>as</sup> seized it from his<sup>la</sup> mouth. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Revealed unto Adam<sup>as</sup>: “The grapes have been sucked by My<sup>azwj</sup> enemy and your<sup>as</sup> enemy Iblees<sup>la</sup>, and I<sup>azwj</sup> have Prohibited upon you<sup>as</sup> from the wine juice what the breath of Iblees<sup>la</sup> had been mixed with”. Thus, the Prohibition of the wine is because Iblees<sup>la</sup> the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had plotted against Hawwa<sup>as</sup> until he<sup>la</sup> sucked the grapes, and had he<sup>la</sup> eaten it, the grapes would have been Prohibited from its beginning to its end, and the entirety of its fruits, and whatever comes out from it’. Then he<sup>la</sup> said to Hawwa<sup>as</sup>, ‘If only you<sup>as</sup> would let me<sup>la</sup> suck from these dates just as you<sup>as</sup> let me<sup>la</sup> suck from the grapes’. So she<sup>as</sup> gave him a date. So he<sup>la</sup> touched it, and the grapes and the dates used to be more intensely aromatic and pure than the Al-Azfar musk, and sweeter than the honey. So when Iblees<sup>la</sup> the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> touched it, both their aromas and their sweetness was reduced’. Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, after the passing away of Adam<sup>as</sup> went and urinated in the roots of the grapes and the palm tree. So the water flowed upon its veins from the urine of the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So from then onwards, the grapes and the dates produced wine. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Prohibited upon the offspring of Adam<sup>as</sup>, every intoxicant, because the water flowed by the urine of the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> in the palm tree and the grapes, and every fermented is wine, because the water fermented in the palm tree and the grape from the smell of the urine of the enemy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/247)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Aban, from Zurara, Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘When Noah<sup>as</sup> descended from the ship, planted some plants, and among what he<sup>as</sup> planted was a vine (of grapes). Then he<sup>as</sup> returned to his<sup>as</sup> family. So Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, came over and uprooted it. Then Noah<sup>as</sup> repeated planting it, but he<sup>as</sup> (later) found it to be upon its state and the vine had been uprooted, and found Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup> by it. So Jibraeel<sup>la</sup> came to him<sup>as</sup> and informed him<sup>as</sup> that Iblees<sup>la</sup> had uprooted it. So Noah<sup>as</sup> said to Iblees<sup>la</sup>: ‘What called you to uproot it, for, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, I<sup>as</sup> did not plant a plant which was more beloved to me than it, and by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, I<sup>as</sup> will not leave it until I<sup>as</sup> plant it’. So Iblees<sup>la</sup> said, ‘And I<sup>la</sup>, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, will not leave it until I<sup>la</sup> uproot it’. He<sup>la</sup> said to him<sup>as</sup>, ‘Make a share for me<sup>la</sup> from it’. So he<sup>as</sup> made a third from it to be for him<sup>la</sup>. But he<sup>la</sup> refused to agree. So he<sup>as</sup> made half of it to be for him<sup>la</sup>. But, he<sup>la</sup> refused to agree. So Noah<sup>as</sup> refused to increase it. So Jibraeel<sup>la</sup> said to Noah<sup>as</sup>: ‘O Rasool<sup>as</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Do a favour, for the favours are from you<sup>as</sup>’. So Noah<sup>as</sup> came to know that he (Jibraeel<sup>as</sup>) had made an authorisation for him<sup>as</sup>. So Noah<sup>as</sup> made two-thirds to be for him<sup>la</sup>. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So whenever you take juice, so cook (boil) it until two-thirds of it goes away, and eat and drink, for that (evaporated two-thirds) is the share of the Satan<sup>la</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: لَمَّا هَبَطَ نُوحٌ ( عليه السلام ) مِنَ السَّفِينَةِ غَرَسَ غَرْساً وَ كَانَ فِيمَا غَرَسَ ( عليه السلام ) الْحَبَلَةُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَجَاءَ إِبْلِيسُ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ فَقَلَعَهَا ثُمَّ إِنَّ نُوحاً ( عليه السلام ) عَادَ إِلَى غَرْسِهِ فَوَجَدَهُ عَلَى حَالِهِ وَ وَجَدَ الْحَبَلَةَ قَدْ قُلِعَتْ وَ وَجَدَ إِبْلِيسَ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ عِنْدَهَا فَأَتَاهُ جَبْرَئِيلُ ( عليه السلام ) فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ إِبْلِيسَ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ قَلَعَهَا فَقَالَ نُوحٌ لِإِبْلِيسَ مَا دَعَاكَ إِلَى قَلْعِهَا فَوَ اللَّهِ مَا غَرَسْتُ غَرْساً أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِنْهَا وَ وَ اللَّهِ لَا أَدَعُهَا حَتَّى أَغْرِسَهَا فَقَالَ إِبْلِيسُ وَ أَنَا وَ اللَّهِ لَا أَدَعُهَا حَتَّى أَقْلَعَهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ اجْعَلْ لِي مِنْهَا نَصِيباً قَالَ فَجَعَلَ لَهُ مِنْهَا الثُّلُثَ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَرْضَى فَجَعَلَ لَهُ النِّصْفَ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَرْضَى فَأَبَى نُوحٌ ( عليه السلام ) أَنْ يَزِيدَهُ فَقَالَ جَبْرَئِيلُ ( عليه السلام ) لِنُوحٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَحْسِنْ فَإِنَّ مِنْكَ الْإِحْسَانَ فَعَلِمَ نُوحٌ ( عليه السلام ) أَنَّهُ قَدْ جَعَلَ لَهُ عَلَيْهَا سُلْطَاناً فَجَعَلَ نُوحٌ ( عليه السلام ) لَهُ الثُّلُثَيْنِ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) فَإِذَا أَخَذْتَ عَصِيراً فَاطْبُخْهُ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ الثُّلُثَانِ وَ كُلْ وَ اشْرَبْ فَذَاكَ نَصِيبُ الشَّيْطَانِ .

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Usman Bin Isa, from Saeed Bin Yassar, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, disputed with Noah<sup>as</sup> regarding the grapes. So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> came to him<sup>as</sup> and said: ‘There is a right for him<sup>la</sup>, so give him<sup>la</sup>’. So he<sup>as</sup> gave him the one-third. But Iblees<sup>la</sup> did not agree. Then he<sup>as</sup> gave him<sup>la</sup> the half, but he<sup>la</sup> did not agree. So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> threw the fire, and two-thirds was incinerated, and there remained the one-third. So he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘Whatever the fire incinerated, so it is his<sup>la</sup> share, and whatever remains, so it is Permissible for you<sup>as</sup>, O Noah<sup>as</sup>!

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ نَازَعَ نُوحاً ( عليه السلام ) فِي الْكَرْمِ فَأَتَاهُ جَبْرَئِيلُ ( عليه السلام ) فَقَالَ إِنَّ لَهُ حَقّاً فَأَعْطِهِ فَأَعْطَاهُ الثُّلُثَ فَلَمْ يَرْضَ إِبْلِيسُ ثُمَّ أَعْطَاهُ النِّصْفَ فَلَمْ يَرْضَ فَطَرَحَ جَبْرَئِيلُ نَاراً فَأَحْرَقَتِ الثُّلُثَيْنِ وَ بَقِيَ الثُّلُثُ فَقَالَ مَا أَحْرَقَتِ النَّارُ فَهُوَ نَصِيبُهُ وَ مَا بَقِيَ فَهُوَ لَكَ يَا نُوحُ حَلَالٌ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Usman Bin Isa, from Saeed Bin Yassar, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, disputed with Noah<sup>as</sup> regarding the grapes. So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> came to him<sup>as</sup> and said: ‘There is a right for him<sup>la</sup>, so give him<sup>la</sup>’. So he<sup>as</sup> gave him the one-third. But Iblees<sup>la</sup> did not agree. Then he<sup>as</sup> gave him<sup>la</sup> the half, but he<sup>la</sup> did not agree. So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> threw the fire, and two-thirds was incinerated, and there remained the one-third. So he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘Whatever the fire incinerated, so it is his<sup>la</sup> share, and whatever remains, so it is Permissible for you<sup>as</sup>, O Noah<sup>as</sup>!
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/249)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Umar Al Yamani, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic did not Send a Prophet<sup>as</sup> at all except it was in the Knowledge of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Completing the Religion for him<sup>as</sup>, and in it is the Prohibition of the wine, and the wine will not cease to be unlawful. The Religion rather, changes from one characteristic to another, and had that been in its entirety (all the characteristics at once), they (people) would cut off to be without the Religion’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Khalid Bin Jareer, from Abu Al Rabie Al Shamy who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was asked about the wine, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Sent me<sup>saww</sup> as a Mercy to the worlds, and for the obliteration (destruction) of the musical instruments, and the affairs of the Pre-Islamic period, and the idols’. And he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘My<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> Vowed: “A servant of Mine<sup>azwj</sup> will not drink wine in the world except that I<sup>saww</sup> shall Quench him<sup>as</sup> similar to whatever he has drunk from the scalding water on the Day of Judgement as a Punishment, regardless of there being Forgiveness for him; nor would any servant of Mine<sup>azwj</sup> drink it, be he a young child or an owned slave, except that I<sup>azwj</sup> would Quench him from the scalding water on the Day of Judgement, as a Punishment afterwards, regardless of there being Forgiveness for him”.

citation.arabic_text: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الْخَمْرِ فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بَعَثَنِي رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ وَ لِأَمْحَقَ الْمَعَازِفَ وَ الْمَزَامِيرَ وَ أُمُورَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَ الْأَوْثَانَ وَ قَالَ أَقْسَمَ رَبِّي أَنْ لَا يَشْرَبَ عَبْدٌ لِي فِي الدُّنْيَا خَمْراً إِلَّا سَقَيْتُهُ مِثْلَ مَا شَرِبَ مِنْهَا مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُعَذَّباً أَوْ مَغْفُوراً لَهُ وَ لَا يَسْقِيهَا عَبْدٌ لِي صَبِيّاً صَغِيراً أَوْ مَمْلُوكاً إِلَّا سَقَيْتُهُ مِثْلَ مَا سَقَاهُ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُعَذَّباً بَعْدُ أَوْ مَغْفُوراً لَهُ .

text: Ibn Mahboub, from Khalid Bin Jareer, from Abu Al Rabie Al Shamy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who drinks the wine after Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic having Prohibited it upon my<sup>saww</sup> tongue, so he is not deserving of being married to when he proposes, nor for him to be interceded for when there is intercession, nor should he be ratified when he narrates, nor relied upon an entrustment. So the one who relies upon him after having his knowledge with regards to it, so it is not for those who rely upon him, any guarantee (of security) upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, nor would there be any Rewards for him, nor a compensation’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ بَعْدَ مَا حَرَّمَهَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَى لِسَانِي فَلَيْسَ بِأَهْلٍ أَنْ يُزَوَّجَ إِذَا خَطَبَ وَ لَا يُشَفَّعَ إِذَا شَفَعَ وَ لَا يُصَدَّقَ إِذَا حَدَّثَ وَ لَا يُؤْتَمَنَ عَلَى أَمَانَةٍ فَمَنِ ائْتَمَنَهُ بَعْدَ عِلْمِهِ فِيهِ فَلَيْسَ لِلَّذِي ائْتَمَنَهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ضَمَانٌ وَ لَا لَهُ أَجْرٌ وَ لَا خَلَفٌ .

text: A number of our copanions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Amro Bin Usman, from Al Husayn Bin Sadeyr, from his father, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘They would bring the drinker of the wine on the Day of Judgement as blackened of face, drooping tongue, his saliva dripping upon his chest, and it is a right upon Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic that Heazwj Quenches him from the essence of Khabaal’, or said: ‘from a well of Khabaal’. I said, ‘And what is a well of Khabaal?’ Hesaww said: ‘A well in which accumulates the puss of the adulteresses’.

citation.arabic_text: يُؤْتَى شَارِبُ الْخَمْرِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُسْوَدّاً وَجْهُهُ مُدْلَعاً لِسَانُهُ يَسِيلُ لُعَابُهُ عَلَى صَدْرِهِ وَ حَقٌّ عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهُ مِنْ طِينَةِ خَبَالٍ أَوْ قَالَ مِنْ بِئْرِ خَبَالٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ مَا بِئْرُ خَبَالٍ قَالَ بِئْرٌ يَسِيلُ فِيهَا صَدِيدُ الزُّنَاةِ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from IBn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The wine drinker should neither be consoled when he is sick, nor should his funeral be attended, nor should he be verified when he testifies, nor should he be given in marriage when he proposes, nor should he be relied upon an entrustment’.

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Al A’ala, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The wine drinker, if he were to fall sick, so do not console him, and if he dies, so do not attend it (funeral), and if he were to testify, so do not ratify him, and if he proposes, so do not give in marriage to him, and if he were to ask you for an entrustment, so do not entrust it to him’.

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Bashir Al Huzalay, from Ajlan Abu Salih who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The child is born so (if) we quench it from the wine’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whoever quenches a newborn with wine’, or said: ‘intoxicant’, ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Quench him from the scalding water, even though He<sup>azwj</sup> may have Forgiven him’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) الْمَوْلُودُ يُولَدُ فَنَسْقِيهِ مِنَ الْخَمْرِ فَقَالَ مَنْ سَقَى مَوْلُوداً خَمْراً أَوْ قَالَ مُسْكِراً سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ وَ إِنْ غَفَرَ لَهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Bashir Al Huzalay, from Ajlan Abu Salih who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The child is born so (if) we quench it from the wine’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whoever quenches a newborn with wine’, or said: ‘intoxicant’, ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Quench him from the scalding water, even though He<sup>azwj</sup> may have Forgiven him’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazal Bin Shazaan, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, and Dorost, and Hisham Bin Salim, altogether, from Ajlan Abu Salih who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Says: “The one who drinks an intoxicant, or quenches it to his young children not having the intellect, would be Quenched from the scalding water as a Punishment or there being Forgiveness for him; and the one who leaves the intoxicant seeking My<sup>azwj</sup> Pleasure, I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Enter him into the Paradise, and Quench him from the sealed nectar, and would Deal with him from the prestige what I<sup>azwj</sup> would Deal with My Guardians<sup>asws</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مَنْ شَرِبَ مُسْكِراً أَوْ سَقَاهُ صَبِيّاً لَا يَعْقِلُ سَقَيْتُهُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْحَمِيمِ مُعَذَّباً أَوْ مَغْفُوراً لَهُ وَ مَنْ تَرَكَ الْمُسْكِرَ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِي أَدْخَلْتُهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَ سَقَيْتُهُ مِنَ الرَّحِيقِ الْمَخْتُومِ وَ فَعَلْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْكَرَامَةِ مَا أَفْعَلُ بِأَوْلِيَائِي .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The wine drinker would come on the Day of Judgement as blackened of face, bent side, drooping tongue, calling out, ‘The thirst! The thirst!’

citation.arabic_text: شَارِبُ الْخَمْرِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَأْتِي مُسْوَدّاً وَجْهُهُ مَائِلًا شِقُّهُ مُدْلَعاً لِسَانُهُ يُنَادِي الْعَطَشَ الْعَطَشَ .

text: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from someone else, from Aban Bin Usma, from Hammad Bin Bashir, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The one who drinks the wine after Allahazwj the High having Prohibited it upon mysaww tongue, so he is not deserving of being married to when he proposes, nor to be ratified when he narrates, nor interceded for when there is intercession, nor relied upon an entrustment. So the one who trusts him upon an entrustment, so he devours it or wastes it, so it is not for the one who entrusted him, upon Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic that Heazwj Rewards him or Compensates him’. And Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Iasws wanted to barter (trade) some goods to Yemen, so Iasws went to Abu Ja’farasws and said to himasws, ‘Iasws intend to send so and so for bartering goods’. So heasws said to me: ‘But, do youasws not know that he drinks the wine?’ So I said, ‘It has reached me from the Believers, they are saying that’. So heasws said to me: ‘Ratify them, for Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [9:61] he believes in Allah and has faith in the Believers’. Then heasws said: ‘If youasws were to send him for trading so if he destroys it or wasters it, so it would not be for youasws upon Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic that Heazwj Recompenses you nor Compensates upon youasws. So if youasws were to send him for barter and he wastes it, and youasws were to supplicate to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic: ‘Recompense measws!’ Heasws said: ‘O myasws son! No, it is not for youasws upon Allahazwj that Heazwj Recompenses you, nor that Heazwj Compensates’. Heasws said: ‘Iasws said to himasws: ‘And why is that so?’ So heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [4:5] And do not give away your property to the foolish which Allah has made for you a (means of) support. So, do youasws know of any one more foolish that the wine drinker?’ Heasws said: ‘Then heasws said: ‘The servant does not cease to be in a leeway from Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic until he drinks the wine. So when he drinks it, Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Tears down his protective covering, and his guardian and his brother would be Ibleesla, may Allahazwj Curse himla, and be his hearing, and his vision, and his hands, and his feet, ushering him to every straying, and exchange him from every goodness’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ بَعْدَ أَنْ حَرَّمَهَا اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَى لِسَانِي فَلَيْسَ بِأَهْلٍ أَنْ يُزَوَّجَ إِذَا خَطَبَ وَ لَا يُصَدَّقَ إِذَا حَدَّثَ وَ لَا يُشَفَّعَ إِذَا شَفَعَ وَ لَا يُؤْتَمَنَ عَلَى أَمَانَةٍ فَمَنِ ائْتَمَنَهُ عَلَى أَمَانَةٍ فَأَكَلَهَا أَوْ ضَيَّعَهَا فَلَيْسَ لِلَّذِي ائْتَمَنَهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يَأْجُرَهُ وَ لَا يُخْلِفَ عَلَيْهِ وَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنِّي أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَسْتَبْضِعَ بِضَاعَةً إِلَى الْيَمَنِ فَأَتَيْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّنِي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْتَبْضِعَ فُلَاناً بِضَاعَةً فَقَالَ لِي أَ مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّهُ يَشْرَبُ الْخَمْرَ فَقُلْتُ قَدْ بَلَغَنِي مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لِي صَدِّقْهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَ يُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّكَ إِنِ اسْتَبْضَعْتَهُ فَهَلَكَتْ أَوْ ضَاعَتْ فَلَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يَأْجُرَكَ وَ لَا يُخْلِفَ عَلَيْكَ فَاسْتَبْضَعْتُهُ فَضَيَّعَهَا فَدَعَوْتُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يَأْجُرَنِي فَقَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ مَهْ لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يَأْجُرَكَ وَ لَا يُخْلِفَ عَلَيْكَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ وَ لِمَ فَقَالَ لِي إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ وَ لا تُؤْتُوا السُّفَهاءَ أَمْوالَكُمُ الَّتِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِياماً فَهَلْ تَعْرِفُ سَفِيهاً أَسْفَهَ مِنْ شَارِبِ الْخَمْرِ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ( عليه السلام ) لَا يَزَالُ الْعَبْدُ فِي فُسْحَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ حَتَّى يَشْرَبَ الْخَمْرَ فَإِذَا شَرِبَهَا خَرَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَنْهُ سِرْبَالَهُ وَ كَانَ وَلِيُّهُ وَ أَخُوهُ إِبْلِيسَ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ وَ سَمْعُهُ وَ بَصَرُهُ وَ يَدُهُ وَ رِجْلُهُ يَسُوقُهُ إِلَى كُلِّ ضَلَالٍ وَ يَصْرِفُهُ عَنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Husayn Bin Ulwan, from Amro Bin Khalid, (It has been narrated) from Zayd son of Ali<sup>asws</sup>, from his forefather<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> cursed the wine, and those who squeeze it, and who order for it to be squeezed, and its sellers, and its buyers, and its quenchers, and the consumer of its price, and its drinker, and its carrier, and to whom it is carried to’.

citation.arabic_text: لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) الْخَمْرَ وَ عَاصِرَهَا وَ مُعْتَصِرَهَا وَ بَائِعَهَا وَ مُشْتَرِيَهَا وَ سَاقِيَهَا وَ آكِلَ ثَمَنِهَا وَ شَارِبَهَا وَ حَامِلَهَا وَ الْمَحْمُولَةَ إِلَيْهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Husayn Bin Ulwan, from Amro Bin Khalid, (It has been narrated) from Zayd son of Ali<sup>asws</sup>, from his forefather<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> cursed the wine, and those who squeeze it, and who order for it to be squeezed, and its sellers, and its buyers, and its quenchers, and the consumer of its price, and its drinker, and its carrier, and to whom it is carried to’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/254)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ali Al Sowfy, from Hazar Al Sayrafi, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who drinks Al-Nabeez upon that it is Permissible would abide eternally in the Fire, and the one who drinks it upon that it is Prohibited would be Punished in the Fire’.

citation.arabic_text: مَنْ شَرِبَ النَّبِيذَ عَلَى أَنَّهُ حَلَالٌ خُلِّدَ فِي النَّارِ وَ مَنْ شَرِبَهُ عَلَى أَنَّهُ حَرَامٌ عُذِّبَ فِي النَّارِ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ali Al Sowfy, from Hazar Al Sayrafi, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who drinks Al-Nabeez upon that it is Permissible would abide eternally in the Fire, and the one who drinks it upon that it is Prohibited would be Punished in the Fire’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/254)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yusuf Bin Ali, from Nasr Bin Muzahim and Dorost Al Wasity, from Zurara and someone else, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The drinker of intoxication, there is no bond of marriage between us<sup>asws</sup> and him’.

citation.arabic_text: شَارِبُ الْمُسْكِرِ لَا عِصْمَةَ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَهُ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ismail Bin Muhammad Al Minqary, from Yazeed Bin Abu Ziyad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who drinks an intoxicant and dies, and in his inside is something from it, not having repented from it, would be Resurrected from his grave confused, his die inclined, his saliva oozing, calling for the woe and the doom’.

citation.arabic_text: مَنْ شَرِبَ الْمُسْكِرَ وَ مَاتَ وَ فِي جَوْفِهِ مِنْهُ شَيْ‏ءٌ لَمْ يَتُبْ مِنْهُ بُعِثَ مِنْ قَبْرِهِ مُخَبَّلًا مَائِلًا شِدْقُهُ سَائِلًا لُعَابُهُ يَدْعُو بِالْوَيْلِ وَ الثُّبُورِ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/254)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Amro Bin Ibrahim, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Umar Bin Aban who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The one who drinks an intoxicant, would have a right upon Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic that Heazwj Quenches him from the essence of Khabaal’. I said, ‘And what is the essence of Khabaal?’ So heasws said: ‘Puss from the private parts of a prostitute’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَنْ شَرِبَ مُسْكِراً كَانَ حَقّاً عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهُ مِنْ طِينَةِ خَبَالٍ قُلْتُ وَ مَا طِينَةُ خَبَالٍ فَقَالَ صَدِيدُ فُرُوجِ الْبَغَايَا .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Amro Bin Ibrahim, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Umar Bin Aban who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The one who drinks an intoxicant, would have a right upon Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic that Heazwj Quenches him from the essence of Khabaal’. I said, ‘And what is the essence of Khabaal?’ So heasws said: ‘Puss from the private parts of a prostitute’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Muhraz, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> do not Pray over the one drowned in wine’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) لَا أُصَلِّي عَلَى غَرِيقِ خَمْرٍ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Bakr Bin Salih, from Al Shaybani, from Yunus Bin Zibyan who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘O Yunus Bin Zabyan! Tell Atiyya from measws that the one who drinks one dosage of wine, Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Curses him, and Hisazwj Angels, and Hisazwj Rasoolsas, and the Believers. So if he were to drink it until he is intoxicated from it, the Spirit of Faith would be removed from his body, and there would ride inside him a stupid, malicious, Accursed Spirit, so he would neglect the Prayer. So when he neglects the Prayer, the Angels Rebuke him, and Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Says: “Myazwj servant! You have disbelieved and the Angels have Rebuked you. Shame on you, Myazwj servant!”’ Then Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Disgrace! Disgrace! Disgrace, by Allahazwj of the Rebuke of the Sublime, Majestic is Hisazwj Name, an hour of it is more difficult that the Punishment of a thousand years’. He (the narrator) said, ‘Then Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘[33:61] Accursed: wherever they are found they shall be seized and killed with a (fierce) killing’. Then heasws said: ‘O Yunus! Accursed, Accursed is the one who neglects the Command of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic. If he takes to the land he would be ravaged, and if he takes to the sea he would drown, in anger due to the Anger of the Sublime, Mighty is Hisazwj Name’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَا يُونُسَ بْنَ ظَبْيَانَ أَبْلِغْ عَطِيَّةَ عَنِّي أَنَّهُ مَنْ شَرِبَ جُرْعَةً مِنْ خَمْرٍ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ مَلَائِكَتُهُ وَ رُسُلُهُ وَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ فَإِنْ شَرِبَهَا حَتَّى يَسْكَرَ مِنْهَا نُزِعَ رُوحُ الْإِيمَانِ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ وَ رَكِبَتْ فِيهِ رُوحٌ سَخِيفَةٌ خَبِيثَةٌ مَلْعُونَةٌ فَيَتْرُكُ الصَّلَاةَ فَإِذَا تَرَكَ الصَّلَاةَ عَيَّرَتْهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُ عَبْدِي كَفَرْتَ وَ عَيَّرَتْكَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ سَوْأَةً لَكَ عَبْدِي ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) سَوْأَةً سَوْأَةً كَمَا تَكُونُ السَّوْأَةَ وَ اللَّهِ لَتَوْبِيخُ الْجَلِيلِ جَلَّ اسْمُهُ سَاعَةً وَاحِدَةً أَشَدُّ مِنْ عَذَابِ أَلْفِ عَامٍ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَلْعُونِينَ أَيْنَما ثُقِفُوا أُخِذُوا وَ قُتِّلُوا تَقْتِيلًا ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا يُونُسُ مَلْعُونٌ مَلْعُونٌ مَنْ تَرَكَ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِنْ أَخَذَ بَرّاً دَمَّرَتْهُ وَ إِنْ أَخَذَ بَحْراً غَرَّقَتْهُ يُغْضَبُ لِغَضَبِ الْجَلِيلِ عَزَّ اسْمُهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Bakr Bin Salih, from Al Shaybani, from Yunus Bin Zibyan who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘O Yunus Bin Zabyan! Tell Atiyya from measws that the one who drinks one dosage of wine, Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Curses him, and Hisazwj Angels, and Hisazwj Rasoolsas, and the Believers. So if he were to drink it until he is intoxicated from it, the Spirit of Faith would be removed from his body, and there would ride inside him a stupid, malicious, Accursed Spirit, so he would neglect the Prayer. So when he neglects the Prayer, the Angels Rebuke him, and Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Says: “Myazwj servant! You have disbelieved and the Angels have Rebuked you. Shame on you, Myazwj servant!”’ Then Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Disgrace! Disgrace! Disgrace, by Allahazwj of the Rebuke of the Sublime, Majestic is Hisazwj Name, an hour of it is more difficult that the Punishment of a thousand years’. He (the narrator) said, ‘Then Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘[33:61] Accursed: wherever they are found they shall be seized and killed with a (fierce) killing’. Then heasws said: ‘O Yunus! Accursed, Accursed is the one who neglects the Command of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic. If he takes to the land he would be ravaged, and if he takes to the sea he would drown, in anger due to the Anger of the Sublime, Mighty is Hisazwj Name’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (22/255)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Marwak, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The people of the world who quench themselves from the intoxicants are dying thirsty, and would be Resurrected thirsty, and would be entering the Fire thirsty’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ أَهْلَ الرِّيِّ فِي الدُّنْيَا مِنَ الْمُسْكِرِ يَمُوتُونَ عِطَاشاً وَ يُحْشَرُونَ عِطَاشاً وَ يَدْخُلُونَ النَّارَ عِطَاشاً .
